50064.text: Forced Interrupt: When a character you control attacks Black Widow, remove 1 threat from the main scheme (ignoring any crisis icons in play) → discard the top card of the encounter deck and resolve each "Preparation" ability on that card.

50065.Name: Black Widow
50065.text: When Revealed: Place 2[per_hero] threat on the main scheme. Forced Interrupt: When a character you control attacks Black Widow, remove 1 threat from the main scheme → discard the top card of the encounter deck and resolve each "Preparation" ability on that card.

50066.Name: Black Widow
50066.text: When Revealed: Place 3[per_hero] threat on the main scheme. Forced Interrupt: When a character you control attacks Black Widow, remove 1 threat from the main scheme → discard the top card of the encounter deck and resolve each "Preparation" ability on that card.

50067a.Name: The Widow's Web
50067a.text: Contents: Black Widow (I) and Black Widow (II). (Black Widow (II) and Black Widow (III) instead for expert mode.) Black Widow and Standard encounter sets. Two modular encounter sets (A.I.M. Abduction and A.I.M. Science). Setup: Each player searches the encounter deck for a minion and puts it into play engaged with them. (Shuffle.)

50067b.Name: The Widow's Web
50067b.text: X is Black Widow's stage number. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

50068.Name: Black Widow's Gauntlet
50068.text:
Attack to Black Widow. Black Widow gains retaliate 1. Hero Response: After a character you control attacks Black Widow, if no "Preparation" ability was resolved, discard this card (after resolving the retaliate keyword).
Preparation: Attach this card to Black Widow.

50069.Name: Grappling Hook
50069.text:
Attack to Black Widow. Forced Interrupt: When a player plays an event card, cancel its effects and discard it. Then, discard this card.
Preparation: Discard 1 event card from your hand.

50070.Name: Night Vision Goggles
50070.text:
Attack to Black Widow. Each encounter card without a printed "Preparation" ability gains "Preparation: Prevent all damage from this attack. Then, discard Night Vision Goggles."
Preparation: Attach this card to Black Widow.

50071.Name: Stun Net
50071.text:
Attach to your identity. Attached character cannot attack. Hero Action: Exhaust a character you control → discard this card. Any player may trigger this ability.
Preparation: After this attack, attach this card to the attacking character.

50072.Name: A.I.M. Commando
50072.text:
Quickstrike.
Preparation: After this attack, put this minion into play engaged with you.

50073.Name: A.I.M. Grunt
50073.text:
Guard.
Preparation: Put this minion into play engaged with you. Then, resolve this attack against A.I.M. Grunt instead.

50074.Name: Automated Defenses
50074.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. Each encounter card without a printed "Preparation" ability gains "Preparation: Deal 1 damage to the attacking character."

50075.Name: Destroy Evidence
50075.text: Hinder 2[per_hero]. Each other encounter card gains incite 1. (When revealed, place 1 threat on the main scheme.)

50076.Name: Attacrobatics
50076.text:
When Revealed: If you are in alter-ego form, change to hero form. Black Widow attacks you. Give her an additional boost card for this attack.
Preparation: Prevent all damage from this attack. In expert mode, deal that much damage to the attacking character.

50077.Name: Covert Ops
50077.text:
When Revealed: You are confused. Black Widow schemes.
Preparation: Place 1 threat on each scheme.

50078.Name: Dance of Death
50078.text:
When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to a character you control. Deal 2 damage to a second character you control. Deal 3 damage to a third character you control.
Preparation: Deal 1 damage to each character you control.

50079.Name: Widow's Bite
50079.text:
When Revealed: You are stunned. Take 1 damage (2 damage instead if you were already stunned).
Preparation: After this attack, stun the attacking character.

50080.Name: A.I.M. Abductor
50080.text: When Revealed: Tuck the ally you control with the most remaining hit points under Abduct Superhumans. Otherwise, place 2 threat on Abduct Superhumans. If Abduct Superhumans is not in play, find it and put it into play.

50081.Name: Abduct Superhumans
50081.text: Surge. Forced Interrupt: When an ally leaves play, tuck it under here and place threat here equal to its cost. Then, place 1 acceleration token here. When Defeated: Put each ally tucked here into play under its owner's control.

50082.Name: Nabbed!
50082.text: When Revealed: If Abduct Superhumans is not in play, find it and put it into play. Discard cards from the top of your deck until an ally is discarded and tuck it under Abduct Superhumans. Place threat equal to that ally's cost and 1 acceleration token on Abduct Superhumans.

50083.Name: A.I.M. Scientist
50083.text: Surge. Vulnerable. (Discard this character if it is stunned or confused.) While the engaged player is engaged with another minion, A.I.M. Scientist cannot be attacked.

50084.Name: A.I.M. Soldier
50084.text: Patrol. When Revealed: Find A.I.M. Scientist and put it into play engaged with you. (If it is already in play, it engages you.) If A.I.M. Scientist did not enter play this way, place 1 threat on the main scheme.

50085.Name: Mad Science
50085.text:
Hinder 2[per_hero].
Each [[A.I.M.]] minion gains 1 acceleration icon ([acceleration]).

50086a.Name: Batroc
50086a.text: [star] Forced Response: After Batroc attacks, place 1 threat on Alert Level. Forced Interrupt: When Batroc would be defeated, reset his hit points to 8 instead. Then, remove 6 threat from the main scheme.

50086b.Name: Batroc
50086b.text: [star] Forced Response: After Batroc attacks, place 1 threat on Alert Level. Forced Interrupt: When Batroc would be defeated, reset his hit points to 12 instead. Then, remove 6 threat from the main scheme.

50087a.Name: Infiltrate A.I.M. Island Embassy
50087a.text: Contents: Batroc (A). (Batroc (B) instead for expert mode.) Batroc and Standard encounter sets. Two modular encounter sets (A.I.M. Science and Batrocs's Brigade). Setup: Set each Rescued Captive ally aside. Put the Alert Level environment into play, [[Low]] side faceup. In expert mode, place 2[per_hero] threat on Alert Level.

50087b.Name: Infiltrate A.I.M. Island Embassy
50087b.text: Forced Interrupt: When the last threat is removed from this scheme, advance to stage 2A (the players win by advancing). If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

50088b.Name: Locate Missing Person
50088b.text: Forced Interrupt: When the last threat is removed from this scheme, put 1 set-aside Rescued Captive ally into play exhausted under any player's control. The players may advance to stage 3A. If they do not advance, place 3[per_hero] threat here. (The players win by advancing, but will need at least 1 Rescued Captive to survive.) If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

50089a.Name: Extract Captives
50089a.text: When Revealed: If the Alert Level is on its [[High]] side, deal each player 1 facedown encounter card. Otherwise, remove all threat from Alert Level and flip it to its [[High]] side. In either case, in expert mode, place 2[per_hero] threat on Alert Level.

50089b.Name: Extract Captives
50089b.text: In expert mode, each minion gains quickstrike. Forced Interrupt: When an enemy attacks, it attacks a Rescued Captive instead. If there is no threat here, the players win the game. If this stage is completed or there are no Rescued Captive allies in play, the players lose the game.

50090a.Name: Alert Level
50090a.text: If there is at least 4[per_hero] threat here, remove all threat from here and flip this card. Forced Response: After a character is defeated except by consequential damage, place 1 threat here. Hero Action: Spend 1 resource of any type → remove 1 threat from here.

50090b.Name: Alert Level
50090b.text: Batroc gets +1 SCH and +1 ATK. If there is at least 4[per_hero] threat here, the players lose the game. Forced Response: After a character is defeated except by consequential damage, place 1 threat here. Hero Action: Spend 1 resource of any type → remove 1 threat from here.

50091.Name: Rescued Captive
50091.text: Victory -1. Does not count against your ally limit. Card abilities cannot remove this ally from play. Hero Action: Exhaust Rescued Captive → remove 1[per_hero] threat from the main scheme.

50092.Name: Heightened Reflexes
50092.text:
Attach to Batroc. Uses (4 leap counters). Forced Interrupt: When Batroc would take any amount of damage, prevent 2 of that damage and remove 1 leap counter from here.
[star] Boost: Attach this card to Batroc.

50093.Name: Embassy Guard
50093.text: Guard. Vulnerable. (Discard this character if it is stunned or confused.) If Alert Level is on its [[High]] side, this card gains surge. When Defeated: Place 1 threat on Alert Level.

50094.Name: Embassy Patrol
50094.text: Patrol. Vulnerable. (Discard this character if it is stunned or confused.) If Alert Level is on its [[High]] side, this card gains incite 1. When Defeated: Place 1 threat on Alert Level.

50095.Name: Commandeer Security Office
50095.text: When Revealed: If Alert Level is on its [[High]] side, place 1 acceleration token here. When Defeated: Remove 1[per_hero] threat from Alert Level.

50096.Name: Leaping Kick
50096.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Batroc schemes. When Revealed (Hero): Batroc attacks the ally with the most remaining hit points. This attack gains overkill. If there were no allies in play, Batroc attacks you.

50097.Name: Security Cameras
50097.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Remove 1 threat from Alert Level. This card gains surge. When Revealed (Hero): For each character you control, choose to either exhaust that character or place 1 threat on Alert Level (2 threat instead if Alert Level is on its [[High]] side).

50098.Name: Machete
50098.text: Surge. Vulnerable. [star] Machete's attacks gain piercing. When Defeated: Shuffle Machete into the encounter deck.

50099.Name: Rapido
50099.text:
[star] Rapido's attacks gain ranged and deal indirect damage. When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to each character you control.
[star] Boost: Deal 1 damage to each character you control.

50100.Name: Zaran
50100.text: [star] Zaran gets +X ATK, where X is the printed resource cost of the card tucked under him. When Revealed: Tuck a [[Weapon]] upgrade you control under Zaran. Otherwise, tuck the top card of your deck under Zaran.

50101.Name: Batroc's Brigade
50101.text: Each minion gains toughness. When Revealed: Give each enemy a tough status card. Hero Interrupt: When you reveal a non-[[Elite]] minion, spend 3 resources of any type → cancel the effects of that minion and discard it.

50102.Name: Soldiers of Fortune
50102.text:
When Revealed: Choose: • Spend 3 resources of any type. • Find a [[Mercenary]] minion and reveal it. If no minion entered play this way, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: Choose: Either spend 1 resource of any type, or this card gains [boost][boost][boost].

50103a.Name: M.O.D.O.K.
50103a.text: Retaliate 1. Forced Interrupt: When M.O.D.O.K. would be defeated, if a Holding Cell is in play, remove 2 lock counters from it and reset M.O.D.O.K.'s hit points to 10 instead. Otherwise, the players win the game.

50103b.Name: M.O.D.O.K.
50103b.text: Retaliate 2. Steady. Forced Interrupt: When M.O.D.O.K. would be defeated, if a Holding Cell is in play, remove 2 lock counters from it and reset M.O.D.O.K.'s hit points to 14 instead. Otherwise, the players win the game.

50104a.Name: Upgrading Adaptoids
50104a.text: Contents: M.O.D.O.K. (A). (M.O.D.O.K. (B) instead for expert mode.) M.O.D.O.K. and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (Scientist Supreme). Setup: Create the Holding Cell deck (see rulebook p. 13). Put 1 random [[Adaptoid]] environment into play (2 environments instead in expert mode) and set the others aside. Each player searches the encounter deck for a copy of Adaptoid and reveals it.

50104b.Name: Upgrading Adaptoids
50104b.text: Forced Interrupt: When this stage would be completed, put 1 random set-aside [[Adaptoid]] environment into play instead. Then, if there are no set-aside [[Adaptoid]] environments, the players lose the game. Otherwise, remove all threat from here and shuffle each Adaptoid minion from the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.

50105a.Name: Holding Cell
50105a.text: Enters play with 2[per_hero] lock counters on it. Forced Interrupt: When the last lock counter is removed from here, flip this card and put Flying Inhuman into play under any player's control. Hero Action: Spend [energy] [energy] resources or 3 resources of any type → remove 1 lock counter from here.

50105b.Name: Flying Inhuman
50105b.text: Does not count against your ally limit. [star] Response: After this ally thwarts, remove 1 threat from another scheme. Forced Response: After this card leaves play, flip it and place it on the bottom of the Holding Cell deck.

50106a.Name: Holding Cell
50106a.text: Enters play with 2[per_hero] lock counters on it. Forced Interrupt: When the last lock counter is removed from here, flip this card and put Psionic Inhuman into play under any player's control. Hero Action: Spend [mental] [mental] resources or 3 resources of any type → remove 1 lock counter from here.

50106b.Name: Psionic Inhuman
50106b.text: Does not count against your ally limit. [star] Response: After this ally thwarts, remove 1 lock counter from a Holding Cell. Forced Response: After this card leaves play, flip it and place it on the bottom of the Holding Cell deck.

50107a.Name: Holding Cell
50107a.text: Enters play with 2[per_hero] lock counters on it. Forced Interrupt: When the last lock counter is removed from here, flip this card and put Sarah Garza into play under any player's control. Hero Action: Spend a [wild] resource or 3 resources of any type → remove 1 lock counter from here.

50107b.Name: Sarah Garza
50107b.text: Does not count against your ally limit. [star] Sarah Garza's attacks gain overkill and ranged. Forced Response: After this card leaves play, flip it and place it on the bottom of the Holding Cell deck.

50108a.Name: Holding Cell
50108a.text: Enters play with 2[per_hero] lock counters on it. Forced Interrupt: When the last lock counter is removed from here, flip this card and put Strong Inhuman into play under any player's control. Hero Action: Spend [physical] [physical] resources or 3 resources of any type → remove 1 lock counter from here.

50108b.Name: Strong Inhuman
50108b.text: Toughness. Does not count against your ally limit. Forced Interrupt: After this card leaves play, flip it and place it on the bottom of the Holding Cell deck.

50109.Name: Flying Upgrade
50109.text: Each Adaptoid gets +1 SCH, gains incite 1, and gains the [[Aerial]] trait.

50110.Name: Psionic Upgrade
50110.text: Each Adaptoid gains villainous and the [[Psionic]] trait.

50111.Name: Sarah Garza Upgrade
50111.text:
Each Adaptoid gains the [[Elite]] trait.
Each Adaptoid gets +1 ATK and its attacks gain overkill and ranged.

50112.Name: Strong Upgrade
50112.text: Each Adaptoid gets +1 ATK, gains toughness, and gains the [[Brute]] trait.

50113.Name: Adaptoid
50113.text:
[star] (Check [[Adaptoid]] environments for modifiers to these values.) When Defeated: Remove 1 all-purpose counter from an environment.
[star] Boost: After this activation, shuffle Adaptoid into the encounter deck.

50114.Name: Automated Mobile Unit
50114.text: Attach to M.O.D.O.K. M.O.D.O.K. gets +5 hit points. Forced Response: After M.O.D.O.K.'s hit points are reset, discard this card.

50115.Name: Focusing Crystal
50115.text: Attach to M.O.D.O.K. Forced Response: After M.O.D.O.K.'s hit points are reset, discard this card.

50116.Name: Nanobots
50116.text: Attach to M.O.D.O.K. [star] Forced Response: After M.O.D.O.K. activates, heal 1 damage from him. Forced Response: After M.O.D.O.K.'s hit points are reset, discard this card.

50117.Name: Psionic Force Field
50117.text:
Attach to M.O.D.O.K. Attached enemy gains stalwart. Forced Interrupt: When attached enemy would take any amount of damage, place it here instead. Then, if there is at least 5 damage here, discard this card.
[star] Boost: Attach this card to the activating enemy.

50118.Name: Psionic Machetes
50118.text:
Attach to M.O.D.O.K. [star] M.O.D.O.K.'s attacks gain piercing. Forced Response: After M.O.D.O.K.'s hit points are reset, discard this card.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, it gains piercing.

50119.Name: Reverse Engineering
50119.text: Attach to M.O.D.O.K. [star] X is equal to the printed cost of the card tucked here. When Revealed: Tuck an upgrade you control under here. Otherwise, tuck the top card of your deck under here. Forced Response: After M.O.D.O.K.'s hit points are reset, discard this card.

50120.Name: A.I.M. Jailer
50120.text: Guard. When Revealed: A.I.M. Jailer attacks the [[Rescued]] ally with the fewest remaining hit points. Otherwise, place 1 lock counter on a Holding Cell.

50121.Name: Hostage Situation
50121.text: M.O.D.O.K. cannot take damage. When Revealed: Attach 1 [[Rescued]] ally faceup here. Attached ally is under no player's control. (Attached ally is still in play.) When Defeated: The defeating player takes control of attached ally.

50122.Name: Psionic Enhancement
50122.text:
Hinder 1[per_hero].
[star] Boost: Give the activating enemy an additional boost card.

50123.Name: "It's Alive!"
50123.text: When Revealed: Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for an [[Adaptoid]] minion and reveals it. (Shuffle.) Deal each player who did not engage a minion this way a facedown encounter card.

50124.Name: Psionic Blast
50124.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): You are confused. M.O.D.O.K. schemes. When Revealed (Hero): Take X indirect damage, where X is M.O.D.O.K.'s SCH. Confuse each character that takes damage this way.

50125.Name: Scientist Supreme
50125.text: Victory -1. Villainous. Vulnerable. (Discard this character if it is stunned or confused.) [star] Scientist Supreme's attacks gain piercing and ranged.

50126.Name: Monica Rappaccini
50126.text: Victory -1. Villainous. Vulnerable. (Discard this character if it is stunned or confused.) While Scientist Supreme is in the victory display, Monica Rappaccini gains villainous.

50127.Name: Diplomatic Immunity
50127.text: When Revealed: Place 1 acceleration token here for each [[A.I.M.]] minion in the victory display.

50128.Name: Diplomatic Sanctions
50128.text:
Surge. When Revealed: Discard 1 card from your hand for each [[A.I.M.]] minion in the victory display.
[star] Boost: This card gains [boost] for each [[A.I.M.]] minion in the victory display.

50129a.Name: Citizen V
50129a.text: Citizen V cannot be defeated unless there are at least 1[per_hero] [[Thunderbolt]] minions in the victory display. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Citizen V would activate against you during step two of the villain phase, if you are engaged with a [[Thunderbolt]] minion, Citizen V does not activate and heals 4 damage instead.

50129b.Name: Citizen V
50129b.text: Citizen V cannot be defeated unless there are at least 1[per_hero] [[Thunderbolt]] minions in the victory display. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Citizen V would activate against you during step two of the villain phase, if you are engaged with a [[Thunderbolt]] minion, Citizen V does not activate and heals 6 damage instead.

50130a.Name: Apprehending Rogue Agents
50130a.text: Contents: Citizen V (A). (Citizen V (B) instead for expert mode.) Thunderbolts and Standard encounter sets. Setup: Choose 1 modular set, plus 1[per_hero] additional modular sets, each with an [[Elite]], [[Thunderbolt]] minion. Set each of those minions aside and shuffle the rest of their encounter sets into the encounter deck. Reveal the Justice, Like Lightning environment.

50130b.Name: Apprehending Rogue Agents
50130b.text: Each [[Thunderbolt]] minion gains guard. Forced Response: After a player attacks a [[Thunderbolt]] minion, that minion engages that player. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

50131a.Name: Justice, Like Lightning
50131a.text: When Revealed: Each player reveals a random set-aside [[Thunderbolt]] minion. Reveal and attach the remaining set-aside [[Thunderbolt]] minion faceup here. In expert mode, give each of these minions a tough status card. Flip this card.

50131b.Name: Thunderbolt Backup
50131b.text: (The minion attached here is in play and can be targeted by attacks and abilities.) Forced Interrupt: When the round ends, attach the [[Thunderbolt]] minion with the most damage here, swapping it with the minion already attached here, if any. Heal 1[per_hero] damage from attached minion. In expert mode, heal 1[per_hero] additional damage from that minion and give it a tough status card.

50132.Name: Citizen V's Sword
50132.text: When Revealed: Attach to Citizen V. He activates against you. Hero Response: After you attack and damage Citizen V, spend [physical] [physical] resources → discard this card.

50133.Name: Jolt
50133.text: Villainous. When Defeated: Place 3 threat on the main scheme. Hero Action: Exhaust your hero → place 1 parley counter on Jolt. If there are 3 or more parley counters here, remove Jolt from the game. (She is not defeated.)

50134.Name: Innocent Bystanders
50134.text: Uses (4 bystander counters). Forced Response: After you attack an enemy or an enemy attacks you, either spend 1 resource of any type or place 1 threat on the main scheme (2 threat instead in expert mode). Remove 1 bystander counter from here.

50135.Name: The Coming Storm
50135.text: When Revealed: Each player engages each minion engaged with the player clockwise from them.

50136.Name: Rumbling Thunder
50136.text: When Revealed: Each player engages each minion engaged with the player clockwise from them.

50137.Name: Down but Not Out
50137.text: When Revealed: Choose a random [[Thunderbolt]] minion from the victory display and reveal it. Place damage on that minion until it has 5 hit points remaining. Then, remove this card from the game. If no minion entered play this way, this card gains surge.

50138.Name: Tap In
50138.text: When Revealed: Engage the [[Thunderbolt]] minion with the least damage that is not engaged with you. That minion activates against you. If no minion activated this way, Citizen V activates against you.

50139.Name: Moonstone
50139.text: Villainous. Victory 1. [star] Forced Response: After Moonstone activates, give her a tough status card.

50140.Name: Rule the Skies
50140.text:
Each [[Aerial]] character gets +1 ATK.
[star] Boost: If the activating enemy has the [[Aerial]] trait, give it an additional boost card.

50141.Name: Gravitational Pull
50141.text:
When Revealed: Find Moonstone and reveal her. (If she is already in play, she engages you.) Moonstone activates against you. If no enemy activated this way, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: Exhaust a character you control.

50142.Name: Psychological Manipulation
50142.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Discard an ally or support you control. Otherwise, this card gains surge. When Revealed (Hero): Deal X damage to the friendly character with the fewest remaining hit points, where X is equal to your hero's ATK.

50143.Name: Songbird
50143.text: Villainous. Victory 1. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Songbird activates, give her 1 additional boost card for this activation.

50144.Name: Solid Sound Constructs
50144.text: Attach to Songbird. Otherwise, attach to the villain. Attached enemy loses stalwart. Forced Interrupt: When attached enemy would gain a confused or stunned status card, discard this card instead.

50145.Name: Hard Sound Bindings
50145.text:
Attach to your identity. Forced Interrupt: When you would attack, discard Hard Sound Bindings instead. Then, you are stunned.
[star] Boost: You are stunned. If you were already stunned, give the activating enemy an additional boost card.

50146.Name: Sonic Bubble
50146.text: Forced Interrupt: When any amount of damage would be dealt to an enemy, remove an equal amount of threat from here instead.

50147.Name: Hard Sound
50147.text:
When Revealed: Find Songbird and reveal her. (If she is already in play, she engages you.) Songbird activates against you. If no enemy activated this way, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: Give the activating enemy an additional boost card.

50148.Name: Black Widow
50148.text: Retaliate 1. Villainous. Victory 1. [star] Forced Response: After Black Widow schemes against you, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Handspring and attach it to her. (Shuffle.) Otherwise, you are confused.

50149.Name: Handspring
50149.text: Attach to Black Widow. Otherwise, attach to the villain. Forced Interrupt: When attached enemy would take damage from an attack, deal that damage to the attacking character instead. Discard this card.

50150.Name: Pride of the Red Room
50150.text: When Revealed: Place 1 additional threat here for each [[Preparation]] card in play.

50151.Name: Pale Little Spider
50151.text:
When Revealed: Find Black Widow and reveal her. (If she is already in play, she engages you.) Black Widow activates against you. If no enemy activated this way, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: You are confused. If you were already confused, place 1 threat on the main scheme.

50152.Name: Radioactive Man
50152.text: Villainous. Victory 1. [star] Forced Response: After Radioactive Man activates against you, deal 1 damage to each character you control.

50153.Name: Radiation Exposure
50153.text: Attach to your identity. [star] If attached identity has the [[Gamma]] trait, this attachment gives +1 ATK instead. Forced Response: After you recover, discard 1 card from your hand → discard this card.

50154.Name: Runaway Nuclear Reaction
50154.text: Forced Response: After Radioactive Man is dealt any amount of damage, place an equal amount of threat here. Then, if there is 10 or more threat here, deal 10 damage to each character and discard Runaway Nuclear Reaction.

50155.Name: Power of the Atom
50155.text:
When Revealed: Find Radioactive Man and reveal him. (If he is already in play, he engages you.) Radioactive Man activates against you. If no enemy activated this way, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: Take 2 indirect damage.

50156.Name: MACH-IV
50156.text:
Villainous. Victory 1.
[star] Each character without the [[Aerial]] trait cannot make basic defenses against MACH-IV's attacks.

50157.Name: Blasters
50157.text: Attach to MACH-IV. Otherwise, attach to the enemy with the highest ATK. [star] Attached enemy's attacks gain overkill and ranged. Hero Response: After you attack and damage attached enemy, spend [energy] [energy] resources → discard this card.

50158.Name: Heat-Seeking Missiles
50158.text: Attach to MACH-IV. Otherwise, attach to the villain. Uses (4 missile counters). [star] Forced Response: After attached enemy attacks you, remove 1 missile counter from here and take 2 indirect damage.

50159.Name: Aerial Dogfight
50159.text:
Hinder 2[per_hero].
Reduce the damage each [[Aerial]] character takes from each attack by 2 unless the attacker or attack has the [[Aerial]] trait, or the attack has ranged.

50160.Name: Supersonic
50160.text:
When Revealed: Find MACH-IV and reveal him. (If he is already in play, he engages you.) MACH-IV activates against you. If no enemy activated this way, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, it gains overkill and ranged.

50161.Name: Batroc
50161.text: Villainous. Victory 1. Forced Interrupt: When Batroc engages you, discard 1 card from your hand.

50162.Name: Coup de Foudre
50162.text: Forced Interrupt: When a minion engages a player, that player discards the top X cards of their deck, where X is the number of boost icons ([boost]) on that minion. Place 1 threat here for each printed [energy] resource discarded this way.

50163.Name: Batroc the Leaper
50163.text:
When Revealed: Find Batroc and reveal him. (If he is already in play, he engages you.) Batroc activates against you. If no enemy activated this way, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: Discard 1 card from your hand.

50164.Name: Parcours du Combattant
50164.text:
Surge. When Revealed: Each player engages each minion engaged with the player clockwise from them.
[star] Boost: After this attack resolves, engage a minion in play that is not engaged with you.

50165a.Name: Baron Zemo
50165a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Baron Zemo would be defeated, reset his hit points to 12 instead. Remove 3 secret counters from among [[Board Member]] environments.

50165b.Name: Baron Zemo
50165b.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Baron Zemo activates against you, either place 1 secret counter on a [[Board Member]] card or give Baron Zemo an additional boost card for this activation.

50166a.Name: Baron Zemo
50166a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Baron Zemo would be defeated, reset his hit points to 16 instead. Remove 3 secret counters from among [[Board Member]] environments.

50166b.Name: Baron Zemo
50166b.text: Steady. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Baron Zemo activates against you, either place 2 secret counters on a [[Board Member]] card or give Baron Zemo an additional boost card for this activation.

50167a.Name: Zemo's Manipulations
50167a.text: Contents: Baron Zemo (A1). (Baron Zemo (B1) instead for expert mode.) Baron Zemo, S.H.I.E.L.D. Executive Board, Executive Board Evidence, and Standard encounter sets. Two modular encounter sets (Scientist Supreme and S.H.I.E.L.D.). Setup: Prepare the evidence (see rulebook p. 18). Put each [[Board Member]] environment into play. If not playing campaign mode, place 2 secret counters on each [[Board Member]] environment.

50167b.Name: Zemo's Manipulations
50167b.text: Response: After the player phase ends, the first player may place 2 secret counters on a [[Board Member]] environment that has no secret counters on it to gain 2 cards from the S.H.I.E.L.D. envelope (1 card instead in campaign mode). The players may advance to stage 2A to make their accusation. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

50168a.Name: The Accusation
50168a.text: When Revealed: Make an accusation by guessing a means, a motive, and an opportunity, along with the board member associated with that combination in the campaign log. This board member is the accused. (See "The Accusation" on p. 19 of the rulebook.)

50168b.Name: The Accusation
50168b.text: When Revealed: Do the following: 1. Use the cards in the A.I.M. envelope to identify the mole. 2. For each guess you got wrong, place 1 secret counter on each [[Board Member]] card. 3. If you accused the wrong board member, place 3 secret counters on the accused. 4. Advance to stage 3A.

50169a.Name: Fighting Zemo
50169a.text: When Revealed: Flip Baron Zemo to his [[Unmasked]] side and reset his hit points to his printed hit point value. Find Baron Zemo's Sword and attach it to him.

50169b.Name: Fighting Zemo
50169b.text: When Revealed: Flip the mole to its attachment side and attach it to Baron Zemo. Place 1[per_hero] threat here for each secret counter on each [[Board Member]] attachment. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

50170.Name: Baron Zemo's Sword
50170.text: Attach to Baron Zemo. [star] Forced Response: After Baron Zemo attacks and defeats a character, place 1 secret counter on the [[Board Member]] environment with the fewest secret counters. Hero Action: Spend [physical] [physical] [physical] or [energy] [energy] [energy] resources → remove 1 secret counter from a [[Board Member]] environment and discard this card.

50171.Name: Reluctant Foe
50171.text: Treat attached hero as an [[Elite]] minion with SCH equal to its printed THW. Replace its printed text box with: "Villainous. When Defeated: Remove this hero and Reluctant Foe from the game." When Revealed: Search your collection for a hero whose title does not match a character in play and put it into play engaged with you. Attach this card to it.

50172.Name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent
50172.text: Quickstrike. Vulnerable. [star] Forced Interrupt: When S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent activates or is defeated, add 1 secret counter to the [[Board Member]] environment with the fewest secret counters.

50173.Name: Divided Loyalties
50173.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. As an additional cost for a player to attack, thwart, or defend with an ally, that player must spend 1 resource of any type. When Defeated: Remove 1[per_hero] secret counters from among [[Board Member]] environments.

50174.Name: Undermine Support
50174.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. As an additional cost for a player to ready a support, that player must spend 1 resource of any type. When Defeated: Remove 1[per_hero] secret counters from among [[Board Member]] environments.

50175.Name: Battle of Wits
50175.text: When Revealed: Baron Zemo schemes. If this activation would place any threat on the main scheme, you may spend X [mental] resources to prevent X of that threat and remove X secret counters from among [[Board Member]] environments.

50176.Name: Might Makes Right
50176.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Place 2 secret counters on the [[Board Member]] environment with the fewest secret counters. When Revealed (Hero): Baron Zemo attacks you. If no character takes damage from this attack, remove 3 secret counters from among [[Board Member]] environments.

50177.Name: The Ends Justify the Means
50177.text: When Revealed: Choose: • Baron Zemo defeats the minion with the fewest remaining hit points. Baron Zemo schemes. • Discard an ally or support you control → remove secret counters from among [[Board Member]] environments equal to the discarded card's printed resource cost.

50178.Name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Trooper
50178.text: Patrol. Vulnerable. When Defeated: The engaged player discards 1 [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] ally or support they control. Otherwise, place 2 threat on the main scheme.

50179.Name: Arrest Warrant
50179.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust your identity or 1 [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] card you control → search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] minion and reveal it. (Shuffle.) Discard this card.

50180.Name: Disavowed
50180.text: Increase the resource cost to play each [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] card by 1. When Revealed: Place 1 threat here for each [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] card in play.

50181a.Name: Chief Medical Officer
50181a.text: Setup. If there are 4 or more secret counters here (3 or more instead in expert mode), flip this card. Hero Action: Spend [energy] [energy] resources → remove 1 secret counter from here. Then, heal 1 damage from a friendly character.

50181b.Name: Medical Officer's Aid
50181b.text: Attach to the villain. Permanent. Forced Response: After a secret counter is placed here, either heal 2 damage from the villain or deal 1 damage to the friendly character with the fewest remaining hit points. If there are 3 [[Board Member]] attachments in play, the players lose the game.

50182a.Name: Chief Surveillance Officer
50182a.text: Setup. If there are 4 or more secret counters here (3 or more instead in expert mode), flip this card. Hero Action: Spend [mental] [mental] resources → remove 1 secret counter from here. Then, remove 2 threat from a scheme.

50182b.Name: Surveillance Officer's Aid
50182b.text: Attach to the villain. Permanent. Forced Response: After a secret counter is placed here, place 2 threat on the main scheme. If there are 3 [[Board Member]] attachments in play, the players lose the game.

50183a.Name: Chief Tactical Officer
50183a.text: Setup. If there are 4 or more secret counters here (3 or more instead in expert mode), flip this card. Hero Action: Spend [physical] [physical] resources → remove 1 secret counter from here. Then, deal 2 damage to an enemy.

50183b.Name: Tactical Officer's Aid
50183b.text: Attach to the villain. Permanent. Forced Response: After a secret counter is placed here, deal 2 damage to a friendly character. If there are 3 [[Board Member]] attachments in play, the players lose the game.

50184a.Name: A.I.M. Interference ([energy])
50184a.text:
Incite 1. When Revealed: Place 1 secret counter on each [[Board Member]] card. You may spend X [energy] resources to prevent X of these counters from being placed.
[star] Boost: Resolve this card's "When Revealed" ability.

50184b.Name: A.I.M. Interference ([mental])
50184b.text:
Incite 1. When Revealed: Place 1 secret counter on each [[Board Member]] card. You may spend X [mental] resources to prevent X of these counters from being placed.
[star] Boost: Resolve this card's "When Revealed" ability.

50184c.Name: A.I.M. Interference ([physical])
50184c.text:
Incite 1. When Revealed: Place 1 secret counter on each [[Board Member]] card. You may spend X [physical] resources to prevent X of these counters from being placed.
[star] Boost: Resolve this card's "When Revealed" ability.

50185.Name: Medical Records
50185.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Protection ally and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for a Protection ally and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

50186.Name: Wiretap
50186.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Justice ally and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for a Justice ally and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

50187.Name: Security Scanner
50187.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Aggression ally and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for an Aggression ally and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

50188.Name: Money
50188.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Protection upgrade and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for a Protection upgrade and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

50189.Name: Blackmail
50189.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Justice upgrade and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for a Justice upgrade and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

50190.Name: Ideology
50190.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Aggression upgrade and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for an Aggression upgrade and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

50191.Name: Security Clearance
50191.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Protection support and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for a Protection support and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

50192.Name: Travel
50192.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Justice support and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for a Justice support and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

50193.Name: Authority
50193.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Aggresion support and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for an Aggresion support and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

60301.Name: Gorgon
60301.text: Forced Response: After Gorgon takes damage from an attack, discard 1 card from the encounter deck. If a [[hand]] minion is discarded this way, put that minion into play engaged with you. (Limit once per phase per player.) "I am the Gorgon.”

60302.Name: Gorgon
60302.text: Forced Response: After Gorgon takes damage from an attack, discard 2 cards from the encounter deck. Each time a [[hand ]]minion is discarded this way, put that minion into play engaged with you. (limit once per phase per player.) "I am the Gorgon.”

60303.Name: Gorgon
60303.text: Forced Response: After Gorgon takes damage from an attack, discard 3 cards from the encounter deck. Each time a [[hand]] minion is discarded this way, put that minion into play engaged with you. (limite once per phase per player.) "I am the Gorgon.”

60304a.Name: Madripoor is burning
60304a.text: A lot of riots takes place in Madripoor. Contents: Gorgon (I) and Gorgon (II). (Gorgon (II) and Gorgon (III) instead for expert mode.) Madripoor's Dragon and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (recommended: Streets of Mayhem). Setup: Put a Hand Soldier minion into play engaged with each player. Shuffle the encounter deck. Advance to stage 1B.

60304b.Name: Madripoor is burning
60304b.text: It seems almost impossible to contain those riots. The Hand is everywhere. Forced Response: After a [[hand]] minion is defeated, place 1 threat on Madripoor is Burning

60305a.Name: Attack on Hong Kong
60305a.text: The dragon if flying toward Hong Kong. What is the target of the hand? When Revealed: Advance to stage 2B.

60305b.Name: Attack on Hong Kong
60305b.text: Each [[hand]] minion gains quickstrike. Forced Interrupt: When the villain phase ends, the first player must choose: Deal 1 indirect damage to the first player or place 1 threat on the main scheme. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

60306.Name: Gorgon Katana
60306.text: Attach to the villain. [star] Attached villain's attacks gain piercing. Hero Action: Spend [physical][physical][physical] resources → discard this card.

60307.Name: Trance
60307.text: Attach to the villain. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Gorgon schemes, give him 1 additional boost card for that activation. Hero Action: Spend [mental][mental][mental] resources → discard this card.

60313.Name: Mounted Dragon
60313.text: Guard. [star] Forced Response: After Mounted Dragon attacks you, discard 1 card from the top of the encounter deck. If a [[hand]] minion is discarded this way, put that minion into play engaged with you.

60316.Name: The Circle
60316.text: The Circle is under attack. Everyone is going to defend it. When Revealed: Each player must choose: Find an ally and put it facedown under The Circle or exhaust your identity. When defeated: Each player chooses up to 2 cards in their discard pile and shuffle them into their deck. (Discard each card attached to the Circle)

60317.Name: Untold
60317.text: They are everywhere. Hinder 2[per_hero]. When Revealed: The first player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[hand]] minion and puts it into play engaged with them. Shuffle the encounter deck. [hazard]

60320.Name: Ambush
60320.text: When Revealed: Discard an ally or a [[persona ]]support you control. If no cards were discarded this way, this card gains surge. —————————————————— [star] Boost: Exhaust an ally or a [[persona]] support you control.

60322.Name: Duel
60322.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Flip to hero form. The villain attacks you with +1 ATK. Do not give the villain a boost card for this activation. When Revealed (hero): The villain attacks you. Other characters cannot defend against this attack.

60324.Name: Hand Reinforcement
60324.text: When Revealed: Discard 3 cards from the top of the encounter deck. Each time a [[hand]] minion is discarded this way, put that minion into play engaged with you.

08001a.Name: Black Widow
08001a.text: "Faiseuse de veuves" — Réponse : après avoir déclenché la capacité d'une carte [[Préparation]] que vous contrôlez, infligez 1 dégât à un ennemi.

08001b.Name: Natasha Romanoff
08001b.text: Préparatifs de mission — Réponse : après avoir joué une carte [[Préparation]], piochez 1 carte. (Limite d'une fois par phase.)

08002.Name: Le Soldat de l'Hiver
08002.text: Réduisez de 1 le coût pour jouer le Soldat de l'Hiver pour chaque carte [[Préparation]] que vous contrôlez.

08003.Name: Opération Secrète
08003.text: Action (contre) : retirez 4 menaces d'une manigance. Désorientez le méchant.

08004.Name: Danse de la Mort
08004.text: Action de héros : Effectuez les 3 attaques suivantes dans l'ordre: - Infligez 1 dégât à un ennemi. - Infligez 2 dégâts à un ennemi. - Infligez 3 dégâts à un ennemi.

08005.Name: Refuge #29
08005.text: Action d'alter-ego : inclinez le réfuge #29 et choisissez une carte [[Préparation]] dans votre pile de défausse → ajoutez à votre main la carte choisie.

08006.Name: Attaque Acrobatique
08006.text: Interruption de Héros (attaque) : quand une carte de boost est retournée face visible, défaussez Attaque Acrobatique → annulez les icônes de boost de cette carte. Infligez 1 dégât au méchant pour chaque icône de boost ainsi annulée.

08007.Name: Bracelet de Black Widow
08007.text: Ressource : inclinez le Bracelet de Black Widow → générez une ressource [wild] pour une carte [[Préparation]].

08008.Name: Grappin
08008.text: Interruption de Héros : quand vous révélez une carte traîtrise, défaussez le grappin → annulez les effets de cette traîtrise et défaussez là.

08009.Name: Costume Synthétique
08009.text: Black Widow gagne +1 DEF. Réponse de héros : après avoir déclenché la capacité d'une carte [[Préparation]] que vous contrôlez, inclinez le Costume Synthétique → redressez Black Widow.

08010.Name: Morsure de la Veuve
08010.text: Réponse de Héros (attaque) : après qu'un sbire est entré en jeu, défaussez la Morsure de la Veuve → infligez 2 dégâts à ce sbire et sonnez le.

08011.Name: Agent Coulson
08011.text: Réponse: après que l'Agent Coulson est entré en jeu, cherchez une carte [[Préparation]] dans votre deck ou votre pile de défausse et ajoutez-la à votre main. Mélangez votre deck.

08012.Name: Quake
08012.text: Réponse : après qu'un sbire a manigancé, inclinez Quake → infligez 2 dégâts à ce sbire.

08013.Name: Frappe furtive
08013.text: Action de Héros (attaque) : Infligez 4 dégâts à un ennemi. Si cet ennemi est vaincu par cette attaque, retierez 2 menaces d'une manigance.

08017.Name: Contre-Espionnage
08017.text: 1 max par joueur. Interruption : quand n'importe quelle quantité de menaces est censée être placée sur la manigance principale, défaussez Contre-Espionnage → prévénez 3 de ces menaces.

08018.Name: Technique d'Espion
08018.text: Jouez cette carte uniquement si vous contrôlez un personnage [[Espion]]. Interruption : quand vous révélez une carte Rencontre, défaussez Technique d'Espion → annulez les effets de cette carte et défaussez-la. Ensuite, révélez une autre carte du deck Rencontre.

08023.Name: Quinporteur
08023.text: Jouez cette carte uniquement si votre identité a le trait [[Avenger]]. Ressource : inclinez le Quinporteur → générez une ressource [wild].

08024.Name: Cible Verrouillée
08024.text: 1 max par joueur. Réponse de Héros : après qu'une carte de Boost a été retournée face visible, défaussez Cible Vérrouillée → annulez la capacité de Boost de cette carte.

08030.Name: Contre-Attaque
08030.text: 1 max par joueur. Réponse de Héros (attaque) : après que vous avez subi des dégâts d'une attaque ennemie, défaussez Contre-Attaque → infligez une quantité égale de dégâts à cet ennemi.

08031.Name: Réponse Immédiate
08031.text: 1 max par joueur. Réponse de Héros : après qu'un allié que vous contrôlez a été vaincu, défaussez Réponse Immédiate → mettez en jeu cet allié depuis votre pile de défaussez et infligez-lui 1 de dégât.

08032.Name: Posture Défensive
08032.text: 1 max par joueur. Interruption de Héros : quand vous êtes censé subir quelle quantité de dégâts, défaussez Posture Défensive → prévénez 3 de ces dégâts.

08033.Name: Espionnage
08033.text: Jouez cette carte uniquement si vous contrôlez un personnage [[Espion]]. Interruption : quand le mot-clé Renfort d'une carte Rencontre est censé être résolu, défaussez Espionnage → piocheez 2 cartes.

08025.Name: Désaveu Officiel
08025.text: Donnez cette carte au joueur de Natasha Romanoff Vous pouvez passer sous forme d'alter ego. Choississez: • Inclinez Natasha Romanoff → retirez Désaveu Officiel de la partie. • Défaussez la carte [[Preparation]] que vous contrôlez ayant le coût le plus élévé. Si vous ne pouvez pas, cette obligation gagne Renfort. Défaussez cette obligation.

08026.Name: Taskmaster
08026.text:
[star] Taskmaster gagne +1 MNG et +1 ATQ pour chaque amélioration que vous contrôlez. (Sbire Némésis de Black Widow.)
[star] Boost: pour cette activation, le méchant gagne +1 MNG et +1 ATQ pour chaque amélioration que vous contrôlez.

08027.Name: Tueur à Louer
08027.text: Une fois révélée : placez 1[per_hero] menace supplémentaire sur cette carte.

08028.Name: Mercenaire d'Hydra
08028.text: Garde. (Tant que ce sbire est engagé avec vous, vous ne pouvez pas attaquer le méchant.)

08029.Name: Tir Mortel
08029.text: Une fois révélée (Alter-Ego) : défaussez une amélioration que vous contrôlez et placez 1 menace sur la manigance principale. Une fois révélée (Héros) : défaussez une amélioration que vous contrôlez et subissez 1 dégât.

51001a.Name: Black Panther
51001a.text: [star] Response: After Black Panther uses a basic power, resolve the "Special" ability on 1 [[Black Panther]] upgrade you control.

51001b.Name: Shuri
51001b.text: Inventor — Action: Exhaust Shuri → search your deck for a [[Black Panther]] or [[Tech]] upgrade and play it, reducing its resource cost by 2. (Limit once per round.)

51002.Name: T'Challa
51002.text: [star] Hero Response: After T'Challa uses a basic power, resolve the "Special" ability on 1 [[Black Panther]] upgrade you control.

51003.Name: Clawed Strike
51003.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. Resolve the "Special" ability on 1 [[Black Panther]] upgrade you control.

51004.Name: On the Prowl
51004.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Resolve the "Special" ability on 1 [[Black Panther]] upgrade you control.

51005.Name: Wakanda Forever!
51005.text: Hero Action: Resolve the "Special" ability on each [[Black Panther]] upgrade you control in any order.

51007.Name: The Elephant's Trunk
51007.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust The Elephant's Trunk and up to 2 other [[Wakanda]] allies and/or supports you control → draw 1 card for each card exhausted this way (including this one).

51008.Name: Queen Ramonda
51008.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Queen Ramonda → heal damage from an alter-ego with the [[Wakanda]] trait equal to that alter-ego's REC.

51009.Name: Aja-Adanna
51009.text: Action: Exhaust Aja-Adanna → shuffle 1 identity-specific card from your discard pile into your deck.

51010.Name: Kimoyo Beads
51010.text: Special (thwart): Remove 1 threat from a scheme. You may discard this card to confuse an enemy.

51011.Name: Panther Claws
51011.text: Special (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. You may discard this card to deal 3 additional damage to that enemy. If you do, this attack gains piercing.

51012.Name: Spider Bites
51012.text: Special: Choose a player. Deal 1 damage to the villain and each minion engaged with that player. You may discard this card to stun each of those enemies.

51013.Name: Vibranium Suit
51013.text: Special (attack): Move 1 damage from your hero to an enemy. You may discard this card to give your hero a tough status card.

51014.Name: Manifold
51014.text: Response: After Manifold enters play, choose a player. That player searches their deck and discard pile for a player side scheme and adds it to their hand.

51015.Name: Infiltration
51015.text: Hero Action (thwart): Choose a number from 1 to 5. Discard that many cards from the top of the encounter deck → remote 1 threat from a scheme for each card discarded this way. Put 1 minion discarded this way into play engaged with you.

51016.Name: Going Undercover
51016.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: The defeating player looks at the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. They may add 1 non-scenario-specific card from among those to the victory display, then place the rest on the top and/or bottom of the encounter deck in any order.

51017.Name: Show of Empathy
51017.text: Victory 0. Forced Interrupt: When threat is removed from this scheme, place that threat on a non-[[Elite]] minion. If that minion has threat on it equal to or greater than its remaining hit points, add Show of Empathy to the victory display and attach 1 set-aside copy of Redemption to that minion.

51018.Name: The Raft
51018.text: Response: After a minion leaves play, tuck it under here from the encounter discard pile → remove threat from a scheme equal to the tucked minion's printed SCH. If there are at least 4 minions here, deal 1 random minion here to any player as a facedown encounter card.

51019.Name: Invisibility Gear
51019.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player. Interrupt: When an enemy would attack you, discard Invisibility Gear → that enemy schemes instead.

51021.Name: Sting Operation
51021.text: Max 1 per player. Response: After a non-[[Elite]] minion schemes, discard Sting Operation → discard that minion.

51022.Name: Aneka
51022.text: [star] Response: After Aneka uses a basic power, resolve the "Special" ability on another [[Dora Milaje]] ally. Special: Remove 1 threat from a scheme.

51023.Name: Ayo
51023.text: [star] Response: After Ayo uses a basic power, resolve the "Special" ability on another [[Dora Milaje]] ally. Special: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.

51024.Name: Okoye
51024.text: [star] Response: After Okoye uses a basic power, resolve the "Special" ability on another [[Dora Milaje]] ally. Special: Choose a [[Wakanda]] hero or ally. They get +1 THW and +1 ATK until the end of the phase.

51025.Name: Heart of the Panther
51025.text: Team-Up (Black Panther/T'Challa and Black Panther/Shuri). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Search your deck and discard pile for a [[Black Panther]] upgrade and put it into play. Resolve the "Special" ability on up to 4 [[Black Panther]] upgrades you control in any order.

51030.Name: Dora Milaje
51030.text: Ignore this card's resource cost if your identity has the [[Wakanda]] trait. Action: Exhaust Dora Milaje → resolve the "Special" ability on 1 [[Dora Milaje]] ally and heal 1 damage from that ally.

51036.Name: Redemption
51036.text:
Linked (Show of Empathy). Victory 0.
Take control of attached minion and treat it as a [[Redeemed]] ally with a blank text box. Its THW is equal to its printed SCH and it takes 1 consequential damage after it thwarts or attacks.

51037.Name: White Wolf
51037.text: [star] Forced Response: After White Wolf attacks, place 1 threat on the main scheme.

51038.Name: Target Spotter
51038.text: Uses (2 target counters). Interrupt: When a minion would engage a player, remove 1 target counter from here → that minion cannot activate until the end of the phase. Engage that minion.

51032.Name: Klaw
51032.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Klaw attacks, give him 1 boost card for this activation. (Black Panther's nemesis minion.)

51033.Name: Manipulated M.U.S.I.C.
51033.text: When Revealed: Find M.U.S.I.C. and put her into play engaged with you. When Defeated: Discard M.U.S.I.C. from play.

51034.Name: M.U.S.I.C.
51034.text: When Revealed: Find Manipulated M.U.S.I.C. and put it into play. When Defeated: Move all threat from Manipulated M.U.S.I.C. to the main scheme.

51039.Name: Joystick
51039.text: Villainous. Victory 1. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Joystick activates against you, choose: • Give her 1 additional boost card for this activation and draw 1 card. • Give her a tough status card.

51041.Name: Playing for Keeps
51041.text: Each identity gets +1 hand size. Forced Interrupt: When an enemy activates, give it 1 boost card for that activation (in addition to any other boost cards it gets).

51042.Name: Extreme Risk
51042.text:
When Revealed: Find Joystick and reveal her. (If she is already in play, she engages you.) Joystick activates against you. If no enemy activated this way, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: You may give the activating enemy an additional boost card. If you do, draw 1 card.

03001a.Name: Captain America
03001a.text: "Je peux faire ça toute la journée !" — Action : défaussez une carte de votre main → redressez Captain America. (Limite d'une fois par round.)

03001b.Name: Steve Rogers
03001b.text: Légende vivante — Réduisez de 1 le coût du premier allié joué à chaque round. Mise en place : cherchez l'amélioration Bouclier de Captain America dans votre deck ou votre pile de défausse et ajoutez-la à votre main. Mélangez votre deck.

03002.Name: Agent 13
03002.text: Réponse : après que l'Agent 13 est entrée en jeu, retirez 2 menaces d'une manigance.

03003.Name: Détermination sans faille
03003.text: Action de héros : Captain America gagne +1 CTR jusqu'à la fin de la phase. Piochez 1 carte.

03004.Name: Frappe héroïque
03004.text: Action de héros (attaque) : infligez 6 dégâts à un ennemi. Si vos avez utilisé une ressource [physical] pour payer cette carte, sonnez cet ennemi.

03005.Name: Parade au bouclier
03005.text: Interruption (défense) : quand vous êtes censé subir n'importe quelle quantité de dégâts, inclinez le Bouclier de Captain America → prévenez tous ces dégâts.

03006.Name: Lancer de bouclier
03006.text: Action de héros (attaque) : Défaussez X cartes de votre main, ensuite, renvoyez dans votre main le Bouclier de Captain America qui est en jeu → infligez 4 dégâts à X ennemis.

03007.Name: Appartement de Steve
03007.text: Action d'alter ego : inclinez l'Appartement de Steve → piochez 1 carte et soignez 1 dégâts de Steve Rogers.

03008.Name: Casque de Captain America
03008.text: Interruption : quand Captain America est censé être vaincu, fixez son compteur de points de vie à 1 à la place. Ensuite, défaussez cette carte.

03009.Name: Bouclier de Captain America
03009.text: Restreint. (2 cartes restreintes max par joueur.) Captain America gagne +1 DEF et Riposte 1.

03010.Name: Sérum de Super-soldat
03010.text: Ressource : inclinez le Sérum de Super-Soldat → générez une ressource [physical].

03011.Name: Le Faucon
03011.text: Réponse : après que Le Faucon est entré en jeu, regardez les 3 cartes du dessus du deck de Rencontre. Pour chaque traîtrise ainsi regardée, retirez 1 menace d'une manigance.

03013.Name: Squirrel Girl
03013.text: Réponse : après que Squirrel Girl est entrée en jeu, infligez 1 dégâts à chaque ennemi.

03014.Name: Wonder Man
03014.text: [star] En tant que coût supplémentaire pour que Wonder Man attaque, vous devez défausser 1 carte de votre main.

03015.Name: Avengers, rassemblement
03015.text: 1 max par round. Action de héros : redressez chaque personnage [[Avenger]] que vous contrôlez. Jusqu'à la fin de la phase, chaque personnage [[Avenger]] en jeu gagne +1 CTR et +1 ATQ.

03017.Name: La Force du Nombre
03017.text: Action : inclinez n'importe quel nombre d'alliés que vous contrôlez → piochez 1 carte pour chaque allié ainsi incliné.

03019.Name: Quinjet
03019.text: Réponse : après le début de votre tour, placez 1 jeton Temps sur le Quinjet. Action : mettez en jeu un allié [[Avenger]] de votre main, dont le coût imprimé est inférieur ou égal au nombre de jetons Temps sur le Quinjet. Ensuite, défaussez le Quinjet.

03024.Name: Tour des Avengers
03024.text: Si chacun de vos alliés a le trait [[Avenger]], augmentez de 1 votre limite d'alliés. Action : inclinez la Tour des Avengers → réduisez de 1 le coût du prochain allié [[Avenger]] joué à cette phase.

03025.Name: Membre Honoraire des Avengers
03025.text:
Jouez cette carte uniquement si votre identité a le trait [[Avenger]].
Attachez cette carte à un personnage ami.
Le personnage attaché gagne +1 point de vie et le trait [[Avenger]].

03031.Name: Enragé
03031.text:
Attachez cette carte à un allié.
1 max par allié.
L'allié attaché gagne +2 ATQ et subit +1 dégât consécutif après avoir attaqué.

03032.Name: Pris en Filature
03032.text: Attachez cette carte à une manigance annexe. 1 max par manigance. Interruption : quand la manigance attachée est déjouée, infligez 4 dégâts à un ennemi.

03033.Name: Defense experte
03033.text: Interruption de héros (défense) : quand votre héros défend contre une attaque, il gagne +3 DEF pour cette attaque.

03034.Name: Vigilance Accrue
03034.text: Utilisation (3 jetons Mental). Ressource de héros : retirez 1 jeton Mental de Vigilance Accrue et inclinez-la → générez une ressource [mental].

03026.Name: Homme d'une Autre Époque
03026.text: Donnez cette carte au joueur de Steve Rogers. Vous pouvez passer sous forme d'alter ego. Choisissez: • Inclinez Steve Rogers → retirez Homme d'une Autre Époque de la partie. • Défaussez la moitié des cartes de votre main, arrondie à l'inférieur. Défaussez cette obligation.

03027.Name: Commando Armé
03027.text: Une fois révélé : dans l'ordre des joueurs, chaque joueur défausse la carte du dessus du deck de Rencontre et subit 1 dégâts pour chaque icône de boost défaussée par cet effet.

03028.Name: Baron Zemo
03028.text: Coup Rapide. Tant que le Baron Zemo est engagé avec vous, vous ne pouvez pas contrer. (Sbire Némésis de Captain America)

03029.Name: Soldat d'Hydra
03029.text: Garde. (Tant que ce sbire est engagé avec vous, vous ne pouvez pas attaquer le méchant.) Une fois vaincu : attribuez une carte Rencontre au joueur engagé.

03030.Name: Hail Hydra !
03030.text: Une fois révélée : chaque sbire [[Hydra]] engagé avec un héros, attaque ce héros. Chaque joueur qui n'a pas été attaqué par cet effet cherche un sbire [[Hydra]] dans le deck de Rencontre et le met en jeu engagé avec lui. Mélangez le deck Rencontre s'il a été consulté.

01001a.Name: Spider-Man
01001a.text: Sens d'Araignée — Interruption : quand le méchant initie une attaque contre vous, piochez 1 carte.

01001b.Name: Peter Parker
01001b.text: Scientifique — Ressource : générez une ressource [mental]. (Limite d'une fois par round.)

01002.Name: Black Cat
01002.text: Réponse forcée : après que vous avez joué Black Cat, défaussez les 2 cartes du dessus de votre deck. Ajoutez à votre main chaque carte avec une ressource [mental] imprimée défaussée par cet effet.

01003.Name: Salto Arrière
01003.text: Interruption (défense) : quand vous êtes censé subir n'importe quelle quantité de dégâts d'une attaque, prévenez tous ces dégâts.

01004.Name: Sens d'Araignée Améliorés
01004.text: Interruption de héros : quand une carte Trarise est révélée du deck Rencontre, annulez ses effets "Une fois révélée".

01005.Name: Coup de pied en balancier
01005.text: Action de héros (attaque) : inflgez 8 dégâts à un ennemi.

01006.Name: Tante May
01006.text: Action d'alter ego : inclinez Tante May → heal 4 damage from Peter Parker.

01007.Name: Spider-Traceur
01007.text: Attachez cette carte à un sbire. Interruption forcée : quand le sbier atatché est vaincu, retirez 3 menaces d'une manigance.

01008.Name: Lance-toile
01008.text: Utilisations (3 jetons Toile). (Entre en jeu avec 3 jetons. Quand il n'y en a plus, défaussez cette carte) Ressource de héros : retirez 1 jeton Toile du Lance-Toile et inclinez → générez une ressource [wild].

01009.Name: Pris dans la Toile
01009.text: Sous forme de héros uniquement. Attachez cette carte à une ennemi. 1 max par ennemi.. Interruption forcée : quand l'ennemi attaché est censé attaquer, défaussez Pris dans la Toile à la place. Ensuite, sonnez cet ennemi.

01010a.Name: Captain Marvel
01010a.text: Recanaliser — Action : dépensez une ressource [energy] et soignez 1 dégât de Captain Marvel → piochez 1 carte. (Limite d'une fois par round.)

01010b.Name: Carol Danvers
01010b.text: Commandante — Action : choisissez un joueur qui pioche 1 carte. (Limite d'une fois par round.)

01011.Name: Spider-Woman
01011.text: Réponse : après que Spider-Woman est entrée en jeu, désorientez le méchant.

01012.Name: Empêcher les Conflits
01012.text: Action de héros (contre) : retirez 2 menaces d'une manigance. Ensuite, si vous avez le trait [[AÉRIEN]], retirez 2 menaces d'une autre manigance.

01013.Name: Rayon Photonique
01013.text: Action de héros (attaque) : infligez 5 dégâts à un ennemi. SI vous avez utilisé une ressource [energy] pour payer cette carte, piochez 1 carte.

01015.Name: Station Alpha Flight
01015.text: Action : inclinez la Station Alpha Flight, choisissez et défaussez 1 carte de votre main → piochez 1 carte (piochez 2 cartes si vous êtes Carol Danvers).

01016.Name: Casque de Captain Marvel
01016.text: Captain Marvel gagne +1 DEF (+2 DEF à la place si vous avez le trait [[AÉRIEN]]).

01017.Name: Vol Cosmique
01017.text: Captain Marvel gagne le trait [[AÉRIEN]]. Interruption de héros (défense) : quand Captain Marvel est censée subir des dégâts, défaussez Vol Cosmique → prévenez 3 de ces dégâts.

01018.Name: Énergie Canalisée
01018.text: 1 max par joueur. Action : dépensez X ressources [energy] → mettez X jetons Énergie sur cette carte. Action de héros (attaque) : défaussez Énergie Canalisée → infligez 2 dégâts par jeton Énergie sur cette carte à une ennemi (jusqu'à un maximum de 10 dégâts).

01019a.Name: Miss Hulk
01019a.text: "Tu fais de la muscu ?" — Réponse : après être passé sous cette forme, infligez 2 dégâts à un ennemi.

01019b.Name: Jennifer Walters
01019b.text: "Objection !" — Interruption : quand de la menace est censée être placée sur une manigance, prévenez 1 de ces menaces. (Limite d'une fois par round.)

01021.Name: Frappe Gamma
01021.text: Action de héros (attaque) : infligez X dégâts à un ennemi (jusqu'à un maximum de 15). X est la quantité de dégâts que vous avez subis.

01022.Name: Piétinement
01022.text: Action de héros : infligez 1 dégât à chaque ennemi.

01023.Name: Pratique de la Loi
01023.text: Action d'alter ego (contre) : choisissez et défaussez jusqu'à 5 cartes de votre main → retirez 1 menace d'une manigance pour chaque carte ainsi défaussée.

01024.Name: Droite-Gauche
01024.text: Réponse : après que vous avez effectué une attaque de base (en utilisant votre ATQ), redressez Miss Hulk.

01025.Name: Personnalité divisée
01025.text: Action : changez de forme (retournez votre carte Identité). Ensuite, piochez jusqu'à atteindre votre taille de main imprimée.

01026.Name: Département Judiciaire des Surhumains
01026.text: Action d'alter ego (contre) : inclinez le département Judiciaire des Surhumains et dépensez une ressource [mental] → retirez 2 menaces d'une manigance.

01027.Name: Rage contrôlée
01027.text: Action de héros : inclinez Rage Contrôlée et subissez 1 dégât → piochez 1 carte.

01028.Name: Force Surhumaine
01028.text: Miss Hulk gagne +2 ATQ. Réponse forcée : après que Miss Hulk a attaqué, défaussez Force Surhumaine → sonnez l'ennemi attaqué.

01029a.Name: Iron Man
01029a.text: Votre taille de main augmente de +1 pour chaque amélioration [[TECH]] que vous contrôlez (jusqu'à une taille de main maximale de 7).

01029b.Name: Tony Stark
01029b.text: Futuriste — Action : regardez les 3 cartes du dessus de votre deck. Ajoutez-en 1 à votre main et défaussez les autres. (Limite d'une fois par round.)

01030.Name: War Machine
01030.text: Action : inclinez War Machine et infligez-lui 2 dégâts → infligez 1 dégât à chaque ennemi.

01031.Name: Rayon répulsif
01031.text: Action de héros (attaque) : infligez 1 dégât à un ennemi et défaussez les 5 cartes du dessus de votre deck. Pour chaque ressource [energy] imprimée défaussée par cet effet, infligez 2 dégâts supplémentaires à cet ennemi.

01032.Name: Coup de poing Supersonique
01032.text: Action de héros (attaque) : infligez 4 dégâts à un ennemi (8 dégâts à la place si vous avez le trait [[AÉRIEN]]).

01033.Name: Pepper Potts
01033.text: Ressource : inclinez Pepper Potts → générez les ressources de la carte du dessus de votre pile de défausse.

01034.Name: Tour Stark
01034.text: Action d'alter ego : inclinez la Tour Stark → choisissez un joueur. Ce joueur renvoie dans sa main l'amélioration [[TECH]] la plus proche du dessus de sa pile de défausse.

01035.Name: Réacteur Arc
01035.text: Action de héros : inclinez le réacteur Arc → redressez Iron Man.

01037.Name: Casque Mark V
01037.text: Action de héros (contre) : inclinez le Casque mark V → retirez 1 menace d'une manigance (de chaque manigance à la place si vous avez le trait [[AÉRIEN]]).

01038.Name: Gantelets énergétiques
01038.text: Action de héros (attaque) : inclinez les Gantelets énergétiques → infligez 1 dégât à un ennemi (2 dégâts à la place si vous avez le trait [[AÉRIEN]]).

01039.Name: Bottes-Fusée
01039.text: Vous gagnez +1 point de vie. Action de héros : inclinez les Bottes-fusée et dépensez une ressource [mental] → vous gagnez le trait [[AÉRIEN]] jusqu'à la fin de la phase.

01040a.Name: Black Panther
01040a.text: Riposte 1. (Après que ce personnage a été attaqué, infligez 1 dégât au personnage attaquant.)

01040b.Name: T'Challa
01040b.text: Prévoyance — Mise en place : cherchez une amélioration [[BLACK PANTHER]] dans votre deck et ajoutez-la à votre main.

01041.Name: Shuri
01041.text: Réponse : après que Shuri est entrée en jeu, cherchez une amélioration dans votre deck et ajoutez-la à votre main. Mélangez votre deck.

01042.Name: Connaissance Ancestrale
01042.text: Action d'alter ego : choisissez jusqu'à 3 cartes différentes dans votre pile de défausse et mélangez-les dans votre deck.

01043a.Name: Wakanda Éternel !
01043a.text: Action de héros : résolvez la capacité "Spéciale" de chaque amélioration [[BLACK PANTHER]] que vous contrôlez, dans n'importe quel ordre. (La résolution de chaque capacité est une étape de cette séquence.)

01043b.Name: Wakanda Éternel !
01043b.text: Action de héros : résolvez la capacité "Spéciale" de chaque amélioration [[BLACK PANTHER]] que vous contrôlez, dans n'importe quel ordre. (La résolution de chaque capacité est une étape de cette séquence.)

01043c.Name: Wakanda Éternel !
01043c.text: Action de héros : résolvez la capacité "Spéciale" de chaque amélioration [[BLACK PANTHER]] que vous contrôlez, dans n'importe quel ordre. (La résolution de chaque capacité est une étape de cette séquence.)

01043d.Name: Wakanda Éternel !
01043d.text: Action de héros : résolvez la capacité "Spéciale" de chaque amélioration [[BLACK PANTHER]] que vous contrôlez, dans n'importe quel ordre. (La résolution de chaque capacité est une étape de cette séquence.)

01045.Name: La Cité Dorée
01045.text: Action d'alter ego : inclinez la Cité Dorée → piochez 2 cartes.

01046.Name: Dagues Énergétiques
01046.text: Spécial : choisissez un joueur. Infligez 1 dégât au méchant et à chaque ennemi engagée avec ce joueur (2 dégâts à la place s'il s'agit de la dernière étape de la séquence). (Jouez l'événement "Wakanda Éternel !" pour utiliser cette capacité.)

01047.Name: Griffes de Panthère
01047.text: Spécial (attaque) : infligez 2 dégâts à un ennemi (4 dégâts à la place s'il s'agit de la dernière étape de la séquence). (Jouez l'événement "Wakanda Éternel !" pour utiliser cette capacité.)

01048.Name: Génie tactique
01048.text: Spécial (contre) : retirez 1 menace d'une manigance (2 menaces à la place s'il s'agit de la dernière étape de la séquence. (Jouez l'événement "Wakanda Éternel !" pour utiliser cette capacité.)

01049.Name: Costume en Vibranium
01049.text: Spécial (attaque) : déplacez 1 dégât de votre héros vers un ennemi (2 dégâts à la place s'il s'agit de la dernière étape de la séquence). (Jouez l'événement "Wakanda Éternel !" pour utiliser cette capacité.)

01050.Name: Hulk
01050.text: Réponse forcée : après que Hulk a attaqué, défaussez la carte du dessus de votre deck. Si cette carte a comme ressource imprimée : [physical] - Infligez 2 dégâts à un ennemi. [energy] - Infligez 1 dégât à chaque personnage. [mental] - Défaussez Hulk. [wild] - Effectuez toutes les options ci-dessus.

01051.Name: Tigra
01051.text: Réponse : après que Tigra a attaqué et vaincu un sbire, soignez-la de 1.

01052.Name: Poursuivons-Les
01052.text: Réponse (contre) : après que votre héros a attaqué et vaincu un ennemi, retirez 2 menaces d'une manigance.

01053.Name: Assaut Implacable
01053.text: Action de héros (attaque) : infligez 5 dégâts à un sbire. Si vous avez utilisé une ressource [physical] pour payer cette carte, cette attaque gagne Déferlement. (Les dégâts excédentaires de cette attaque sont infligés au méchant.)

01054.Name: Uppercut
01054.text: Action de héros (attaque) : infligez 5 dégâts à un ennemi.

01055.Name: Le Pouvoir de l'Agressivité
01055.text: 2 max par deck. Doublez le nombre de ressources générées par cette carte lorsque vous jouez une carte Aggressivité (rouge).

01056.Name: Équipe Tactique
01056.text: Utilisations (3 jetons Attaque). (Entre en jeu avec 3 jetons. Quand il n'y en a plus, défaussez cette carte) Action : retirez 1 jeton Attaque de l'Équipe Tactique et inclinez-la → infligez 2 dégâts à un ennemi.

01057.Name: Entraînement au Combat
01057.text:
Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. 1 max par joueur.
Votre héros gagne +1 ATQ.

01059.Name: Jessica Jones
01059.text: Jessica Jones gagne +1 CTR pour chaque manigance annexe en jeu.

01058.Name: Daredevil
01058.text: Réponse : après que Daredevil a contré, infligez 1 dégât à un ennemi.

01060.Name: Pour la Justice !
01060.text: Action de héros (contre) : retirez 3 menaces d'une manigance (4 menaces à la place si vous avez utilisé une ressoure [mental] pour payer cette carte).

01061.Name: De Grandes Responsabilités
01061.text: Interruption de héros : quand n'importe quelle quantité de menaces est censée être placée sur une manigance, vous subissez une quantité égale de dégâts à la place.

01062.Name: Le Pouvoir de la Justice
01062.text: 2 max par deck. Doublez le nombre de ressources générées par cette carte lorsque vous jouez une carte Justice (jaune).

01063.Name: Salle d'Interrogatoire
01063.text: 1 max par joueur. Réponse : après que vous avez vaincu un sbire, inclinez la Salle d'Interrogatoire → retirez 1 menace d'une manigance.

01064.Name: Équipe de Surveillance
01064.text: Utilisations (3 jetons Mouchard). (Entre en jeu avec 3 jetons. Quand il n'y en a plus, défaussez cette carte.) Action : retirez 1 jeton Mouchard de l'Équipe de Surveillance et inclinez-la → retirez 1 menace d'une manigance.

01065.Name: Instinct Héroïque
01065.text:
Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. 1 max par joueur.
Votre héros gagne +1 CTR.

01066.Name: Hawkeye
01066.text: Hawkeye entre en jeu avec 4 jetons Flèche sur lui. Réponse : après qu'un sbire est entré en jeu, retirez 1 jeton Flèche de Hawkeye → infligez 2 dégâts à ce sbire.

01067.Name: Maria Hill
01067.text: Réponse : après que Maria Hill est entrée en jeu, chaque joueur pioche 1 carte.

01068.Name: Vision
01068.text: Action : dépensez une ressource [energy] → choisissez CTR ou ATQ. Jusqu'à la fin de la phase, Vision gagne +2 au pouvoir choisi. (Limite d'une fois par round.)

01070.Name: Commander en Première Ligne
01070.text: Action de héros : choisissez un joueur. Chaque personnage contrôlé par ce joueur gagne +1 CTR et +1 ATQ jusqu'à la fin de la phase.

01071.Name: Appel de détresse
01071.text: Action : payez le coût imprimé d'un allié qui se trouve dans la pile de défausse de n'importe quel joueur → mettez en jeu cet allié sous votre contrôle.

01072.Name: Le Pouvoir du Commandement
01072.text: 2 max par deck. Doublez le nombre de ressources générées par cette carte lorsque vous jouez une carte Commandement (bleu).

01073.Name: Le Triskelion
01073.text: Augmentez de 1 votre limite d'alliés. (Cela vous permet de contrôler plus de 3 alliés.)

01074.Name: Motivé
01074.text:
Attachez cette carte à un allié. 1 max par allié.
L'allié attaché gagne +1 CTR et +1 ATQ.

01075.Name: Black Widow
01075.text: Interruption : quand une carte est révélée du deck Rencontre, inclinez Black Widow et dépensez une ressource [mental] → annulez les effets de cette carte et défaussez-la. Ensuite, révélez une autre carte du deck Rencontre.

01076.Name: Luke Cage
01076.text: Tenacité. (Ce personnage entre en jeu avec une carte d'état Tenace.)

01077.Name: Contre-Attaque au Poing
01077.text: Réponse (attaque) : après que votre héros a défendu contre une attaque ennemie, infligez à cet ennemi des dégâts égaux à l'ATQ de votre héros.

01078.Name: Restez derrière moi !
01078.text: Interruption de héros : quand une carte Traîtrise est révélée du deck Rencontre, annulez ses effets "Une fois révélée". Le méchant vous attaque à la place.

01079.Name: Le Pouvoir de la Protection
01079.text: 2 max par deck. Doublez le nombre de ressources générées par cette carte lorsque vous jouez une carte Protection (verte).

01080.Name: Équipe Médicale
01080.text: Utilisations (3 jetons Soin). (Entre en jeu avec 3 jetons. Quand il n'y en a plus, défaussez cette carte) Action : retirez 1 jeton Soin de l'Équipe Médicale et inclinez-la → soignez 2 dégats d'un personnage ami.

01081.Name: Veste blindée
01081.text:
Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. 1 max par joueur.
Votre héros gagne +1 DEF.

01082.Name: Inébranlable
01082.text: Réponse : après que votre héros a défendu, défaussez Inébranlable → redressez votre héros.

01083.Name: Mockingbird
01083.text: Réponse : après que Mockingbird est entrée en jeu, sonnez un ennemi.

01084.Name: Nick Fury
01084.text: Réponse forcée : après que Nick Fury est entré en jeu, choisissez une option : retirez 2 menaces d'une manigance, piochez 3 cartes ou infligez 4 dégâts à un ennemi. À la fin du round, si Nick Fury est toujours en jeu, défaussez-le.

01085.Name: Urgence
01085.text: Interruption (contre) : quand le méchant manigance, diminuez de 1 la quantité de menaces placées sur la manigance.

01086.Name: Premiers Soins
01086.text: Action : soignez 2 dégâts de n'importe quel personnage.

01087.Name: Haymaker
01087.text: Action de héros (attaque) : infligez 3 dégâts à un ennemi.

01091.Name: Manoir des Avengers
01091.text: 1 max par joueur. Action : inclinez le Manoir des Avengers → choisissez un joueur. Ce joueur pioche 1 carte.

01092.Name: Héliporteur
01092.text: 1 max par joueur. Action : inclinez l'Héliporteur → choisissez un joueur. Réduisez de 1 le coût de la prochaine carte jouée par ce joueur à cette phase.

01093.Name: Persévérance
01093.text: Action de héros : dépensez une ressource [physical] et défaussez cette carte → redressez votre héros.

01095.Name: Rhino
01095.text: Une fois révélée : cherchez la manigance annexe Casser et Emporter dans le deck Rencontre ou la pile de défausse Rencontre et révélez-la. Mélangez le deck Rencontre.

01096.Name: Rhino
01096.text: Tenacité. (Ce personnage entre en jeu avec une carte d'état Tenace.) Une fois révélée : sonnez chaque héros.

01097a.Name: L'Effraction !
01097a.text: Contenu : Rhino (I) et Rhino (II). (Rhino (II) et Rhino (III) à la place en mode expert.) Les sets de rencontre Rhino et Standard. Un set de rencontre modulaire (recommandé : Alerte à la Bombe). Mise en place : avancez au stade 1B.

01097b.Name: L'Effraction !
01097b.text: Si ce stade est achevé, les joueurs perdent la partie.

01098.Name: Costume Blindé de Rhino
01098.text: Attachez cette carte à Rhino. Interruption forcée : quand n'importe quelle quantité de dégâts devrait être infligée à Rhino, placez ces dégâts sur cette carte à la place. Ensuite, s'il y a au moins 5 dégâts sur cette carte, défaussez-la.

01099.Name: Charge
01099.text: Attachez cette carte à Rhino. [star] Interruption forcée : quand Rhino attaque, son attaque gagne Déferlement. (Si un allié a défendu, les dégâts excédentaires de cette attaque sont infligés au contrôleur de cet allié.) À la fin de cette attaque, défaussez Charge.

01100.Name: Corne en Ivoire Renforcée
01100.text: Attachez cette carte à Rhino. Action de héros : dépensez les ressources suivantes : [physical] [physical] [physical] → défaussez cette carte.

01101.Name: Mercenaire d'Hydra
