60620.text: Peril. When Revealed: Choose to either place 1[per_hero] threat on a scheme or exhaust 1 character you control.

10326a.Name: Moon Knight
10326a.text: a good offense — Reduce the cost of Agression (red) cards you play by 1.

10326b.Name: Marc Spector
10326b.text: Setup: Marc Spector begins the game with an [[identity]] stack. You are always considered to be “the Marc Spector player”. To create the Identity Stack, take the Marc Spector card and put it into play as your starting alter-ego card. Then, take the remaining four of Moon Knight’s cards with the [[IDENTITY]] trait (Steven Grant, Jake Lockley, Mr. Knight, and Moon Knight), and set them in a facedown stack outside the play area. During the game, when you would usually flip your identity card to change form, choose any card from the Identity Stack to replace your active identity card with instead. Discard the active card you are changing from onto a special discard pile out of play that belongs to the Identity Stack, then put the desired identity card you have selected into play as your new active identity. You may not change your form to a card that is in this special discard pile. At the end of the player phase, place all cards in the special discard pile back into the Identity Stack. Cheap Shots — Use all aspects instead of one during deck building. You cannot include cards with printed cost of 3 or more, and must include at least 4 cards of each aspect.

10326c.Name: Mr. Knight
10326c.text: The best defense — Reduce the cost of Protection (green) cards you play by 1.

10326d.Name: Steven Grant

10326e.Name: Jake Lockley
10326e.text: Just 'Cause — Reduce the cost of Justice (yellow) cards you play by 1.

(limit once per round for each aspect) Action: Remove 3 madness counters from Different Strokes → ready your identity or change form. 10332.Name: Deck and Cover

10333.Name: Figth or Foil
10333.text: Choose one: Action (attack): Change form to Moon Knight → deal 2 damage to an enemy. Action (attack): Change form to Mr. Knight → remove 2 threat from a scheme. This card is both a Moon Knight card and a justice card).

10334.Name: Gear Up
10334.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you defend against an attack, you get +2 DEF and gain retaliate 2 until the of the round. After this attack is resolved, change your form. This card is both a Moon Knight card and a protection card).

10335.Name: Where 'd He Go
10335.text: Choose one: Action: Change to hero form → confuse an enemy. Action : Change to alter-ego form → stun an enemy. This card is both a Moon Knight card and a leadership card).

10337.Name: Seek Help
10337.text: Give to the Marc Spector player. You may flip to Marc Spector. Choose: . Discard Steven Grant and Jake Lockley from the [[IDENTITY]] stack → remove Seek Help from the game. . Take 2 indirect damage → discard this obligation.

10338.Name: Bushman

10339.text: Bushman is hellbent on defeating Marc Spector. Deescalate the situation quickly! Moon Knight and Mr. Knight get -1 ATK.

10341.text: Attach to Bushman, if able. If you cannot, attach to the minion with the most remaining hit points. [star] Attached character's attacks gain piercing. Hero Action: Spend a resource → discard this card.

53001a.Name: Falcon

53004.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. You may discard the top card of the encounter deck to remove 1 additional threat from that scheme for each icon ([star] and [boost]) in the discarded card's boost area.

53015.Name: Aero

53019.Name: Strength in Diversity
53019.text: Alliance. Hero Action: For each different [[Trait]] on friendly characters in play, choose: • Remove 1 threat from a scheme. • Deal 1 damage to an enemy.

53039.text: Attach to Fixer. Otherwise, attach to the villain. Attached enemy gains [[Aerial]]. Forced Interrupt: When attached character would take 3 or more damage, prevent all of that damage and discard Jet Pack.

53040.Name: Tech-Pac
53040.text: Attach to Fixer. Otherwise, attach to the villain. [star] Attached enemy gets +1 ATK for each other [[Tech]] attachment it has. Hero Action: Exhaust any number of characters you control with a combined THW greater than attached enemy's SCH → discard this card.

53041.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Tech]] attachment and reveal it. Place 1 additional threat here for each [[Tech]] card in play.

54001a.Name: Winter Soldier

54008.text: Hero Response: After you attack and defeat an enemy, discard this card → ready your hero and confuse an enemy.

54010.Name: Winter Mask

54012.text: Toughness. Response: After Captain America enters play, ready a [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] character.

54016.Name: Spoiling for a Fight

54019.Name: Man on the Wall

54022.Name: Super-Soldiers

54035.text:
Attach to your identity.

54036.text: Forced Response: After an ally enters play, exhaust it.

53014.Name: Adam Warlock

201003.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When a character would take any amount of damage from an attack, prevent all of that damage. You may discard a [[portal]] upgrade attached to an enemy to deal damage to that enemy equal to the amount prevented this way. "I don't plan on dying at all! 'least, not today..." —Blink

201005.text: Hero Action (attack/thwart): Deal 2 damage to each enemy with a [[portal]] upgrade attached. Remove 2 threat from each scheme with a [[portal ]]upgrade attached. "I don't plan on dying at all! 'least, not today…" —Blink

Exhaust Clarice Ferguson → remove Stranger in This Reality from the game.

201120.Name: Pandemonium
201120.text: When Revealed: Each player searches the discard pile for a minion and puts it into play engaged with them. If no minions were put into play, this card gains surge.

201122.Name: Unmade
201122.text: Surge. When Revealed: Choose and discard an identity-specific card from your hand.

200401b.Name: Lorna Dane
200401b.text: Geomagnetic Link — Action: Shuffle up to 2 [[magnetic]] cards from your discard pile into your deck. For each card shuffled this way, heal 1 damage from Lorna Dane. (Limit once per round.) “Complicated. It's my brand.”

200401a.Name: Polaris
200401a.text: Electromagnetism Manipulation — Action: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for up to 2 [[magnetic]] cards and add them to your hand. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per round.) “I am a big gun. Or have you forgotten?”

200402.Name: Havok
200402.text: Response: After Havok attacks, put each copy of Magnetized Debris in your discard pile on top of your deck (limit once per phase). "... this is what I have been most afraid of, ever since I first manifested my powers - using it to kill."

200403.Name: Disarmament
200403.text: Hero Action: Choose: • Remove 2 threat from a scheme • Discard an attached copy of Magnetized Debris from an enemy → discard an attachment with the text "Hero Action" or "Hero Response" from that enemy.

200404.Name: Electromagnetic Pulse
200404.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 5 damage to an enemy. This attack gains overkill. You may discard X attached copies of Magnetized Debris from among enemies → this attack deals 2X additional damage. If none were discarded this way, confuse an enemy.

200405.Name: Forcefield Exoskeleton
200405.text: Hero Action: Choose: • Ready and heal 1 damage from an ally. • Discard X attached copies of Magnetized Debris from among enemies → give X friendly characters a tough status card. "Little electromagnetic shield for us..." -Polaris

200406.Name: Hold it Together
200406.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 4 threat from a scheme. You may discard X attached copies of Magnetized Debris from among enemies → remove X additional threat from that scheme. "Spoiler alert: I struggle with this. A lot." -Polaris

200408.Name: Magnetized Debris
200408.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. If you overpaid for this card with a [energy] resource, this attack gains piercing and deals 1 additional damage. If that enemy is defeated by this attack, shuffle this card into your deck. Otherwise, attach this card facedown to that enemy.

200412.Name: Opposites Attract
200412.text: Hero Action: Choose a player. Deal 2 damage to the villain and each enemy engaged with that player. For each enemy damaged this way, you may discard an attached copy of Magnetized Debris from that enemy to stun it.

200413.Name: Boneyard
200413.text: Interrupt: When a Magnetized Debris would be shuffled from your discard pile into your deck, attach it facedown under here instead. Hero Interrupt: When Polaris would take any amount of damage from an attack, shuffle a card under here into your deck → prevent 2 of that damage.

200414.Name: Magnetic Levitation
200414.text: Polaris gains the [[aerial]] trait. Hero Response: After you play a Magnetized Debris, exhaust this card → ready Polaris. "Well, clever is my middle name." -Polaris

200415.Name: Mistress of Magnetism
200415.text: Magnetized Debris gains "This attack gains ranged." Hero Resource: Exhaust this card → generate a [energy] resource. you may discard X attached copies of Magnetized Debris from among enemies to generate X additional [energy] resource.

200416.Name: Wrapped in Metal
200416.text: Attach to an enemy. Reduce the cost to play this card by 1 for each copy of Magnetized Debris attached to the target. Forced Interrupt: When the attached enemy would activate, discard this card instead.

200423.Name: Energetic Duo
200423.text: Team-Up (Havok and Polaris). Max 1 per deck. Hero Response: After Havok deals any amount of damage, each player who controls Havok or Polaris may search their deck for an identity-specific card (up to 2 identity-specific cards if they control both) and add them to their hand.

200417.Name: The Fragmented Past
200417.text: When Revealed: Discard each attached copy of Magnetized Debris. Forced Response: After you play a [[magnetic]] card, take 2 damage. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Lorna Dane → remove The Fragmented Past from the game.

200418.Name: "Daddy Issues"
200418.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for the Magneto minion and put it into play engaged with you. Seek a [[magnetic]] card from the Polaris player's deck and attach it facedown under the Magneto minion. If Magneto did not enter play this way, place 2[per_hero] threat here. [acceleration]

200419.Name: Magneto
200419.text: Forced Response: After a [[magnetic]] event or treachery has been resolved, attach it facedown under here. Forced Interrupt: When Magneto would take any amount of damage, if there are any [[magnetic]] cards attached under here, discard one of them instead. (Polaris’s nemesis minion.)

200420.Name: Magnetized Shrapnel
200420.text: When Revealed: Take 3 indirect damage. The Polaris player may spend X [energy] resource to prevent X of that damage. [star]Boost: Take 1 indirect damage. Shuffle this card into the encounter deck.

201301a.Name: Yondu
201301a.text: D'ast Whistlin' — Interrupt: When the Yaka Arrow uprgrade is attached to or removed from an enemy, deal 1 damage to that enemy. When it is attached to your identity, heal 1 damage from Yondu.

201301b.Name: Yondu Udonta
201301b.text: Crew Cut — Action: Summon the Tahlei upgrade and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round) Whistlin' - Action:Exhaust Yondu Udonta → summon the Yaka Arrow upgrade and add it to your hand.

201302.Name: Cheap Shot
201302.text: Hero Action (attack): Stun an enemy. Then, if that enemy has the Yaka Arrow upgrade attached, deal 6 damages to that enemy.

201303.Name: Fight Dirty
201303.text: Hero Action (attack): Confuse an enemy. Then, if that enemy has the Yaka Arrow upgrade attached, deal 6 damages to that enemy.

201304.Name: Whistle While You Work
201304.text: Hero Action: Attach the Yaka Arrow upgrade to Yondu→ready Yondu and the Tahlei upgrade. If the Yaka Arrow upgrade is not in play, summon it and add it to your hand instead.

201305.Name: Tough Motherlover
201305.text: Action: Give Yondu a tough status card. Then, if you have the Yaka Arrow upgrade in your hand, draw a card.

201306.Name: Twirlin' and Whirlin'
201306.text: Hero Action: Attach the Yaka Arrow upgrade to an enemy or to your identity. You may resolve this ability up to 3 times.

201307.Name: Jackpot!
201307.text: Response: After you spend this card, treat the next card you spend this phase as if it has double the resources.

201308.Name: Ravager Redshirts
201308.text: Hero Interrupt: When you would take any amount of damage from an enemy with the Yaka Arrow upgrade attached, exhaust Ravager Redshirts → prevent up to 2 of that damage.

201309.Name: Invest
201309.text:
Hero Action: Exhaust Invest and spend 2 or more resources from your hand. If the number of resources spent this way was:
  • 2 â€“ Attach the Yaka Arrow upgrade to an enemy or to your identity.
  • 3 â€“ Ready Yondu and the Tahlei upgrade.
  • 4 or more â€“ Draw 5 cards.

201310.Name: Ravage
201310.text: Hero Response: After the Yaka Arrow upgrade is attached to a minion, exhaust Ravage → that minion gains fragile until the end of the round. (Attacks against fragile minions gain overkill.)

201311.Name: Tahlei
201311.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Tahlei → attach the Yaka Arrow upgrade to an enemy or to your identity.

201312.Name: Yaka Arrow
201312.text: While Yaka Arrow is attached to Yondu, he gets +1 THW and +1 ATK. Forced Interrupt: When Attached enemy is defeated, attach Yaka Arrow to an enemy, to your identity, or add it to your hand.

201313.Name: Banished
201313.text: Give to the Yondu Udonta player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: â€¢ Exhaust your alter-ego â†’ remove Banished from the game. â€¢ Discard the Yaka Arrow upgrade and exhaust the Tahlei upgrade. Discard this obligation.

201314.Name: Price on Your Head
201314.text: Forced Response: After a friendly character is defeated, heal 1 damage from Sav'rkk. If Sav'rkk is not in play, heal 1 damage from the villain instead.

201315.Name: Sav'rkk
201315.text: Upgrades cannot be removed from Sav'kk. When Revealed: Summon the Sword-Gun-Arm Attachment and attach it to Sav'rkk.

201316.Name: Sword-Gun-Arm
201316.text: Attach to Sav'rkk. If you cannot, attach to the minion withe the highest ATK. If you cannot, this card gain surge. [star] Attached character's attacks gain overkill. Forced Response: When attached character has 2 or less remaining hit points, discard Sword-Gun-Arm.

201317.Name: Hard to Kill
201317.text: When Revealed: If Sav'rkk is in play, he heals 2 damages. Otherwise, summon Sav'rkk and reveal him. [star] Boost: The vilain heals 2 damages.

201318.Name: Savage Destruction
201318.text: When Revealed: If Sav'rkk is in play, he attacks you. Ohterwise, summon Sav'rkk and reveal him.

53005.Name: Up, Up, and Away
53005.text: Hero Response (defense): After an attacking enemy is given a facedown boost card, look at that card and the top card of the encounter deck. You may swap those cards. Draw 1 card for each printed icon ([star] and [boost]) in the (current) boost card's boost area.

53006.Name: Falcon's Flock
53006.text: Uses (5 bird counters). Resource: Remove 1 bird counter from here → generate a [energy] resource for an [[Aerial]] card. (Limit once per card.)

53007.Name: Soup Kitchen
53007.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Sam Wilson and Soup Kitchen → heal damage from Sam Wilson equal to his REC and reduce the cost of the next ally or support played this phase by 2.

53010.Name: Battlefield Awareness
53010.text: Hero Interrupt: When Falcon uses a basic power, exhaust Battlefield Awareness and discard the top card of the encounter deck → Falcon gets +1 to that power for this use for each icon ([star] and [boost]) in the discarded card's boost area.

53013.Name: Vibranium Microweave
53013.text: Falcon gets +1 DEF. Hero Interrupt: When Falcon would take any amount of damage, exhaust Vibranium Microweave → prevent 1 of that damage and deal 1 damage to an enemy.

53018.Name: Spectrum
53018.text: Response: After you play Spectrum, tuck 1 card used to pay for her under her. If that card's printed resource has: [mental] – Spectrum gets +2 THW. [physical] – Spectrum gets +2 ATK. [energy] – Spectrum gets +2 hit points. [wild] – All of the above.

53021.Name: Resource Reserve
53021.text: Max 1 per player. Any player may spend the resource card tucked here as if it were in their hand. Action: Exhaust Resource Reserve → tuck 1 resource card from your hand under here (to a maximum of 1).

53023.Name: Captain America
53023.text: Play only if you are the Bucky Barnes or Sam Wilson player. Hero Action: Exhaust Captain America and spend a [physical] resource → find Captain America's Shield and add it to your hand. If it leaves play this way, deal 4 damage to an enemy.

53034.Name: Captain America's Shield
53034.text:
Linked (Captain America upgrade). Restricted.
Your hero gets +1 DEF and gains retaliate 1.

53035.Name: Winter Soldier
53035.text: Response: After Winter Soldier attacks and defeats an enemy, remove 2 threat from a scheme.

53036.Name: Misty Knight
53036.text: [star] Interrupt: When Misty Knight thwarts, look at the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and discard 1 of those cards. Misty Knight gets +1 THW for this thwart for each icon ([star] and [boost]) in the discarded card's boost area.

53037.Name: Ops Room
53037.text: Uses (3 alert counters). Interrupt: When a friendly character would take any amount of damage while defending, remove 1 alert counter from here → prevent 1 of that damage and remove 1 threat from a scheme.

53029.Name: Harlem's Protector
53029.text: Give to the Sam Wilson player. Uses (3 emergency counters). Victory 0. Alter-Ego Action: Spend 1 resource of any type → remove 1 emergency counter from here.

53030.Name: Viper
53030.text: Quickstrike. [star] Forced Response: After Viper activates, discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. (Falcon's nemesis minion.)

53031.Name: Serpent Solutions
53031.text: Forced Response: After a [[Serpent Society]] minion is discarded from the top of the encounter deck, deal that minion to the first player as a facedown encounter card.

53032.Name: Serpent Soldier
53032.text:
Quickstrike.
[star] Boost: Give the activating enemy an additional boost card.

53033.Name: Adder-tisement
53033.text: Surge. When Revealed: Shuffle each [[Serpent Society]] minion from the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.

53042.Name: Techno
53042.text:
When Revealed: Find Fixer and reveal him. (If he is already in play, he engages you.) Fixer activates against you. If no enemy activated this way, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, it gains piercing.

54003.Name: Black Widow
54003.text: Response: After you play Black Widow from your hand, return an [[Attack]] event from your discard pile to your hand.

54009.Name: Winter Armor
54009.text: You get +3 hit points and gain steady.

54011.Name: Winter Rifle
54011.text: Restricted. Hero Interrupt: When Winter Soldier makes a basic attack, exhaust Winter Rifle → Winter Soldier gets +2 ATK for this attack. This attack gains piercing and ranged.

54013.Name: Deathlok
54013.text: Response: After Deathlok enters play, search your deck and discard pile for a copy of S.H.I.E.L.D. Sidearm and attach it to him. (Shuffle.)

54014.Name: Firepower
54014.text: Hero Action (attack): Exhaust up to 3 [[Weapon]] upgrades you control → for each weapon upgrade exhausted this way, choose an enemy and deal 3 damage to it. This attack gains ranged.

54018.Name: Bambino
54018.text: Attach to a [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] character. While attached to an identity, this card gains restricted. Uses (3 ammo counters). Interrupt: When attached character makes a basic attack, remove 1 ammo counter from here → this attack deals 3 additional damage and gains overkill.

54020.Name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Sidearm
54020.text: Attach to a [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] character. Limit 1 per character. Uses (3 ammo counters). Interrupt: When attached character makes a basic attack, exhaust S.H.I.E.L.D. Sidearm and remove 1 ammo counter from it → deal 1 damage to an enemy.

54023.Name: Winter, Widow, Soldier, Spy
54023.text: Team-Up (Black Widow and Winter Soldier). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action (attack): Put a [[Preparation]] upgrade from your discard pile into play. Deal 4 damage to an enemy.

54032.Name: White Widow
54032.text: Response: After you resolve the ability of a [[Preparation]] card you control, heal damage from White Widow equal to that card's printed resource cost.

54033.Name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Deputy
54033.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] trait.
Attach to a friendly character.
Attached character gets +1 hit point and gains the [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] trait.

54027.Name: Red Room Programming
54027.text: Give to the Bucky Barnes player. You may flip to your alter-ego form. Choose: • Exhaust Bucky Barnes → remove this card from the game. • Discard the highest printed cost card from your hand and take indirect damage equal to its cost. Discard this obligation.

54028.Name: Crossbones
54028.text: Quickstrike. [star] Forced Response: After Crossbones attacks and defeats an ally, place 2 threat on the main scheme. (Winter Soldier's nemesis minion.)

54029.Name: Hydra Hit Squad
54029.text: Each [[Hydra]] minion gets +1 ATK and +2 hit points. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Hydra]] minion and reveals it. (Shuffle.)

54030.Name: High-Tech Armament
54030.text: Attach to Crossbones. Otherwise, attach to the villain. Forced Response: After you attach High-Tech Armament to an enemy, that enemy activates against you. Hero Action: Exhaust a character you control → discard this card.

54031.Name: Hydra Mercenary
54031.text: Guard. (While this minion is engaged with you, you cannot attack the villain.)

54037.Name: Whiteout
54037.text:
When Revealed: Find Blizzard and reveal him. (If he is already in play, he engages you.) Blizzard activates against you. If no enemy activated this way, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: You are stunned. If you were already stunned, take 1 damage.

53022.Name: The Triskelion
53022.text: Increase your ally limit by 1. (This allows you to control more than 3 allies.)

53028.Name: The Power of Flight
53028.text: Double the number of resources this card generates while paying for an [[AERIAL]] card.

54015.Name: One by One
54015.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. If this attack defeats that enemy, deal 2 damage to an enemy.

54021.Name: Nick Fury, Sr.
54021.text: Forced Response: After Nick Fury, Sr. enters play, choose one: Remove 3 threat from a scheme, draw 2 cards, or give a [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] character a tough status card. At the end of the round, if Nick Fury, Sr. is still in play, discard him.

800401a.Name: Sentry
800401a.text: L'explosion d'un million de soleils — Ressource : ajoutez X jetons Ombre sur l'Ennemi intérieur (jusqu'à un maximum de 3) → piochez X carte. (Limite d'une fois par round.)

800401b.Name: Robert Reynolds
800401b.text: Mise en place : mettez en jeu l'Ennemi intérieur. Cherchez Lindy Reynolds dans votre deck ou votre pile de défausse et ajoutez-la à votre main. (mélangez votre deck) Reprendre le contrôle — Action: inclinez Robert Reynolds, retirez 3 jetons Ombre de l'Ennemi Intérieur. (Limite d'une fois par round.)

800402.Name: Ennemi Intérieur
800402.text:
Permanent.
Réponse forcée : après avoir placé un jeton Ombre ici, si le nombre de jetons Ombre est au moins égal à 10 et si Voïd n'est pas en jeu → cherchez la manigance annexe L'arrivée des Ténèbres dans la zone "mis de côté" et révélez-la. Mélangez dans le deck Rencontre les cartes restantes de votre set de rencontre Némésis mis de côté.

800403.Name: Puissance Irrésistible
800403.text:
Action de héros (attaque) : ajoutez X jetons Ombre sur Ennemi intérieur (jusqu'à un maximum de 3). Infligez à un ennemi
3 dégâts pour chaque jeton ainsi ajouté. Cette attaque gagne Déferlement et Perçant.

800404.Name: Pourfendre l'adversaire
800404.text: Action de héros (attaque) : ajoutez X jetons Ombre sur Ennemi intérieur (jusqu'à un maximum de 3). Vainquez X sbires non-[[élite]] en jeu de votre choix.

800405.Name: Equilibre Précaire
800405.text: Action : soignez un nombre de points de vie de votre identité égal au nombre de jetons Ombre sur Ennemi intérieur.

800406.Name: Moment de lucidité
800406.text: Action : retirez jusqu'à 3 jetons Ombre de Ennemi intérieur.

800407.Name: Rayonnement solaire
800407.text: Action de héros (contre) : ajoutez X jetons Ombre sur Ennemi intérieur (jusqu'à un maximum de 3). Retirez 2 menaces parmi les manigances de votre choix en ignorant les icônes de Crise ([crisis]) pour chaque jeton ainsi ajouté.

800408.Name: Sauvetage in extremis
800408.text: Interruption (défense) : Quand un allié est censé subir n'importe quelle quantité de dégâts, inclinez Sentry ou ajoutez 1 jeton Ombre sur Ennemi intérieur → prévenez tous les dégâts infligés à cet allié.

800409.Name: La Tour de guet
800409.text: Vous pouvez jouer les cartes attachées à La Tour de guet comme si elles étaient dans votre main. Action : inclinez La Tour de guet → attachez une carte événement de votre main à la tour de guet. (jusqu'à 2 cartes maximum peuvent être attachées à La Tour de guet.)

800410.Name: Lindy Reynolds
800410.text:
Action : inclinez Lindy Reynolds → retirez 1 jeton Ombre de Ennemi intérieur.
Réponse forcée : après que Lindy Reynolds a été vaincue, ajoutez 6 jetons Ombre sur Ennemi intérieur.

800411.Name: Maîtrise du potentiel
800411.text: Sentry gagne +1 ATQ et le trait [[aérien]]. Vous gagnez + 4 points de vie. Réponse forcée : après avoir joué cette carte, ajoutez 2 jetons Ombre sur Ennemi intérieur.

800412.Name: Mon nom est Sentry
800412.text: Interruption : quand une carte Traîtrise est révélée du deck Rencontre, annulez ses effets "Une fois révélée". Si vous êtes sous forme d'alter ego, passez sous forme de héros. Ajoutez 1 jeton Ombre sur Ennemi intérieur.

800413.Name: Résister à l'Obscurité;
800413.text: Action : Choisissez une option parmi les suivantes : - redressez votre identité → Ajoutez 1 jeton Ombre sur Ennemi intérieur. - retirez 2 jetons Ombre sur Ennemi intérieur. Ensuite, mélangez cette carte dans votre deck. Réponse forcée : Quand cette carte entre dans votre pile de défausse → ajoutez 1 jeton Ombre sur Ennemi intérieur.

800414.Name: Psychose
800414.text: Donnez cette carte au joueur de Robert Reynolds. Vous pouvez passer sous forme d'alter ego. Choisissez : . Inclinez Robert Reynolds → retirez Psychose de la partie. . Ajoutez 3 jetons Ombre sur Ennemi intérieur. Défaussez cette obligation.

800415.Name: L'arrivée des Ténèbres
800415.text: Une fois révélée : si le sbire Némésis Voïd n'est pas en jeu, cherchez-le dans la zone "mis de côté", le deck Rencontre ou la défausse et mettez-le en jeu. Mélangez le deck Rencontre. Réponse forcée : après l'étape 1 de la phase du Méchant, chaque joueur doit défausser un allié. S'il ne le peut pas, son identité subit 4 dégâts.

800416.Name: Voïd
800416.text:
Garde. Robuste. Vilénie. Voïd ne peut pas être vaincu. Chaque dégât infligé à Voïd retire un jeton Ombre sur Ennemi intérieur. Réponse forcée : s'il n'y a plus de jeton Ombre sur Ennemi intérieur, défaussez Voïd.
[star] Boost : mettez en jeu Voïd engagé avec vous.

800417.Name: Simplement le Néant
800417.text:
Une fois révélée : ajoutez 4 jetons Ombre sur Ennemi intérieur.
[star] Boost : ajoutez 1 jeton Ombre sur Ennemi intérieur.

201401b.Name: Wyn
201401b.text: You may include [[cosmic entity ]]and [[spell ]]cards from any aspect in your deck. Renegotiate — Action: Shuffle up to 3 [[cosmic entity ]]cards from your removed-from -game area into your deck → draw that many cards. (Limit once per round.)

201401a.Name: Ser Reddwyn
201401a.text: Cosmic Ally — Response: After a [[cosmic entity]] is turned faceup as a boost card, deal it to any player as a facedown encounter card. (Limit once per phase.) “You’ve had the sugar, now here’s the salt.”

201402.Name: Aiko Maki
201402.text: Response: After Aiko Maki enters play, shuffle a [[cosmic entity]] card from your hand or discard pile into the encounter deck. “Just know that I love you too.”

201403.Name: The-Powers-That-Be
201403.text: Action: Shuffle this card into the encounter deck (without looking). When Revealed: Search your deck and discard pile for a resource, add it to your hand and remove this card from the game. This effect cannot be canceled.

201404.Name: The-Natural-Order
201404.text: Action: Shuffle this card into the encounter deck (without looking). When Revealed: Search your deck and discard pile for an upgrade, add it to your hand and remove this card from the game. This effect cannot be canceled.

201405.Name: Cosmic Bargainer
201405.text: Alter-Ego Action: Choose a player → that player searches their deck and discard pile for an [[artifact]] or a [[cosmic entity]] card and adds it to their hand. “I bet we can trade this in for something good.” -Ser Reddwyn

201406.Name: Cosmic Intervention
201406.text: Hero Interrupt: When a card is revealed from the encounter deck, search the encounter deck for a [[cosmic entity]] card and reveal it → cancel all of the card’s effects and discard it.

201407.Name: Invoke a Favor
201407.text: Hero Action: Search the encounter deck for a [[cosmic entity]] and reveal it → choose: • Deal 7 damage to an enemy. • Remove 5 threat from a scheme. “All I know is that you’ve made a mortal enemy.” -Wyn

201410.Name: Avatar of Magic
201410.text: When paying for an [[artifact]], [[cosmic entity]] or [[spell]], generate this card’s printed resource from your discard pile by shuffling it into your deck.

201412.Name: Immortality
201412.text: Response: After your deck resets, exhaust Immortality → heal 3 damage from your identity card. “No, I’m old. You’re just tired.” -Ser Reddwyn

201413.Name: Sharpened Soul
201413.text: Ser Reddwyn gets +2 ATK. Forced Interrupt: At the start of your turn, place this card on top of your deck. “It’s about manifesting an object of power that’s a reflection of who you are.” -Ser Reddwyn

201414.Name: The Buchcub
201414.text: Attach to an non-[[elite]] minion. Attached minion cannot activate. Treat its printed text box as if it were blank. “The longer you read it, the more it eats your mind.” -Ser Reddwyn

201415.Name: Wyn’s Bracelet
201415.text: Action: Exhaust Wyn’s Bracelet → discard the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 [[cosmic entity ]]or [[spell ]]card discarded this way to your hand.

201416.Name: Dimitri Krakov
201416.text: Interrupt: When you play a [[cosmic entity]], exhaust Dimitri Krakov → instead of shuffling it into the encounter deck, choose to either place it at the top or the bottom. “Calculating the odds that this is a good idea...”

201423.Name: Cosmic Audience
201423.text: Player under any player’s control. Max 1 per player. Response: After you reveal a [[cosmic entity]] card, exhaust this card → draw 1 card.

201424.Name: Lady Death
201424.text: Action: Shuffle this card into the encounter deck (without looking). When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to ALL characters. Remove this card from the game. This effect cannot be canceled.

201425.Name: Oblivion
201425.text: Action: Shuffle this card into the encounter deck (without looking). When Revealed: Stun the villain and remove this card from the game. This effect cannot be canceled.

201426.Name: Preordained
201426.text: Action: Shuffle this card into the encounter deck (without looking). When Revealed: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card discarded this way to your hand. Remove this card from the game. This effect cannot be canceled.

201427.Name: The Contemplator
201427.text: Action: Shuffle this card into the encounter deck (without looking). When Revealed: Give your identity a tough status card and remove this card from the game. This effect cannot be canceled.

201428.Name: The Possesor
201428.text: Action: Shuffle this card into the encounter deck (without looking). When Revealed: Confuse the villain and remove this card from the game. This effect cannot be canceled.

201417.Name: Avatar’s Duty
201417.text:
You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose:
Exhaust Wyn → remove Avatar’s Duty from the game.
Discard 7 cards from the encounter deck. This card gains surge. Discard Avatar’s Duty.

201418.Name: Cubisk Core
201418.text: [star] Cubisk Core gets +1 SCH and +1 ATK for each [[cosmic entity]] in the removed- from-game area. (Ser Reddwyn’s nemesis minion.) [star] Boost: This card gains [boost] for each [[cosmic entity]] in the removed-from-game area. “I am here to destroy the dream and wake you from your slumber...”

201419.Name: Babylon Event
201419.text: “That spell... Did I hear it incorrectly, or was that the beginning of an elder pantheon breach?” -Jericho Drumm Permanent. Forced Response: After threat is placed here, if there is at least 10 threat here, each player takes damage equal to half their printed hit points rounded down.

201420.Name: Advance the Ritual
201420.text: When Revealed: Choose: Either place 4 threat on Babylon Event, or deal yourself 2 facedown encounter cards. [star] Boost: Choose: Either place 2 threat on Babylon Event, or this card gains [boost][boost]. “Regrets are for the dream. You are awake now. Open your eyes.” -Cubisk Core

201422.Name: Finale
201422.text: When Revealed: Each character you control takes 2 damage. For each character defeated this way, place 2 threat on Babylon Event. [star] Boost: Choose: Either place 3 threat on Babylon Event, or this card gains [boost][boost][boost]. “Regrets are for the dream. You are awake now. Open your eyes.” -Cubisk Core

44223.Name: Ralph
44223.text: Hero Interrupt: When your hero attacks an enemy, attach Ralph to that enemy and look at 2 cards from among the top of the encounter deck and encounter cards dealt to players → that attack gains piercing and deals X additional damage to both that enemy and Ralph, where X is the number of boost ([boost]) icons looked that way

44224.Name: Target Painted
44224.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[soldier]] trait. attach to a minion. Max 1 per Minion.
Attacks against attached minion gain ranged and deal 1 additionnal damage for each card attached to that minion.

250001.Name: Graviton
250001.text: Formidable Foe — Forced Interrupt: When Graviton would take damage that would defeat him, discard the top card of the encounter deck. Prevent an amount of damage equal to the number of boost icons ([boost]) discarded this way.

250002.Name: Graviton
250002.text: When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to each exhausted ally. Exhaust each friendly character and support. Forced Interrupt: When Graviton would take damage that would defeat him, discard 2 cards from the encounter deck. Prevent an amount of damage equal to the total number of boost icons ([boost]) discarded this way.

250003.Name: Graviton
250003.text: When Revealed: Discard each exhausted ally and support. Exhaust each friendly character and support. Forced Interrupt: When Graviton would take damage that would defeat him, discard 3 cards from the encounter deck. Prevent an amount of damage equal to the total number of boost icons ([boost]) discarded this way.

250004a.Name: Turning Into a Black Hole
250004a.text: After breaking free from his prison, Graviton conjures a cataclysmic black hole. Contents: Graviton (I) and Graviton (II). (Graviton (II) and Graviton (III) for expert mode.) Graviton, Dark Matter and Standard encounter set. One modular encounter set (Masters of Evil). Setup: Search the encounter deck for the Dark Matter environment and the Seismic Uprising side scheme and reveal them. (Shuffle.) Advance to stage 1B.

250004b.Name: Turning Into a Black Hole
250004b.text: [star] Forced Response: After resolving step one of the villain phase, each player must choose to either place 1 threat here or exhaust a character they control. Forced Interrupt: When threat is placed here, discard the top card of the encounter deck.

250005a.Name: The Singularity
250005a.text: Earth's irreversible demise looms as the singularity draws near. When Revealed: Each player must exhaust 1 ally and 1 support they control. Deal 1 encounter card to each player. Advance to stage 2B.

250005b.Name: The Singularity
250005b.text: [star] Forced Response: After resolving step one of the villain phase, each player must choose to either place 2 threat here or exhaust a character they control. Forced Interrupt: When threat is placed here, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

250006a.Name: Seismic Uprising
250006a.text: Graviton is tearing apart his former prison. Setup. Forced Response: After resolving step one of the villain phase, place 1 prison counter here. If there are 4 or more prison counters here, flip this card. When Defeated: Place 3[per_hero] threat on the main scheme and remove this card from the game.

250006b.Name: Flying Prison
250006b.text: When Revealed: In player order, each player must discard cards from the encounter deck until a non-[[dark matter]] minion is discarded, then put it into play engaged with them. Each friendly character without the [[aerial]] trait gets -1 THW and -1 ATK. Hero Action: As a group, the players exhaust 2[per_hero] characters → remove this card from the game.

250007.Name: Moon Crash
250007.text: "Things down here are only gonna get worse. More meteors, gravity quakes..." - Sylvie Forced Response: After resolving step one of the villain phase, place 1 moon counter here. Then deal X indirect damage to each player, where X is the number of moon counters here. [acceleration]

250008.Name: Solar Gravitational Field
250008.text: Graviton separated himself from Earth's gravitational field and is tuning to the Sun’s gravitational field instead. Forced Response: After your turn ends, heal 2 damage from Graviton. [amplify]

250009.Name: Gravity Pull
250009.text: When Revealed: Exhaust an ally and a support you control. If no card is exhausted this way, exhaust your identity. [star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, the defender cannot ready until your next turn ends.

250011.Name: Graviton Blast
250011.text: When Revealed: Discard each card with a printed [physical] resource from your hand. If no card was discarded this way, take 2 indirect damage. [star]Boost: Reveal this card.

250013.Name: City in Collapse
250013.text: Surge. When Revealed: Discard X cards from the top of the encounter deck, where X is equal to the amount of threat on the main scheme. If no card was discarded this way, place 3 threat on the main scheme.

250015.Name: Graviton’s Reign
250015.text: Surge. When Revealed: Place 2 threat on each scheme in play. Heal X damage from Graviton, where X is equal to the amount of threat placed this way.

250016.Name: Graviton’s Grasp
250016.text: Surge. When Revealed: Discard an exhausted ally under your control. Heal X damage from Graviton where X is equal to the printed cost of the discarded ally. If no ally was discarded this way, exhaust a character you control. [star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, it gains overkill.

250017.Name: Gravity Lockdown
250017.text: Attach to your identity. Attached identity cannot make basic attacks or basic thwarts. Hero Action: Exhaust your hero and spend a [physical] resource → discard this card.

250018.Name: Gravity Nullification
250018.text: Attach to Graviton. Reduce the damage Graviton takes from each attack from non-[[aerial]] characters by 1. Hero Action: Exhaust your hero and spend a [physical] resource → discard this card.

250019.Name: Graviton Presence
250019.text: Attach to the ally you control with the most remaining hit points. If you cannot, this card gains surge. You cannot ready the attached ally. Hero Action: Exhaust your hero and spend a [physical] resource → discard this card.

250020.Name: Blackout
250020.text: [star]Forced Response: After Blackout attacks and damages a character, stun that character. [star]Boost: Stun the character you control with the highest ATK value.

250021.Name: Moonstone
250021.text: Reduce the damage Moonstone takes from each attack from non-[[aerial]] characters by 1. [star]Boost: Exhaust an ally you control.

250022.Name: Dark Matter
250022.text: Permanent. Setup. Forced Response: After an ally or support enters play under your control, spend a [physical] resource or exhaust it. It is everywhere. 85% of the matter of the Universe is dark matter.

250023.Name: Self Interacting Dark Matter
250023.text: The ever-present dark matter particles seem to flicker and interact with one another. Hinder 2[per_hero]. Forced Response: After you ready a character, deal 1 damage to it.

250024.Name: Dark Matter Excess
250024.text: Dark Matter Excess cannot take damage. [star]Boost: Put Dark Matter Excess into play engaged with you. Dark matter barely interacts with normal matter. It is invisible and escapes all attempts to observe it.

250025.Name: Dark Matter Wind
250025.text: When Revealed: Each player discards the top 3 cards of their deck. For each printed [energy] or [mental] resource a player discards this way, that player takes 1 indirect damage. A strong dark matter wind is coming from the Cygnus constellation.

250026.Name: Dark Matter Resonance
250026.text: Attach to the villain. Attached villain gains steady. Forced Interrupt: When attached villain would be defeated, reset their hit points to 2[per_hero] instead, then discard this card. Hero Action: Exhaust your hero and spend [energy][mental] resources → discard this card.

250027.Name: Dark Matter Entanglement
250027.text: Attach to the ally you control with the most remaining hit points. If you cannot, this card gains surge. Forced Response: After you ready attached ally, deal 1 damage to it. [star]Boost: Deal 1 damage to each exhausted ally you control.

250101b.Name: Noriko Ashida
250101b.text: You may include up to 5 cards with a printed [energy] resource in your deck from aspects other than your own. New X-Men — Action: Exhaust Noriko Ashida → search your deck for an [[x-men]] ally and add it to your hand.

250101a.Name: Surge
250101a.text: Uncontrolled Surge — Forced Response: After you play a card with a printed [energy] resource, ready your identity and draw 1 card. If a card with a printed [energy] resource was drawn this way, take 1 damage. (Limit once per phase.)

250102.Name: Prodigy
250102.text: Mimic — Response: After a character you control thwarts, Prodigy gets +1 THW until the end of the phase (to a maximum of +3 THW). “Knowledge isn't power. It's an intrinsic good. It betters the world simply by existing.”

250103.Name: Gauntlets
250103.text: Interrupt: When you would take damage from “Uncontrolled Surge“, exhaust Gauntlets → cancel that damage. Action: Exhaust Gauntlets → shuffle 1 identity-specific card from your discard pile into your deck.

250104.Name: Double Strike
250104.text: Hero Response: After you play an [[attack ]]event, discard 1 card from your hand → deal 2 damage to an enemy. Deal 2 additional damage to that enemy for each printed [energy] resource on the card discarded this way.

250105.Name: Haste
250105.text: Hero Interrupt: When the surge keyword on an encounter card would be resolved, exhaust Haste instead. “‘ScuseMe StepAsideComin’ Through!”

250106.Name: Intense Training
250106.text: Action: Exhaust your identity and an ally you control → shuffle up to 3 identity specific cards from your discard pile into your deck. Draw 2 cards. If you are in hero form, discard 1 card from your hand.

250107.Name: Keep At Bay
250107.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When a friendly character would take any amount of damage from an attack, prevent 3 of that damage. If you paid for this card using a [energy] resource, deal 3 damage to the attacker.

250109.Name: Full Blast
250109.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 6 damage to an enemy. If the number of [energy] resource spent to pay for this card is at least: • 1 — This attack gains ranged • 2 — This attack also gains piercing • 3 — This attack also gains overkill

250112.Name: Situation Control
250112.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. You may exhaust an ally you control to remove 3 threat from a scheme. “Have to find a way... My responsibility... My burden...”

250114.Name: Gather Energy
250114.text: Hero Action: Choose up to 3 cards with a printed [energy] resource in your discard pile not named Gather Energy and place them on the top of your deck. “My mutant powers let me absorb static electricity and then discharge it whenever i want...”

250116.Name: Lead the Team
250116.text: Hero Action: Ready your identity. Return the topmost ally with a printed [energy] resource in your discard pile to your hand. “Everybody get ready!”

250123.Name: Supportive Partner
250123.text: Team-Up (Surge and Prodigy). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Ready Surge and Prodigy. Heal 2 damage from each of them.

250117.Name: LosingControlNeedHelp
250117.text:
You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose:
Exhaust your alter-ego → remove LosingControlNeedHelp from the game.
You are confused. Exhaust each card with a printed [energy] resource you control. If no card was exhausted this way, this card gains surge. Discard this obligation.

250118.Name: Bus Attack
250118.text: “Assemble my purifiers. We have a bus to catch.” —Stryker Forced Response: After you exhaust an [[x-men]] or [[mutant]] friendly character, deal 1 damage to that character. [crisis]

250119.Name: Reverand Stryker
250119.text: Incite 2. Reverand Stryker cannot take damage while another minion is in play. [star] Forced Response: After Reverand Stryker attacks, he schemes. (Surge’s nemesis minion.)

250120.Name: Purifiers
250120.text: When Revealed: Take 2 indirect damage. When Defeated: Shuffle this card into the encounter deck.

250121.Name: Media Coverage
250121.text: Attach to your identity card. Resolve each “When Revealed” ability that you reveal 1 additional time. Alter-Ego Action: Spend a [mental] resource → discard this card.

250122.Name: Ambushed
250122.text: When Revealed: Choose to either take 3 damage, discard an ally you control, or exhaust and stun your identity. “This can’t be happening... This can’t be...”

201501a.Name: Ms. Marvel
201501a.text: Rechannel — Action: Spend a [energy] resource and heal 1 damage from Ms. Marvel → draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.) “Always get up. If you always get up, then it's never over.”

201501b.Name: Carol Danvers
201501b.text: Commander — Action: Choose a player to draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.) “I'm kind of done with you telling me what I can't do.”

201502.Name: Spider-Woman
201502.text: Response: After Spider-Woman enters play, confuse an enemy. If you paid for this card with only [energy] resources, stun that enemy. “This is what I wanted: helping the innocent by hospitalizing the guilty.”

201503.Name: Crisis Interdiction
201503.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. If you overpaid for this card with a [energy] resource, remove 3 threat from a scheme. "If we could, let's skip the whole - ambush me and make me fight for my life thing."

201505.Name: Photonic Blast
201505.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 5 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this card using a [energy] resource, draw 1 card. "I sort of accidentally blasted him in the crotch. Seven times in the crotch. Poor guy turned blue."

201507.Name: Cosmic Overload
201507.text: You can only spend [energy] resources to pay for this card. Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy for each [energy] resource used to pay for this card. This attack gains piercing and overkill.

201509.Name: Marvelous Might
201509.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove a total of 3 threat from among schemes in play. If this removes the last threat from a scheme, stun or confuse the villain. "All right, you gigantic Skrull &%$#. Time for you to die."

201510.Name: Seventh Sense
201510.text: Hero Interrupt: When you reveal a card from the encounter deck, cancel the effects of that card and discard it. "I'm not going to run away from anything...ever again."

201513.Name: Simon Williams
201513.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Simon Williams → return the bottommost card with a printed [energy] resource from your discard pile to your hand. “Uh...if you can get us any help - GET IT!” —Wonder Man

201514.Name: Ms. Marvel's Suit
201514.text: You get +4 hit points. Hero Interrupt: When you would take any amount of damage from an attack, exhaust Ms. Marvel's Suit and spend an [energy] resource → prevent 2 of that damage. “needs quote here!” —Ms. Marvel

201515.Name: Cosmic Might
201515.text: Ms. Marvel gets +1 ATK. Hero Resource: Exhaust Cosmic Might → generate a [energy] resource for an identity-specific event.

201516.Name: Kree Durability
201516.text: Ms. Marvel gets +1 DEF. Hero Response: After you defeat an enemy or remove the last threat from a scheme, exhaust Kree Durability → ready Ms. Marvel.

201517.Name: Identity Crisis
201517.text:
You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose:
Exhaust Carol Danvers → remove Identity Crisis from the game.
Discard 1 [[persona]] support you control. If no support was discarded this way, this card gains surge. Discard this obligation.

201518.Name: Rogue Rivalry
201518.text: Ms. Marvel has been targeted by Mystique. Acting impulsively, Rogue has decided to take matters into her own hands. Forced Response: After the villain phase begins, each player discards a random card from their hand. [crisis]

201519.Name: Rogue
201519.text: Guard. Teamwork ([[brotherhood of mutants]]). Toughness. [star] Forced Response: After Rogue attacks you, discard a [energy] resource from your hand, if able. (Ms. Marvel’s nemesis minion.)

201520.Name: Mystique
201520.text: Patrol. Teamwork ([[brotherhood of mutants]]). When Defeated: Choose to either spend a [mental] resource or confuse your identity. [star] Boost: You are confused.

201521.Name: Rogue Assault
201521.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Place threat on the main scheme equal to the total number of [energy] resources in your hand. When Revealed (Hero): Take indirect damage equal to the total number of [energy] resources in your hand.

201522.Name: Veiled Ambush
201522.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): The villain schemes. Place 1 threat on each side scheme. When Revealed (Hero): The villain attacks you. Place 1 threat on each side scheme.

400201.Name: Magneto
400201.text: Play only if your identity has the [[mutant]] trait. Interrupt: When Magneto defends against an attack, deal damage to the attacking enemy equal to the number of [[x-men]], [[x-force]] and [[x-factor]] cards you control. Protect MutantKind is the way

200424.Name: Magnetic Poles
200424.text: Team-Up (Magneto and Polaris). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Search your deck for a [[magnetic]] card and add it to your hand. Remove this card from the game.

200501b.Name: Hank Pym
200501b.text: You can only change form by card abilities. Scientist Supreme — Action: Spend 1 [mental] resource → place 1 pym counters on a Size Manipulation. If you cannot, seek a copy of Size Manipulation upgrade from your deck and put it into play. “insert quote.”

200501a.Name: Wasp
200501a.text: You can only change form by card abilities. Bumble Bee — Response: After you change to this form, confuse a minon. You may spend a [mental] resource → confuse the villain instead. “This is my GOOD COP impression.”

200501c.Name: Wasp
200501c.text: You can only change form by card abilities. Man-Mountain — Response: After you change to this form, stun a minon. You may spend a [physical] resource → stun the villain instead. “This is my GOOD COP impression.”

200502.Name: Ant-Man
200502.text: [star] Ant-Man gets +1 ATK and +1 THW for each pym counter on him (to a maximum of +3 TW+HW and +3 ATK.). Action: Exhaust a Size Manipulation → move 1 pym counter from it to here. Action: Discard this card → change form. “It's time to play hero! For a little while at least.”

200503.Name: Gigantification
200503.text: Play only if you are in [[tiny]] hero form. Hero Action (attack): Change to [[giant]] hero form. Deal 4 damage to an enemy, ignoring the guard keyword. Hero Interrupt (defense): When an enemy attacks, change to [[giant]] hero form. Give your hero a tough status card.

200504.Name: Resize at Will
200504.text: Action: Change form. Then, if you are in:

200507.Name: Self-Shrinking
200507.text: Play only if you are in [[giant]] hero form. Hero Action (thwart): Change to [[tiny]] hero form. Remove 3 threat from a scheme, ignoring the patrol keyword. Hero Interrupt (defense): When an enemy initiates an attack against you, change to [[tiny]] hero form and cancel that attack.

200508.Name: Pym Particles
200508.text: Response: After you spend this card, ready each Size Manipulation upgrade you control and place a total of 2 pym counters on them. If no pym counters were placed this way, change form.

200510.Name: Infinite Avengers Mansion
200510.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust this card → place 1 pym counter on a card you control and shuffle 1 identity-specific card from your discard pile into your deck. “My god...This place goes on forever.” —Stature

200511.Name: Jocasta
200511.text: Wasp gets +1 THW. Alter-ego Response: After you change to alter-ego form, ready your identity. (Limit once per phase.) “Because of you, I believe in the impossible.” —Hank Pym

200512.Name: Bio-Synthetic Wings
200512.text: While you are in [[tiny]] hero form, Wasp gains the [[aerial]] trait. Hero Action (thwart): Exhaust this card → remove X threat from among schemes, where X is equal to the number of times you have changed form this turn. “EMBIGGEN!” —Ms. Marvel

200513.Name: Huge Surprise
200513.text: Hero Action: Discard this card → choose an enemy. Until the end of the round, the chosen enemy loses steady and stalwart. After that enemy is stunned or confused, it takes 4 damage. “PSYCH!” —Wasp

200514.Name: Size Manipulation
200514.text: Enters play with 2 pym counters on it. Resource: Exhaust this card and remove 1 pym counter from here → generate a [wild] resource. Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 pym counter from here → change form. “EMBIGGEN!” —Ms. Marvel

200516.Name: The Stinger
200516.text: Hero Action (attack): Exhaust this card → deal 1+X damage divided among enemies you choose, where X is equal to the number of times you have changed form this turn. “The Stinger. It focuses my bio-energy into a powerful stun beam” —Wasp

200517.Name: Identity Crisis
200517.text: Forced Response: After you change form, place 1 crisis counter here. Then, if there are 5 or more crisis counters here, find Shadow of the Past and reveal it. If you cannot, place 3 pursuit counters on Pursued by the Past. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Hank Pym and choose to take 1 damage or place 1 threat on the main scheme for each crisis counter here → discard this obligation.

200518.Name: Return of the Prodigal Son
200518.text: Forced Response: After the player phase ends, place 1 seize counter here. Then, if there are 2 or more seize counters here, remove all seize counters from here and place the upgrade or support in play with the highest cost facedown under here. [star]Boost: Reveal this card.

200519.Name: Ultron
200519.text: Stalwart. Villainous. When Revealed: Find the set-aside Seized Control attachment and reveal it. If you cannot, Seek a [[hacked]] card from the encounter deck and reveal it. (Wasp’s nemesis minion.) [star]Boost: Exhaust an upgrade you control.

200520.Name: Seized Control
200520.text: Attach to Ultron. Otherwise, attach to the villain When Revealed: Place the card you control with the lowest cost facedown under this card. Otherwise, discard this card. Forced Interrupt: When the attached character would take any amount of damage, place it here instead. Then, if there is at least X damage here, discard this card. X is equal to the resource cost of the card placed under here.

200521.Name: Take Over Signal
200521.text: Treat attached ally as a [[hacked]] minion with a blank text box. Attached minion's SCH is equal to its printed THW and it does not take consequential damage. When Revealed: Attach to the ally you control with the hightest cost. Otherwise, seek an ally from your deck. Put that ally into play engaged with you with Take Over Signal attached to it.

200522.Name: Submit or Perish
200522.text: When Revealed: Exhaust each upgrade you control. If fewer than 2 upgrades were exhausted this way, search the encounter deck and discard pile for the Ultron minion and put it into play engaged with you. Otherwise, this card gains surge.

253001b.Name: Agent du S.H.I.E.L.D.
253001b.text: Lors de la construction de votre deck, vous ne pouvez inclure que que des alliés du set Asset of [[s.h.i.e.l.d.]] jusqu'à un maximum de 8. Mise en place : défaussez des cartes du dessus de votre deck jusqu'à ce que vous défaussiez un allié, ensuite, mettez en jeu cet allié sous votre contrôle.

253001a.Name: Agent du S.H.I.E.L.D.
253001a.text: Réserve stratégique — Ressource : inclinez une carte [[s.h.i.e.l.d.]] → générez une ressource [wild] pour une carte [[s.h.i.e.l.d.]]. (Limite une fois par phase) Le S.H.I.EL.D. dispose de nombreux moyens de support et d'intervention.

253002.Name: Directeur du S.H.I.E.L.D.
253002.text: Attachez cette carte à un personnage ami unique. Le personnage attaché gagne le trait [[s.h.i.e.l.d.]] Action : inclinez Directeur du S.H.I.E.L.D et placez 1 menace sur une manigance → piochez 1 carte. "De quoi avez vous besoin?” — Tony

253003.Name: Quartier Général
253003.text: Action d'alter ego : inclinez Quartier Général → cherchez un allié [[s.h.i.e.l.d.]] dans les 5 cartes du dessus de votre deck et ajoutez-le à votre main. (Mélangez votre deck.) “Vous avez appelé ?" — Tony

253004.Name: Salle de Briefing
253004.text: Chaque joueur qui contrôle un allié [[s.h.i.e.l.d.]] augmente sa limite d’allié de 1. "Vous pensez qu'ils l'ont fait assez grand ?" — Miss Hulk

253005.Name: Le Hawk
253005.text: Réponse : après qu'un allié [[s.h.i.e.l.d.]] a quitté le jeu → retirez 1 menace d’une manigance. "Un porte-avions volant ? Vous plaisantez n'est-ce pas ?" — Jennifer Walters

253006.Name: Assistance Tactique
253006.text: Chaque joueur qui contrôle une carte [[s.h.i.e.l.d. ]]peut aider à payer le coût de cette carte. Action de héros : infligez 5 dégâts à un ennemi. Les joueurs qui ont payé pour cette carte peuvent infliger 1 dégât à un ennemi.

253009.Name: Surveillance Renforcée
253009.text: Chaque joueur qui contrôle une carte [[s.h.i.e.l.d. ]]peut aider à payer le coût de cette carte. Action de héros : retirez 3 menaces d'une manigance. Les joueurs qui ont payé pour cette carte peuvent retirer 1 menace d'une manigance.

253012.Name: Mission de Secours
253012.text: Max 1 par round. Action : défaussez des cartes du dessus de votre deck jusqu'à ce que vous défaussiez un allié [[s.h.i.e.l.d.]] Ensuite, ajoutez-le à votre main.

253014.Name: Assistance Médicale
253014.text: Chaque joueur qui contrôle une carte [[s.h.i.e.l.d. ]]peut aider à payer le coût de cette carte. Action : soignez 2 dégâts de n'importe quel personnage que vous contrôlez. Les joueurs qui ont payé pour cette carte peuvent répéter cette capacité.

253016.Name: Rapport de Mission
253016.text: Action : redressez chaque personnage [[s.h.i.e.l.d.]] que vous contrôlez. Toute cette paperasse est elle vraiment utile ?

253101.Name: Nick Fury
253101.text: Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. Réponse : après que Nick Fury a attaqué ou contré, défaussez des cartes du dessus de votre deck jusqu'à ce que vous défaussiez un soutien. Ensuite, ajoutez-le à votre main.

253102.Name: Maria Hill
253102.text: Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. Réponse : après que Maria Hill a contré, piochez 1 carte. “Croyez-le ou non, vous et moi voulons la même chose.”

253103.Name: Agent Coulson
253103.text: Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. Réponse : après que l'Agent Coulson a contré, cherchez une carte [[préparation]] dans votre deck ou votre pile de défausse et ajoutez-la à votre main. (Mélangez votre deck.) "Je vais faire s'effondrer ce bâtiment sur vous!"

253104.Name: Quake
253104.text: Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. Interruption : quand un ennemi manigance, inclinez Quake et infligez-lui 1 dégât → infligez 3 dégâts à cet ennemi. "Je vais faire s'effondrer ce bâtiment sur vous!"

253105.Name: Black Widow
253105.text: Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. Interruption : quand le mot-clé Renfort d'une carte Rencontre est censé être résolu, défaussez Black Widow → annulez le Renfort et piochez 2 cartes.

253106.Name: Agent 13
253106.text: Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. Réponse : après que l'Agent 13 a contré, retirez 1 menace d'une manigance. "Cap, vous avez dit qu'on se battrait comme une équipe! Je veux en être!"

253107.Name: Mockingbird
253107.text: Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. Interruption : quand un personnage [[s.h.i.e.l.d.]] est censé subir n'importe quelle quantité de dégâts, dépensez une ressource [physical] et renvoyez Mockingbird dans votre main → prévenez tous ces dégats.

253108.Name: Roz Solomon
253108.text: Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. Réponse : après que Roz Solomon a attaqué ou contré, regardez la carte du dessus du deck Rencontre. Défaussez cette carte ou remettez la sur le dessus du deck Rencontre.

253109.Name: Captain América
253109.text: Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. Ténacité. Interruption : quand Captain América défend, défaussez la carte du dessus du deck Rencontre. Pour chaque icône de boost ainsi défaussé, réduisez les dégâts subis par cette attaque de 1.

253110.Name: Hawkeye
253110.text: Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. Réponse : après qu’un sbire vous a engagé, inclinez Hawkeye et infligez lui 1 point de dégât → infligez 4 dégats à ce sbire.

253111.Name: Spider-Woman
253111.text: Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. Réponse : après que Spider-Woman a attaqué ou contré, défaussez Spider-Woman → désorientez un ennemi.

253112.Name: Jimmy Woo
253112.text: Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. Réponse: après que Jimmy Woo a attaqué → retirez 1 menace d’une manigance.

253113.Name: Dum Dum Dugan
253113.text: Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. Interruption : quand Dum Dum Dugan attaque, défaussez la carte du dessus du deck Rencontre. Pour chaque icône de boost ainsi défaussé, infligez 2 dégats supplémentaires.

253114.Name: Valentina Allegra de Fontaine
253114.text: Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. Interruption : quand Valentina Allegra de Fontaine contre, défaussez la carte du dessus du deck Rencontre. Pour chaque icône de boost ainsi défaussé, retirez 1 menace supplémentaire de cette manigance.

253115.Name: War Machine
253115.text: Jouez cette carte sous le contrôle de n'importe quel joueur. Réponse : après que War Machine a attaqué → infligez 1 dégât à chaque enemi.

253017.Name: Retour au Q.G.
253017.text: Action d’alter ego : inclinez votre identité et défaussez 1 carte prise au hasard dans votre main → défaussez cette obligation. [hazard]

253018.Name: Mise à Prix
253018.text: “Morris?! Putain, Qu’est-ce-que tu fais ? Il va nous faire perdre notre prime, ce con !” Une fois révélée : défaussez une carte du dessus de votre deck pour chaque allié et soutien [[individu ]]en jeu. [hazard]

400101.Name: Mind Stone
400101.text: Mind Stone enters play with 8 quest counters on it. Hero Action: Spend X [mental] resources → remove X quest counters from here. While Mind Stone has no quest counters on it, you gain + 3 THW and your basic thwart ignores [crisis] icon and patrol keyword.

400102.Name: Reality Stone
400102.text: Reality Stone enters play with 8 quest counters on it. Hero Action: Discard a card you control → remove X quest counters from here. Where X is the cost of the discarded card. While Reality Stone has no quest counters on it, your identity gets +2 hand size.

400103.Name: Soul Stone
400103.text: Soul Stone enters play with 8 quest counters on it. Hero Action: Spend X [wild] resources → remove X quest counters from here. While Soul Stone has no quest counters on it, you gain the [[psionic ]]trait and your attacks gain drain 2.

400104.Name: Space Stone
400104.text: Space Stone enters play with 8 quest counters on it. Hero Action: Spend X resources of any type → remove X quest counters from here. While Space Stone has no quest counters on it, increase your ally limit by 2 and reduce the cost of each ally you play by 2.

400105.Name: Time Stone
400105.text: Time Stone enters play with 8 quest counters on it. Hero Action: Spend X [energy] resources → remove X quest counters from here. While Time Stone has no quest counters on it, you gain + 3 DEF and retaliate 1.

400106.Name: Power Stone
400106.text: Mind Stone enters play with 8 quest counters on it. Hero Action: Spend X [physical] resources → remove X quest counters from here. While Mind Stone has no quest counters on it, you gain + 3 ATK and your basic attacks gain overkill.

500215.Name: Rabid Rodents
500215.text: Hunter Mode Only. Vermin and Vermine (Clone) gets +1 ATK. Forced Response: After a RAT minion enters play, place 1 threat on it.

500216.Name: Sting of the Scorpion
500216.text: Hunter Mode Only. Forced Response: After the villain phase ends, the first player chooses: • Place 1 wound counter on J. Jonah Jameson. • Discard cards from the encounter deck until an attachment is discarded. Reveal that card.

500217.Name: Cold-Blooded
500217.text: Hunter Mode Only. The target threat value of the main scheme is reduced by 1[per_hero] . Forced Response: After Curtis Connors activates against your hero, deal yourself 1 facedown encounter card.

500218.Name: Aerial Excellence
500218.text: Hunter Mode Only. Forced Response: After step one of the villain phase, place 1 threat on the main scheme for each identity without the AERIAL trait. Each identity with the AERIAL trait takes 2 indirect damage.

500219.Name: Master Trapper
500219.text: Hunter Mode Only. Forced Response: After step one of the villain phase, deal each player 1 facedown TRAP card. Forced Interrupt: When the TRAP discard pile is shuffled back into the TRAP deck, deal the first player 1 facedown encounter card.

Experience Cost 4.

Experience Cost 4.

500222.Name: Black Cat

500223.Name: Ka-Zar

500224.Name: Gibbon

500226.Name: Taunt
500226.text: Experience Cost 1. Hero Action: Give the villain up to three facedown boost cards. Draw 1 card for each facedown boost card given to the villain this way.

500227.Name: Stead Fast
500227.text: Experience Cost 3. Hero Interrupt: When you reveal an encounter card, spend a [physical] resource → cancel that encounter card's "When Revealed" effects.

500228.Name: Finish Them Off
500228.text: Experience Cost 2. Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. If that enemy was defeated this way, draw 2 cards.

500229.Name: fresh Tracks
500229.text: Experience Cost 2. Interrupt: When you thwart, increase the amount of threat that thwart removes by 2. If this thwart removes the last threat from a scheme, deal 1 damage to an enemy and draw 1 card.

500230.Name: Savage Land
500230.text: Experience Cost 4. Hero Action: Exhaust Savage Land and deal 1 damage to a hero or ally → that character gets +1 THW and +1 ATK until the end of the round.

500231.Name: Hunting Rifle
500231.text: Experience Cost 2. Restricted. Uses (3 ammo counters). Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Hunting Rifle and remove 1 ammo counter from it → deal 2 damage to an enemy. This attack gains ranged.

500232.Name: Hatchet

500233.Name: Hunterbot
500233.text: Experience Cost 3. Max 1 per player. Your hero gets +1 ATK. Forced Interrupt: When you would take any amount of damage, place it here instead. Then, if there is 3 or more damage here, discard Hunterbot.

500234.Name: Trap

500235.Name: In Hiding

500236.Name: Vermin

500237.Name: Lizard

500238.Name: Vermin

500239.Name: Scorpion
500239.text: [star] Response: After Scorpion attacks and damages an enemy, deal 1 damage to Scorpion → stun that enemy and deal 1 damage to it.

500240.Name: Lizard

[star] While you are in alter ego form, Lizard gets +3 THW.
[star] While you are in hero form, Lizard gets +3 ATK.

500243.Name: Captured!
500243.text: You cannot change form. Action: Exhaust your identity → discard Captured!

500244.Name: Hunted!

500245.Name: Poisoned!
500245.text: When Revealed: Choose to either spend a [energy] resource or take 2 damage.

500101.Name: Vermin

500102.Name: Vermin

500103.Name: Vermin
500103.text: [star] Forced Response: After Vermin activates against you, discard the top two cards of the encounter deck. Put each RAT minion that was discarded this way, into play engaged with you. Resolve the "Special" effect on Even More Rats.

500104a.Name: Rats and More Rats
500104a.text: Contents: Vermin (I) and Vermin (II). Vermin (II) and Vermin (III) in expert mode instead.) Vermin and Standard Encounter sets. One modular encounter set (recommended: Feral Instincts). Setup: Put the Even More Rats Environment into play. Put a Regular Rats minion into play engaged with each player. Shuffle the encounter deck. Advance to stage 1B.

500104b.Name: Rats and More Rats

500105b.Name: Rats, Rats and More Rats

500108.Name: Feral Rats
500108.text: Surge. Quickstrike. X is equal to the number of RAT minions engaged with you (to a maximum of 3). [star] Boost: Put Feral Rats into play engaged with you.

500109.text: Guard. While Vermin Clone is engaged with you, characters you control cannot attack Regular Rats and Feral Rats. [star] Boost: Give the attacking enemy an additional boost card for this activation.

500110.text: Attach to your identity. Each Rat minion engaged with you gains guard. Interrupt: After you defeat a RAT minion engaged with you, discard 2 cards from your hand → discard this card.

500112.Name: Bringer of Plague

500113.text: When Revealed: Discard X cards from the encounter deck, where X is equal to double the villain's stage number. For each RAT minion discarded this way, choose to either place 2 threat on the main scheme or put that minion into play engaged with you.

500114.Name: Rabid Assault
500114.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Vermin schemes. If there are no RAT minions engaged with you, this card gains surge. When Revealed (Hero): Vermin attacks you. If there are no RAT minions engaged with you, this card gains surge.

500115.Name: A thousand Bites
500115.text: When Revealed: For each RAT minion engaged with you, choose to either place 1 threat on that minion, or take 1 indirect damage. Resolve the "Special" effect on Even More Rats. If there is one or no Rat minions engaged with you, this card gains surge.

500116.Name: Feral Instincts
500116.text: Attach to the villain. [star] Forced Interrupt: When the villain would scheme against you, it attacks you instead. This attack gains overkill. Do not give the villain a boost card for this activation. Then, discard Feral Instincts.

500117.Name: Primal Strength
500117.text: Attach to the villain. X is equal to the villain's stage number. [star] Interrupt: When the villain attacks you, choose to either spend [physical] [physical] resources or exhaust your identity → discard Primal Strength.

500118.Name: Unleashed Beast
500118.text: When Revealed: The villain attacks you. If you are in alter-ego form, do not give the villain a boost card for this activation. [star] Boost: This card gets +1 Boost icon ( [boost] ) if this activation is an attack.

500119.Name: Cornered Animal
500119.text: When Revealed: You take 1 damage. If the villain has taken 6[per_hero] or more damage, choose to either spend a [energy] resource or take 2 indirect damage. If the villain has taken 12[per_hero] or more damage, choose to either discard a random card from your hand or place 2 threat on the main scheme.

500120.Name: Scorpion
500120.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When the villain phase ends, if Scorpion's Tail is not attached to Scorpion, put it into play and attach it to Scorpion.

500121.Name: Scorpion

One modular encounter set (recommended: Feral Instincts). Setup: Put the J. Jonah Jameson support into play. Put the Scorpion's Tail into play and attach it to Scorpion. Shuffle the encounter deck. Advance to stage 1B.

500123b.Name: Thirst for Revenge
500123b.text: When Completed: Place 1 wound counter on the J. Jonah Jameson support.

500124b.Name: Vengeful Poursuit
500124b.text: Forced Interrupt: When this scheme would be completed, place 1 wound counter on the J. Jonah Jameson support instead. Then, remove all threat from this scheme and any upgrades and attachments attached to it.

500125.Name: J. Jonah Jameson
500125.text: Permanent. Interrupt: When a friendly character would take any amount of damage, place 1 wound counter here → prevent all of that damage. Forced Interrupt: When there are 3 + 1[per_hero] or more wound counters here, the players lose the game.

500126.Name: Scorpion's Tail
500126.text: [star] Forced Response: After Scorpion attacks and damages a character, that character is stunned. If that character is already stunned, deal 1 damage to that character. Interrupt: When Scorpion would take any amount of damage, it may be placed here instead. Then, if there is 10[per_hero] or more damage here, set Scorpion's Tail aside, out of play. Then, Scorpion takes 8[per_hero] damage.

500127.Name: Tail Armor
500127.text: Move 5 damage from Scorpion's Tail to Scorpion. Attach to Scorpion's Tail. If you cannot, this card gains surge. Forced Interrupt: When damage would be placed on Scorpion's Tail, place it here instead. If there is 8 or more damage here, discard Tail Armor.

500129.Name: Tail Laser
500129.text: Move 5 damage from Scorpion's Tail to Scorpion. Attach to Scorpion's Tail. If you cannot, this card gains surge. Forced Interrupt: When Scorpion attacks, the attack gains ranged and overkill. [star] Boost: Shuffle this card into the encounter deck.

500130.Name: Coiled Up
500130.text: Move 5 damage from Scorpion's Tail to Scorpion. If Scorpion's Tail is attached to Scorpion, attach Coiled Up to your identity. If you cannot, this card gains surge. Forced Interrupt: When Scorpion's Tail is set aside, discard Coiled up.

500131.text: Forced Interrupt: When Human Fly would take any amount of damage from an attack, prevent all of that damage. (Limit once per round.) [star] Boost: After this activation ends, deal yourself this card as a facedown encounter card.
