500786.text: Incite Rebellion - Hero Action: Choose to either exhaust your hero or spend 2 resources of any type → choose 1 PLANET environment in play. Treat its printed text box as if it were blank until the end of the round. (Limit once per round per player.)

500787.Name: Skrull Empire II
500787.text: When Revealed: Shuffle each set-aside Overthrow into the encounter deck. Incite Rebellion - Hero Action: Choose to either exhaust your hero or spend 2 resources of any type → choose 1 PLANET environment in play. Treat its printed text box as if it were blank until the end of the round. (Limit once per round per player.)

500788.Name: Skrull Empire III
500788.text: When Revealed: Shuffle each set-aside Overthrow into the encounter deck. Incite Rebellion - Hero Action: Choose to either exhaust your hero or spend 2 resources of any type → choose 1 PLANET environment in play. Treat its printed text box as if it were blank until the end of the round. (Limit once per round per player.)

202001b.Name: Tony Stark
202001b.text: Haven of Peace — Forced Response: After you change to this form, remove each nanite counters from Tony Stark. You may shuffle 1 identity-specific card from your discard pile into your deck for each counter removed this way. (to a maximum of 3.) “I love you three thousand” - Morgan Stark

202001a.Name: Iron Man
202001a.text: Nanotechnology — Hero Response: After you play an identity-specific card, place 1 nanite counter on Iron Man. “And I.. Am... Iron Man.”

202002.Name: Rescue
202002.text: Response: After you play Rescue from your hand, search your discard pile for an identity-specific event and add it to your hand.

202003.Name: F.R.I.D.A.Y.
202003.text: Hero Action: Exhaust F.R.I.D.A.Y. and remove 1 nanite counter from Iron Man → look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 to your hand, put 1 on the top of your deck and discard the last one. “The targeting system is broken boss!” —F.R.I.D.A.Y.

202004.Name: Tony Stark's villa
202004.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Tony Stark's villa → heal 2 damage from your identity.

202005.Name: Mark LXX Armor
202005.text: You get +4 hit points. Hero Action: Exhaust Mark LXX Armor and remove 1 nanite counter from Iron Man → ready your identity.

202006.Name: Repulsor Blast
202006.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. This attack gains ranged. If this attack defeats an enemy, you may remove 1 nanite counter from Iron Man → deal 4 damage to an enemy.

202009.Name: Micro-Missile Barrage
202009.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. You may remove 2 nanite counters from Iron Man → confuse the villain.

202011.Name: Shield Generation
202011.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage, remove 1 nanite counter from Iron Man → prevent 3 of that damage and draw 1 card.

202013.Name: Arc Reactor
202013.text: Hero Interrupt: When you make a basic attack, exhaust Arc Reactor and remove 1 nanite counter from Iron Man → for this attack, you get +2 ATK and this attack gains piercing and overkill.

202014.Name: System Reset
202014.text: Hero Action: Ready Mark LXX Armor, Arc Reactor, F.R.I.D.A.Y. and each Nanite Manipulation you control.

202015.Name: Nanite Manipulation
202015.text: Hero Resource: Exhaust Nanite Manipulation → generate a [energy] resource for an identity-specific card. Hero Action: Exhaust Nanite Manipulation → place 1 nanite counter on Iron Man.

202017.Name: Damaged armor
202017.text:
Remove all nanite counters from Iron Man. Take 1 damage for each counter removed this way. If you take damage from this effect → remove Damaged Armor from the game.
If no counters were removed by this effect, take 2 damage and discard this obligation.

202018.Name: Crimson Dynamo
202018.text: Toughness. Retaliate 1. [star] Forced Response: After Crimson Dynamo attacks and damages Iron Man, remove 1 nanite counter from him. (Iron Man’s nemesis minion.)

202019.Name: Armor Wars
202019.text: The Crimson Dynamo appears to show once and for all that he has the best armor. Hinder 1[per_hero]. While Armor Wars is in play, treat the printed text box of Iron Man as if it were blank (except for [[traits]]).

202020.Name: Darkstar
202020.text: When Revealed: Discard 5 cards from the encounter deck. If Vanguard was discarded by this effect, put him into play engaged with you. Otherwise, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a minion and put it into play engaged with you, then shuffle the encounter deck.

202021.Name: Vanguard
202021.text: Guard. Toughness. Armored 2. (Reduce the amount of damage this character takes from each attack by 2.) [star] Boost: Put Vanguard into play engaged with you.

202022.Name: Shock
202022.text: When Revealed: Deal 2 damage to the Iron Man player and remove 1 nanite counter from Iron Man’s identity. [star] Boost: If this activation deals damage to a friendly character, stun that character.

500793.Name: Skrullos
500793.text: Each side scheme gains the crisis icon ([crisis icon]).

500794.Name: Tarnax II
500794.text: Decrease the target threat value of the main scheme by 1[per_hero] .

500795.Name: Tarnax IV
500795.text: While a side scheme is in play, this card gains the amplify icon ([amplify]).

500797.Name: Zaragz'na
500797.text: Each ally and support enters play exhausted.

500798.Name: Impostor
500798.text: Treat attached ally as a SKRULL minion with a blank text box. Attached minion's SCH is equal to its printed THW and it does not take consequential damage. When revealed: Attach to the non-SKRULL ally with the most remaining hit points without Impostor attached. Attached ally engages its controller. Otherwise, the villain schemes.

500799.Name: Intelligentsia
500799.text: Each other SKRULL enemy gets +1 SCH. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Intelligentsia would attack, she schemes instead. [acceleration]

500800.Name: Emperor's Throne
500800.text: When Defeated: The villain attacks the player who defeated this scheme (even if that player is in alter-ego form). Give the villain 1 additional boost card for this activation. [acceleration] [hazard]

500802.Name: A New Skrull Is Born
500802.text: When Revealed: Discard cards from the encounter deck until you discard a SKRULL minion and reveal it.

500803.Name: Giving Orders
500803.text: When Revealed: Each SKRULL minion activates against the player it is engaged with. If no minion activated this way, this card gains surge.

500804.Name: Long Live the Empire
500804.text: When Revealed: Heal 2 damage from the villain for each SKRULL enemy in play. If no damage was healed this way, this card gains surge. [star] Boost: Heal 1 damage from the villain for each SKRULL enemy in play.

500805.Name: Overthrow
500805.text: When Revealed: Remove the current villain from the game and reveal the top card of the villain deck. Then, set Overthrow aside, out of play. [star] Boost: Deal this card to yourself as a facedown encounter card.

500806.Name: Wrath of the Empire
500806.text: When Revealed: Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck for each PLANET environment in play. Place 1 acceleration token on the main scheme, if a card with the acceleration icon ([acceleration]) was discarded this way. [star] Boost: This card gets +1 boost icon ( [boost] ) for each PLANET environment in play.

999901a.Name: Stan Lee
999901a.text: Stan Lee can be used to create any character's deck.

999901b.Name: Stan Lee
999901b.text: Stan Lee can be used to create any character's deck.

210201a.Name: Spider-Man Noir
210201a.text: Araignée Vaudou — Interruption : quand une carte de rencontre vous est attribué, placez X jeton infos sur une manigance où X est le nombre de manigance annexe joueur de Spider-Man Noir dans la pile de Victoire plus 1. (limite 1 fois par round.) “Spider-man est là maintenant”. Terre-90214

210201b.Name: Peter B. Parker
210201b.text: Mise en place : trouver l’amélioration Journaliste et mettez-là en jeu sous votre contrôle. Journaliste du Bugle — Action : placez 1 jeton Infos sur une manigance (Limite d’une fois par round).

210202.Name: Journaliste
210202.text: Permanent. Mise en place. Action d’alter ego : inclinez Journaliste → cherchez dans votre deck, votre pile de défausse ou la pile de victoire une manigance annexe de joueur de Spider-Man Noir et mettez-là en jeu. (Mélangez votre deck).

210203.Name: Toile Organique
210203.text: Ressource de héros : inclinez Toile Organique → générez une ressource [wild]. “Accroche toi à tes dents !” -Spider-Man Noir.

210204.Name: Revolver de Ben Parker
210204.text: Utilisations (6 jetons Balle). Action de héros (attaque) : à distance. Retirez 1 jeton Balle du Revolver de Ben Parker et inclinez-le → infligez 2 dégâts à un ennemi. Dépensez X jeton Balle pour infliger X dégat supplémentaire à cet ennemi.

210205.Name: Home Sweet Home
210205.text: Action d’alter ego : inclinez Home Sweet Home → soignez 3 dégâts de Peter B. Parker. “Joyeux anniversaire tante May !” -Peter.

210206.Name: Agir dans l’Ombre
210206.text: Action : infligez 2 dégâts à un ennemi. Vous pouvez retirer 1 jeton Infos d’une manigance pour infligez 1 dégât supplémentaire à cet ennemi. “La discretion est essentielle pour y arriver.”

210207.Name: Intervention Musclée
210207.text: Action de héros (attaque/contre) : infligez 5 dégâts à un ennemi. Retirez 1 jeton Infos d’une manigance → retirez 2 menaces d’une manigance.

210208.Name: Observation
210208.text: 1 max par round. Action de héros (contre) : placez 2 jetons Infos sur chaque manigance en jeu. Retirez 1 menace par jeton Infos sur chaque manigance en jeu. Ensuite retirez tous les jetons Infos de la manigance principale et des manigances permanentes.

210209.Name: Surveillance de la Ville
210209.text: Interruption de héros (défense) : quand Spider-Man Noir est censé subir des dégâts, défaussez Surveillance de la Ville → prévenez 3 de ces dégâts. Placez 1 jeton Infos sur une manigance. “Il est temps de faire le ménage dans cette ville.” -Spider-Man Noir.

210210.Name: Article sur les Rackets
210210.text: Entrave 1[per_hero]. Victoire 0. Cette manigance ne compte pas dans la limite de manigance annexe joueur. Une fois déjouée : les joueurs piochent X carte répartie entre eux, X étant le nombre de jetons Infos qui étaient présents sur cette manigance plus 1 (maximum 5).

210211.Name: Article sur la Prostitution
210211.text: Entrave 1[per_hero]. Victoire 0. Cette manigance ne compte pas dans la limite de manigance annexe joueur. Une fois déjouée : les joueurs mélangent X carte répartie entre eux de leur pile de défausse dans leur deck, X étant le nombre de jetons Infos qui étaient présents sur cette manigance plus 1 (maximum 5).

210212.Name: Article sur la Drogue
210212.text: Entrave 1[per_hero]. Victoire 0. Cette manigance ne compte pas dans la limite de manigance annexe joueur. Une fois déjouée : les joueurs soignent un total de X dégât parmi les personnages qu'ils contrôlent, X étant le nombre de jetons Infos qui étaient présents sur cette manigance plus 1. (maximum 5).

210213.Name: Face à l’Horreur
210213.text:
Vous pouvez passer sous forme d'alter ego. Choisissez :
Inclinez Peter B. Parker → retirez Face à l’Horreur de la partie.
Vous êtes désorienté. Cette carte gagne Renfort. Défaussez cette obligation.

210214.Name: Electro Choque
210214.text: Electro surgit de nulle part. Une fois révélée : vous êtes sonné. Désorientez chaque allié que vous contrôlez. [amplify]

210215.Name: Electro Noir
210215.text: [star] Vous pouvez répartir les dégâts infligés par l’attaque d’Electro Noir entre les personages que vous contrôlez comme s’ils étaient indirects. (Sbire nemesis de Spider-Man Noir.)

210216.Name: Initier l’Etincelle
210216.text: Une fois révélée : vous êtes sonné. Si vous étiez déjà sonné, vous êtes désorienté.

210217.Name: A sa Merci
210217.text: Une fois révélée : inclinez votre identité. Si vous ne pouvez pas cette carte gagne Renfort.

202101a.Name: Thor
202101a.text: Worthy — Action: Search your deck and discard pile for the Mjolnir upgrade and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per round.) “There must always be a Thor.”

202101b.Name: Jane Foster
202101b.text: Survivor — Jane Foster gets +1 hand size while her Chemotherapy obligation is set aside or removed from the game. Physician — Action: Heal 1 damage from another friendly character. (Limit once per round.)

202102.Name: Roz Solomon
202102.text: [star] Interrupt: When Roz Solomon thwarts, exhaust Congress of Worlds or a [[s.h.i.e.l.d.]] card you control → she gets +2 THW for that use. “Let's all remember the most important objective here... nobody break my earpieces. Those things aren't cheap.”

202103.Name: Hammer Swing
202103.text: Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Mjolnir and spend 1 resource of any type → deal 4 damage to an enemy. Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage, exhaust Mjolnir → prevent all of that damage.

202104.Name: Lightning Strike
202104.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 6 damage to an enemy and 1 damage to each enemy engaged with you. If you paid for this card using only [energy] resources, stun an enemy. “I command the lightning and the thunder!” —Thor

202105.Name: Stand Fast
202105.text: Hero Action: Ready Thor and Mjolnir. If you paid for this card using only [energy] resources, give Thor a tough status card. “You shall not take this city! Not while Thor yet lives!”

202106.Name: Congress of Worlds
202106.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Congress of Worlds and spend 1 resource of any type → remove 2 threat from the main scheme or 3 threat from a side scheme. “Is this the congress of worlds, or a confederation of cowards?” —Senator from Alfheim

202107.Name: Medical Clinic
202107.text: Jane Foster gets +2 REC. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Medical Clinic and spend 1 resource → heal 3 damage from an identity. “Let us worry about the other patients, doctor.”

202108.Name: Scrying Pool
202108.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Scrying Pool → look at the top card of a deck. You may discard that card. If a treachery was looked at this way, remove 1 threat from a scheme. If an event was looked at from a player deck this way, that player draws 1 card.

202109.Name: Goddess of Thunder
202109.text: Hero Resource: Exhaust Goddess of Thunder → generate a [energy] resource, or [energy][energy] resources instead for a Thor card. “Stand down, or you too will know the wrath of the goddess of thunder!” —Thor

202110.Name: Mighty
202110.text: You get +2 hit points. Thor gets +1 DEF and gains retaliate 1. “You came here seeking battle. Battle you have found!” —Thor

202111.Name: Mjolnir
202111.text: Restricted. Thor gets +1 ATK and gains the [[aerial]] trait. Hero Action (attack): Discard Mjolnir → deal 2 damage to an enemy. This attack gains ranged.

202112.Name: Unyielding
202112.text: Hero Response (thwart): After you are attacked and take no damage, exhaust Unyielding → remove 2 threat from a scheme. You may spend 1 resource of any type to ready your hero.

202113.Name: Chemotherapy
202113.text:
Change to alter-ego form. Choose:
Exhaust Jane Foster and Medical Clinic → remove Chemotherapy from the game.
Discard 2 cards from your hand or take 2 damage. Discard this obligation.

202114.Name: War of the Realms
202114.text: Malekith's scheming and manipulation has brought war to all of the known realms. His armies must be defeated, but there will be many casualties. When Revealed: Each player takes 1 indirect damage for each character they control. [hazard]

202115.Name: Malekith
202115.text: [star] Forced Response: After Malekith activates, each player takes 1 indirect damage. (Thor's nemesis minion.)

202116.Name: War Witches
202116.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When War Witches would attack, they scheme instead. Forced Response: After threat is placed on the main scheme, the engaged player takes 1 indirect damage.

202117.Name: Execute
202117.text: When Revealed: Defeat the ally in play with the highest remaining hit points. If no ally was defeated this way, this card gains surge.

202118.Name: Hostile Takeover
202118.text: When Revealed: Choose to either discard the support you control with the highest cost or take damage equal to its cost (this damage ignores tough status cards). If no support was discarded and no damage was taken this way, this card gains surge.

261901a.Name: Singularity
261901a.text: Pocket Universe — Action: Place an ally in play facedown under Singularity. (Max 3 cards. Limit once per phase.) Action: Play an ally under Singularity as if they were in you hand, or put a minion under Singularity into play engaged with any player.

261901b.Name: Singularity
261901b.text: Memories from Arcadia's effect applies during deck building. Childlike Curiosity — Action: Discard a card from your hand → draw a card. (Limit once per round.)

261902.Name: Memories from Arcadia
261902.text: Permanent. Setup. Characters named Captain Marvel, Dazzler, Medusa, She-Hulk and Sister Grimm gain the A-FORCE trait. You may include A-FORCE allies from any aspect in your deck.

261903.Name: Sister Grimm
261903.text: Response: After Sister Grimm takes damage and isn't defeated, play an event from your hand ignoring all costs and trait restrictions, then remove that event from the game.

261904.Name: Smile
261904.text: Resource: Exhaust Smile → generate a [wild] resource for an ally or ally ability.

261905.Name: Fight
261905.text: Interrupt: When an ally attacks, exhaust Fight → give that ally +2 ATK for that attack.

261906.Name: Give
261906.text: Interrupt: When an ally thwarts, exhaust Give → give that ally +2 THW for that thwart.

261907.Name: Feel
261907.text: Response: After an ally is defeated by consequential damage, exhaust Feel → place that ally facedown under Singularity (max 3 cards).

261909.Name: Blink Away
261909.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When an enemy attacks, prevent all damage that would be dealt to any character during that attack. Then remove 1 threat from a scheme for each ally under Singularity.

261910.Name: Portal Production
261910.text: Hero Action: Choose one: • Deal 3 damage to an enemy. • Remove 2 threat from a scheme ignoring [crisis] icons and the patrol keyword. • Search your deck for an ally and put it under Singularity.

261911.Name: Sweep Away
261911.text: Hero Action: Place X non-ELITE minions under Singularity (max 3 cards under Singulaity).

261912.Name: Quantum Detonation
261912.text: Hero Action (attack): Discard any number of cards under Singularity. For each card discarded this way, deal 3 damage to an enemy. Then flip to alter-ego. Until the end of this phase you cannot play events or change form.

261913.Name: Cosmic Expansion
261913.text: Hero Action: Put all allies under Singularity into play under your control. (These cards don't count as having been played from hand.)

261914.Name: Self Actualisation
261914.text: Hero Action (attack/thwart): For each MEMORY and ally you control choose one: • Deal 1 damage to an enemy. • Remove 1 threat from a scheme.

261915.Name: Dazzler Thor
261915.text: Response: After you play Dazzler Thor, stun and confuse a minion for each [energy] resource spent to play her.

261916.Name: Medusa
261916.text: [star] Response: After Medusa thwarts, remove 1 threat from a scheme. [star] Response: After Medusa attacks, deal 1 damage to an enemy.

261917.Name: A-Force Assemble!
261917.text: Max 1 per round. Hero Action: Ready each A-FORCE character you control. Until the end of the phase, each A-FORCE character in play gets +1 THW and +1 ATK.

261918.Name: Impossible A-Force
261918.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 TEAM card per player. Each of your A-FORCE allies gets +1 hit point. If all of your characters have the A-FORCE trait, each ally you control gets +1 THW and +1 ATK.

261919.Name: Anything Anywhere
261919.text: Team-Up (Singularity and Sister Grimm). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Defeat a minion and defeat a side scheme. Remove Anything Anywhere from the game.

261920.Name: Communication Issues
261920.text: Give to the Singularity player. Each ally you play cost 1 additional resource. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Singularity and an ally you control → remove Communication Issues from the game.

261921.Name: Antimatter
261921.text: When Revealed: Antimatter engages Singularity. Forced Interrupt: When Antimatter would take damage from an attack, deal 1 damage to the attacking character. (Singularity's nemesis minion.)

261922.Name: Violent Rebirth
261922.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard for Antimatter and reveal him. Forced Response: After Antimatter is defeated, deal him to Singularity as a facedown encounter card.

261923.Name: Destructive Analysis
261923.text: When Revealed: Discard a card you control. Place threat on the main scheme equal to the cost of that card. If that card costs 0, this card gains surge.

261924.Name: Antimatter Blast
261924.text: When Revealed: Deal 2 damage to each character you control. [star] Boost: Deal 1 damage to each character you control.

202201a.Name: Stature
202201a.text: Regulate — Action: Discard a card from your hand → draw 2 cards. (Limit once per round.)

202201b.Name: Cassie Lang
202201b.text: Cycling — Action: Discard up to 3 cards from your hand → Cassie Lang gets +X REC until the end of the turn, where X is the number of cards discarded this way.

202201c.Name: Stature (Tiny)
202201c.text: Lightweight — [star] While your hand is empty, Stature gets +1 THW.

202201d.Name: Stature (Giant)
202201d.text: Heavy-Handed — [star] Stature gets +1 ATK for every 2 cards in your hand in excess of your hand size.

202202.Name: Iron Lad
202202.text: Iron Lad enters play with 4 time counters. Action: Remove a time counter from here → draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)

202203.Name: Double Decker
202203.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. Then, deal X damage to that enemy, where X is the number of cards remaining in your hand after playing this card that exceed your printed hand size.

202204.Name: Rapid Stomp
202204.text: Hero Interrupt (attack): When you make a basic ATK, change to your [[Giant]] hero form and deal X damage to the villain and up to 2 minions engaged with you instead, where X is equal to your ATK.

202205.Name: Let Loose
202205.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove X threat (to a maximum of 6) divided among schemes as you choose. If this removes the last threat on 2 or more schemes, draw 2 cards.

202206.Name: Sliding Scale
202206.text: Hero Action: You get +1 hand size until the end of the phase. You may spend up to 5 resources → you get +1 additional hand size until the end of the phase for each resource paid this way.

202207.Name: Pym Particles
202207.text: Hero Response: After you spend this card, heal 2 damage from your hero if you are in [[Giant]] hero form or draw 1 card if you are in [[Tiny]] hero form.

202208.Name: "Young Avenger"
202208.text: Hero Response: After an ally you control with the [[Young Avenger]] or [[Avenger]] trait attacks or thwarts, exhaust "Young Avenger" → draw 1 card.

202209.Name: Family Resemblance
202209.text: Hero Response: After you change to your: • [[Giant]] hero form → deal 1 damage to an enemy. • [[Tiny]] hero form → remove 1 threat from a scheme.

202210.Name: Re-Resize
202210.text: Hero Action: Discard a card from your hand and exhaust Re-Resize → change to another hero form. Draw 1 card.

202211.Name: Size Tactics
202211.text: Hero Interrupt: When you play a card that shares a trait with your hero, exhaust Size Tactics → draw 1 card.

202212.Name: Nothing Lasts Forever
202212.text: Give to the Cassie Lang player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: • Summon Iron Lad → remove him and this obligation from the game. • You cannot be in [[Giant]] or [[Tiny]] hero form until the next villain phase. Discard this card.

202213.Name: Growing Man
202213.text: [star] Growing Man cannot take more than 1 damage from each instance of damage and his ATK is equal to his remaining hit points. When Defeated: Remove Growing Man from the game. (Stature's nemesis minion.)

202214.Name: Something is Off...
202214.text: Forced Response: After Growing Man takes damage from a player, summon a copy of Growing Man (Clone) and put it into play engaged with that player. Forced Response: After Growing Man is defeated, remove this side scheme from the game.

202215.Name: Growing Man (Clone)
202215.text: [star] Growing Man (Clone) cannot be attacked and his ATK and hit points are equal to Growing Man's remaining hit points. When Defeated: Remove this card from the game.

202401b.Name: Aldrif Odinsdottir
202401b.text: Setup: Search your deck and discard pile for a [[weapon]] card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. [star] Of Heven and Hel — Aldrif Odinsdottir gets +1 REC for each [[weapon]] you control.

202401a.Name: Angela
202401a.text: Frenzy — Response: After you defeat a minion, ready Angela. (Limit once per round.)

202403.Name: Heven's Fury
202403.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 7 damage to an enemy. You may exhaust a [[weapon]] you control. If you do, divide the damage among enemies in play instead.

202404.Name: Murderous Glare
202404.text: Response (thwart): After Angela attacks and defeats an enemy, remove 2 threat from a scheme. Remove 1 additional threat from that scheme for each minion you defeated this round.

202405.Name: Single Out
202405.text: Hero Interrupt: When a treachery card is revealed from the encounter deck, cancel its “When Revealed” effects. Search the encounter deck for a minion and put it into play engaged with any player.

202406.Name: Angelic Ribbons
202406.text: Angela gains steady. Hero Interrupt: When an enemy activates, discard this card → that enemy gets -X ATK and -X SCH for that activation, where X is Angela's ATK.

202407.Name: Asgard's Assassin
202407.text: Hero Resource: Exhaust Asgard's Assassin → generate a [physical] resource (if you defeated a minion this round, generate [wild] instead).

202408.Name: Siri's Dress
202408.text:
You get +4 hit points.
Angela gains the [[aerial]] trait.

202409.Name: Xiphos
202409.text: Restricted. Angela gets +1 ATK. Response: After Angela defeats a minion, draw a card. (Limit once per round.)

202410.Name: Banished from Asgard
202410.text:
You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose:
Exhaust Aldrif Odinsdottir → remove Banished from Asgard from the game.
Discard 1 [[asgard]] card you control. You are stunned. If no card was discarded this way, this card gains surge. Discard this obligation.

202411.Name: Hel's Retribution
202411.text: “Hela has come to settle her score with the Asgardian usurper.” When Revealed: Discard cards from the top of your deck equal to the number of [[asgard]] cards in play. [hazard]

202412.Name: Hela
202412.text: While there are other minions in play, Hela cannot take damage. Forced Interrupt: When you defeat a minion, discard a card from your hand. (Angela's nemesis minion.)

202413.Name: Hel-Wolf
202413.text: [star]The engaged player must defend against Hel-Wolf's attacks with an ally they control, if able. [star]Boost: This attack gains overkill.

202414.Name: Disir
202414.text: Forced Interrupt: When Disir would be defeated, shuffle them into the encounter deck instead. [star]Boost: After this activation ends, shuffle this card back into the encounter deck.

202415.Name: Back from Hel
202415.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter discard pile for the bottom most minion and reveal it. Boost: If you are engaged with a minion. this attack gains 1 additional boost icon ([boost]).

200601b.Name: Heimdall
200601b.text: Sentinel of Asgard — You may include [[asgard]] allies from any aspect in your deck. Action: Search your deck and discard pile for the Hofund upgrade and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.) “Even Blinded, I can see the truth, Sif..”

200601a.Name: Heimdall
200601a.text: God of Vigilance — Response: After a card you own prevents a minion from entering play, any amount of threat from being placed on a scheme or a friendly character from taking any amount of damage, remove 2 threat from a scheme. (Limit once per phase.)

200602.Name: Banishing Blow
200602.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. Flip The Bifrost to its [[closed]] side. Hero Interrupt: When a minion enters play, exhaust Hofund → discard that minion instead. If an [[elite]] minion was discarded this way, shuffle it into the encounter deck. Flip The Bifrost to its [[closed]] side. "I'll use telepathy to get a census--"

200603.Name: Cosmic Strike
200603.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 8 damage to an enemy. If The Bifrost is on its [[opened]] side, you may exhaust Hofund → this attack gains overkill and deal 2 damage to each other enemy. "Allfathers. Let the dark magic flow through me one last time." -Heimdall

200604.Name: "Get Me Out!"
200604.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When a friendly character would take any amount of damage from an attack, exhaust The Bifrost → prevent all of that damage. Flip The Bifrost to its [[opened]] side. If The Bifrost was already on its [[opened]] side, confuse the attacking enemy. "Allfathers. Let the dark magic flow through me one last time." -Heimdall

200605.Name: Heimdall's Observatory
200605.text: While Heimdall is in alter-ego form, he gets +2 REC. Alter-Ego Response: After you change form, exhaust this card → shuffle up to 2 allies from your discard pile into your deck. "You wish to know what I see?" -Heimdall

200606.Name: All-Hearing
200606.text: While Heimdall is in hero form, he gets +1 THW. Hero Interrupt: When any amount of threat would be placed on a scheme (except during step 1 of the villain phase), exhaust this card → prevent 1 of that threat. “I'm okay, guys. I'm still in Colossus's armored form...” —Synch

200607.Name: All-Seeing
200607.text: Hero Action: Exhaust this card → look at the top 1[per_hero] cards of the encounter deck. If you looked at any minion, you may put it into play engaged with you to remove 2 threat from a scheme. “I see WARS, Odinson.” —Heimdall

200608.Name: Gjallarhorn
200608.text: Each of your [[asgard]] allies costs 1 fewer resource to play. Hero Response: After an ally you control defeats a minion or a side scheme, draw 1 card. “The end is come! The horn is sounded!” —Freja

200609.Name: Guardian of the Rainbow Bridge
200609.text: While The Bifrost is on its [[opened]] side, Heimdall gains retaliate 1. While The Bifrost is on its [[closed]] side, Heimdall gains steady. Hero Interrupt: When a minion enters play, exhaust this card → ready Heimdall. “They shall not pass.” —Heimdall

200610.Name: Hofund
200610.text: While The Bifrost is on its [[opened]] side and Heimdall is in hero form, he gets +1 ATK. Hero Action: Exhaust this card and spend 1 resource of any type → flip The Bifrost. “I can always hear its call.” —Heimdall

200611.Name: Shared Vision
200611.text: Attach to a friendly character. Temporary. Attached character gets +2 THW. Interrupt: When the attached ally would take any amount of consequential damage, discard this card → prevent 1 of that damage. “See through NEW EYES." -Jane Foster

200612a.Name: The Bifrost
200612a.text: Permanent. Setup. Interrupt: When a minion would be revealed from a non-set aside area, give it to the villain as a facedown boost card instead (shuffle it into the encounter deck instead if it was an [[elite]] minion). Then, flip this card.

200612b.Name: The Bifrost
200612b.text: Permanent. The first minion revealed each round gains quickstrike. Hero Action: Exhaust this card → search your deck for an [[asgard]] ally (any ally instead if you also exhaust Hofund) and add it to your hand.

200613.Name: Overloaded Senses
200613.text: Treat the printed text box of your identity and each of your [[superpower]] upgrades as if they were blank (except for [[traits]]). Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Heimdall → remove Overloaded Senses from the game.

200614.Name: Judgement of All Gods
200614.text: Mangog was unleashed once again and raged that he would bring about the ultimate judgment upon the Asgardians. Supports cannot ready. The Bifrost cannot be flipped to its [[closed]] side. When Revealed: Exhaust each support. Flip The Bifrost to its [[opened]] side. [amplify]

200615.Name: Mangog
200615.text: Mangog entering play cannot be canceled. Triggered ability on The Bifrost cannot be resolved. [star]Mangog gets +1 ATK for each [[asgard]] character you control. (Heimdall's nemesis minion.) "Time for Gods to die screaming and wailing!"

200616.Name: Kingdom In Ruin
200616.text: When Revealed: Choose to either discard a support you control or take 1+X indirect damage, where X is equal to the printed cost of the support you control with the highest cost. Otherwise, this card gains surge. [star]Boost: Deal 2 damage to an ally you control.

200617.Name: Unquenchable Rage
200617.text: When Revealed: Find the Mangog minion and put him into play engaged with you. Then, Mangog attacks an ally you control (attacks you with +1 ATK instead if you do not control any ally). [star] Boost: Mangog attacks you after this activation.

800601a.Name: La Reine Blanche
800601a.text: Lance Psy - Action de héros : échangez 2 cartes d'état différentes entre 2 personnages (limite d'une fois par phase). Réponse forcée : après avoir joué une carte DIAMANT, donnez une carte tenace à votre identité. Après avoir joué une carte PSIONIQUE défaussez toute carte tenace de votre identité.

800601b.Name: Emma Frost
800601b.text: Réponse : après être passé sous cette forme, mélangez dans votre deck X cartes du set de la Reine Blanche depuis votre pile de défausse, X étant égal au nombre de carte de statut en jeu (Jusqu'à un maximum de 3).

800602.Name: Iron Man
800602.text: Ténacité. Réponse : après que Iron Man est entré en jeu, désorientez Iron Man → sonnez un ennemi.

800603.Name: Esmé
800603.text: Tant que cette carte est en jeu, les personnages Robuste sont Solide à la place. Vous pouvez activer "lance Psy" une fois supplémentaire par phase. Réponse : après avoir résolu Lance Psy, inclinez Esmé → redressez votre héros.

800604.Name: Les Maraudeurs
800604.text: Action de Héros : inclinez les Maraudeurs → pour chaque carte d'état en jeu sur un perosnnage ami choisissez: . Retirez une menace d'une manigance . Infligez un dégât à un ennemi . Retirez cette carte d'état

800605.Name: Sous Emprise
800605.text: Diminuez de 1 le cout de cette carte pour chaque carte d'état attaché à la cible. Sous forme de héros uniquement. Attachez cette carte à un ennemi. 1 max par ennemi. Interruption forcée : Quand l'ennemi attaché est censé attaquer, défaussez Sous Emprise et choisissez un personnage → les dégâts de cette attaque sont infligés au personnage choisi au lieu de vous être infligé.

800606.Name: Force Phénix
800606.text:
Votre identité gagne solide.
La Reine Blanche gagne +1 ATQ (Plus +2 ATQ à la place, tant qu'elle attaque un ennemi avec une carte d'état).

800607.Name: La Belle et la Pègre
800607.text: Action : donnez au méchant et à chaque sbire engagé avec vous une carte d'état tenace. Piochez une carte pour chaque carte d'état tenace ainsi donnée.

800608.Name: Egide Mentale
800608.text: Action de héros (contre) : sonnez un personnage ami → retirez X menaces d'une manigance, X étant égal au contre de base du personnage choisi. Vous pouvez incliner le personnage choisi → ignorez les icones de crise et patrouille pour cet évènement.

800609.Name: Déferlement Psionique
800609.text: Action de héros (attaque) : désorientez un personnage ami → infligez X dégâts à un ennemi, X étant égal à l'attaque de base du personnage choisi. Vous pouvez incliner le personnage choisi → cette attaque gagne Déferlement et inflige 3 dégats supplémentaires.

800610.Name: Dure comme le Diamant
800610.text: Interruption de héros (défense) : quand une carte de boost est retournée face visible lors d'une attaque, annulez toutes les icônes imprimées [boost] et [star] sur cette carte. Ensuite infligez 1 dégât à l'ennemi attaquant pour chacune de ces icônes annulée par cet effet.

800611.Name: Mariage Blanc
800611.text: En Equipe (Emma Frost et Tony Stark). 1 max par deck. Action d'alter ego : désorientez 2 personnages.

800612.Name: Une Affaire de Famille
800612.text: Donnez cette carte au joueur d'Emma Frost. Cherchez Esmé dans votre deck, main, pile de défausse ou zone de jeu et mettez-la de côté. Attachez-lui cette obligation. Tous les personnages deviennent robuste. Action d'alter ego: dépensez 3 ressources de n'importe quel type et retirez cette obligation de la partie → mettez Esmé en jeu sous le contrôle de son propriétaire

800613.Name: Feilong
800613.text: Robuste. Vilenie. Réponse forcée: après que Feilong est entré en jeu, défaussez tout allié Iron Man en jeu. (Sbire Némésis de la Reine Blanche.)

800614.Name: O.P.A. Hostile
800614.text:
Aucune menace ne peut être retiré de cette manigance tant que Feilong est en jeu.
Toutes les attaques enemies gagnent perçant

800615.Name: Sentinelle Stark
800615.text: Ténacité. Vulnérable. [star] Boost : attribuez-vous cette carte de boost en tant que carte Rencontre face cachée.

202501b.Name: Namor McKenzie
202501b.text: Deep: Namor McKenzie gets +2 REC. Symbol of Royalty — Setup: Search your deck and discard pile for Neptune's Trident and add it to your hand. (Shuffle.)

202501a.Name: Namor
202501a.text: Deep: Namor gets +1 THW, +1 ATK and +1 DEF. Arrogance — Forced Interrupt: When Namor is targeted by another friendly character's Action, discard 1 card from your hand.

202502.Name: Atlantean Skin
202502.text: Deep: Draw 1 card. Hero Action: Give your hero a tough status card.

202503.Name: Furious Strike
202503.text: Deep: Ready Namor. Hero Action (attack): Deal 7 damage to an enemy.

202504.Name: Imperius Rex!
202504.text: Hero Interrupt: When you use a basic power, get +1 to that power for this use. Then, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Add one to your hand and discard the other.

202505.Name: Royal Authority
202505.text: Deep: Remove 2 threat from a scheme. Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme.

202506.Name: Wrath of the Sea
202506.text: Hero Action: Deal 10 damage to an enemy. (Deep: You may divide damage dealt by this card among enemies as you choose.)

202507.Name: Atlantis
202507.text: Your hero gets +1 hand size (Deep: +2 hand size instead). Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Atlantis → choose to either discard the top 4 cards from your deck or shuffle the bottom-most 4 cards from your discard pile into your deck.

202508.Name: Ankle Wings
202508.text: If you control another copy of Ankle Wings, your hero gains the [[aerial]] trait. Hero Resource: Exhaust Ankle Wings → generate a [energy] resource. (Deep: generate a [wild] resource instead.)

202509.Name: Neptune's Trident
202509.text: Restricted. Your hero gains retaliate 1. Hero Response: After you pay for an event using a [energy] resource, discard the top card of your deck. If it is a Namor card, add it to your hand.

202510.Name: Atlantis in Peril
202510.text:
You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose:
Exhaust Namor McKenzie → remove Atlantis in Peril from the game.
Shuffle your discard pile into your deck. Deal an encounter card to you. Discard this obligation.

202511.Name: Atlantis Attacks
202511.text: When Revealed: If the Namor McKenzie player has 15 or less remaining cards in their deck, place 3 additional threat here.

202512.Name: Attuma
202512.text: When Revealed: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck [star]Forced Response: After Attuma attacks you, discard cards from the top of your deck equal to damage dealt. [star]Boost: Discard cards from the top of your deck equal to cards in your hand.

202513.Name: Atlantean Traitor
202513.text: When Revealed: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. [star]Boost: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. “Do you know who I am?!?” -Namor

202514.Name: Incited Conflict
202514.text: When Revealed: Discard an ally you control. If no ally was discarded this way, this card gains surge. [star]Boost: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck.

800701a.Name: Le Fauve
800701a.text: Réexploitation géniale - Action : intercalez sous le "Laboratoire du Fauve" une amélioration TECH que vous contrôlez →redressez votre héros et choisissez CTR, ATQ ou DEF. Jusqu'à la fin du round, votre héros gagne +X au pouvoir choisi, X étant égal au coût imprimé de cette amélioration. (Limite une fois par phase).

800701b.Name: Hank McCoy
800701b.text: Mise en place : Cherchez le "Laboratoire du Fauve" et mettez-le en jeu sous votre contrôle. Ressourcé — Action: cherchez dans votre deck ou votre pile de défausse une carte ressource et ajoutez la à votre main. (Limite une fois par phase).

800702.Name: Laboratoire du Fauve
800702.text:
Mise en Place. Permanent.
Les améliorations intercalées sous cette carte peuvent être jouées comme si elles étaient dans votre main.
S'il y a plus de 3 cartes intercalées sous cette carte, défaussez-en pour n'en laisser que 3.

800703.Name: Ultime Mutation
800703.text: Le Fauve gagne +1 DEF, +4 points de vie et ses attaques de base gagnent Perçant.

800704.Name: Gants de Pouvoir Piratés
800704.text: Diminuez de 1 le coût de cette carte si vous contrôlez une amélioration avec le trait TECH. Interruption de héros : quand le Fauve utilise un pouvoir de base choisissez : . infligez 1 dégât à un ennemi . retirez 1 menace d'une manigance

800705.Name: Spider-Traceurs de Peter
800705.text: Cette carte entre en jeu avec 4 jetons traceur sur elle. Diminuez de 1 le coût de cette carte si vous contrôlez une amélioration avec le trait TECH. Ressource : retirez 1 jeton traceur de cette carte → générez 1 ressource [mental] pour une carte TECH. (Limite d'une fois par carte).

800706.Name: Ceinture de Bobby
800706.text: Diminuez de 1 le coût de cette carte si vous contrôlez une amélioration avec le trait TECH. Diminuez de 1 les dégats subis par le Fauve.

800707.Name: Réacteur Arc de Tony
800707.text: Diminuez de 1 le coût de cette carte si vous contrôlez une amélioration avec le trait TECH. Votre taille de main augmente de +1 tant que vous êtes sous forme de héros.

800708.Name: Cérébro de Xavier
800708.text: Cette carte entre en jeu avec 2 jetons Psy sur elle. Diminuez de 1 le coût de cette carte si vous contrôlez une amélioration avec le trait TECH. Action de héros : retirez 1 jeton Psy du Cérébro de Xavier et inclinez-le → infligez 3 dégâts à chacun des ennemis en jeu.

800709.Name: Renfort Technique
800709.text: Action de héros: inclinez le "Laboratoire du Fauve" puis choisissez: . défaussez une carte intercalée sous le "Laboratoire du Fauve" puis redressez votre héros. . cherchez dans votre deck ou pile défausse une amélioration avec le trait TECH puis intercalez-la sous le "Laboratoire du Fauve".

800710.Name: Charge Bestiale
800710.text: Action de héros: infligez 6 dégâts à un ennemi. Vous avez le droit d'incliner le "Laboratoire du Fauve" et de défausser 1 carte intercalée dessous. Si vous le faites cette attaque gagne déferlement et inflige X dégâts supplémentaires X étant égal au coût imprimé de la carte ainsi défaussée.

800711.Name: Génie Civil
800711.text: Action de héros: retirez 3 menaces d'une manigance. Vous pouvez incliner le "Laboratoire du Fauve" et défaussez une carte intercalée dessous pour passer sous forme d'alter égo.

800712.Name: Génie de la Tech
800712.text: Réponse de Héros : après avoir dépensé cette carte, cherchez dans votre deck ou pile de défausse une amélioration TECH et intercalez la sous le "Laboratoire du Fauve".

800713.Name: Surexploité
800713.text: Donnez cette carte au joueur de Hank McCoy Défaussez toutes les cartes intercalées sous le "Laboratoire du Fauve", défaussez ensuite Surexploité. Si aucune amélioration TECH n'est déffaussées par cet effet, attribuez-vous 1 carte Rencontre face cachée, mélangez ensuite Surexploité dans le deck Rencontre.

800714.Name: Problèmes Techniques
800714.text: Une fois révélée: placez 1 menace sur cette carte pour chaque amélioration en jeu. [amplify]

800715.Name: Le Fauve Noir
800715.text: [star] Le Fauve Noir gagne +X ATQ, X étant le coût en ressources imprimé de la carte intercalée sous lui. Une fois révélée : intercalez sous le Fauve Noir l'amélioration TECH que vous controlez ayant le coût le plus élevé. Sinon, intercalez sous le Fauve Noir la carte du dessus de votre deck. (Sbire Némésis du Fauve.)

800716.Name: Génie Maléfique
800716.text: Une fois révélée : défaussez une amélioration TECH que vous contrôlez et infligez à votre identité X dégâts indirects, X étant égal au coût imprimé de cette amélioration. Si aucune amélioration n'est défaussée par cette effet, cette carte gagne Renfort.

800717.Name: Lunettes High-Tech
800717.text: Attachez cette carte au Fauve Noir, si vous ne pouvez pas attachez-la au Méchant. Action de héros : défaussez une amélioration que vous contrôlez → défaussez cet attachement.

500701a.Name: Hulkling
500701a.text: Descendant of Both Races — Response: After you play a card with the [[kree]] or [[skrull]] trait from your hand, if you share that trait, draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.) "I am Hulkling, the Young Avengers' resident shape- changer."

500701b.Name: Teddy Altman
500701b.text: Kree/Skrull Hybrid — Setup: Put your origin form upgrade into play, Skrull Origin side faceup. Response: After you change origin form, heal 1 damage from Teddy Altman. "So I'm half-Kree, half-Skrull?"

500702a.Name: Kree Origin
500702a.text: Origin form. Permanent. Hulkling gains the [[kree]] trait. Action: Exhaust this card → flip this card. Response: After you spend a [[skrull]] card, exhaust this card → draw 1 card.

500702b.Name: Skrull Origin
500702b.text: Origin form. Permanent. Hulkling gains the [[skrull]] trait. Action: Exhaust this card → flip this card. Response: After you spend a card with the [[kree]] trait, exhaust this card → draw 1 card.

500703.Name: Wiccan
500703.text: While you have the [[kree]] trait, Wiccan gets +1 ATK. While you have the [[skrull]] trait, Wiccan gets +1 THW. “You picked the wrong gays to mess with!”

500704.Name: Kree Durability
500704.text: Hero Response: After you change form, ready Hulkling and give him a tough status card. "Yeah, these guys aren't as scary without their guns." —Hulkling

500705.Name: Kree Ferocity
500705.text: Hero Interrupt: When you make a basic attack, you get +6 ATK for that attack. You may take 2 indirect damage → that attack gains overkill. "I dont Hulk-out, if that's what you mean. At least not any more than most sixteen-year-olds." —Hulkling

500706.Name: Shift and Strike
500706.text: Hero Response (attack): After you change form, deal 4 damage to an enemy. If you have the [[skrull]] trait, confuse that enemy. If you have the [[kree]] trait, stun that enemy. "Wow...it worked. I can't believe it." —Hulkling

500707.Name: Skrull Infiltration
500707.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 4 threat from a scheme. You may take 2 indirect damage → this thwart ignores the patrol keyword and the crisis icon ([crisis]). "I guess it's the Skrull part of me." —Hulkling

500708.Name: Skrull Regeneration
500708.text: Hero Action: Ready Hulkling. Heal 2 damage from Hulkling for each resource you overpaid for this card. "Almost healed...that doesn't mean it doesn't hurt." —Hulkling

500709.Name: Alliance
500709.text: Response: After you play a card with the [[kree]] trait from your hand, deal 1 damage to an enemy. Response: After you play a card with the [[skrull]] trait from your hand, remove 1 threat from the main scheme. “Male Kree children are conscripted at age nine. Taken and trained to be the best soldiers in all the universe."

500710.Name: Ancestors
500710.text: Uses (2 individual counters). Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 individual counter from it → choose 1 card in your hand or in play. That card gains the [[kree]] or [[skrull]] trait until the end of the round. “She would have been a powerful leader...might well have brought peace to our warring races." —Mar-Vell

500711.Name: Changeling
500711.text: Hulkling gains the [[aerial]] trait. Interrupt: When you use a basic power, exhaust Changeling → you get +1 to that power for this use. "What else do you call a kid who's half-Hulk, half-changeling?" —Kate Bishop

500712.Name: Emperor Dorrek-Vell
500712.text: While you have the [[kree]] trait, each ally you control gets +1 ATK. While you have the [[skrull]] trait, each ally you control gets +1 THW. "I am Dorrek VIII, the once and future King of Space!" —Hulkling

500713.Name: Excelsior
500713.text: Restricted. (Max 2 restricted cards per player.) While Excelsior is ready, Hulkling's basic attacks gain piercing. Resource: Exhaust Excelsior → generate a [energy] resource. "I found this in there. Looks like a sword" —Hulkling

500714.Name: Nega Rings
500714.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Nega Rings and spend a [energy] resource → choose a card in your hand and swap that card with a card of your choice in your discard pile. "...these are what is left of Captain Marvel's legacy. All I have of him." —Hulkling

500721.Name: Deflect the Blow
500721.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage from an attack, discard Deflect the Blow and exhaust your hero, prevent all of that damage. "Wow...it worked. I can't believe it." —Hulkling

500724.Name: Drunk in Love
500724.text: Action: Confuse your identity → heal 4 damage from it. "I could wish for anything in any world, I could bend reality to all my whims, and when I wake up alone and scared...I only want you." —Wiccan

500729.Name: Glorious Flight
500729.text: Play only if you have an [[aerial]] trait. Hero Response: After you defeat an enemy or a side scheme, discard Glorious Flight → ready your hero.

500715.Name: Lauri-Ell
500715.text: Response: After Lauri-Ell takes any amount of damage from an attack, give her a tough status card. “Though I was born and bred for war, I have no taste for violance."

500716.Name: Mur-G'nn
500716.text: Action: Exhaust Mur-G'nn and deal 1 damage to her → discard the top card of your deck. If that card's printed resource has: [physical] - Ready a card your control. [energy] - Give an identity a tough status card. [mental] - Heal 3 damage from a character. Mur-G'nn to your hand. [wild] - Choose one of the above.

500730.Name: Pride
500730.text: Max 1 per player. Action: Exhaust Pride → discard the top card of your deck. If that card is an identity-specific card, add it to your hand. "I am gay. " —Jean-Paul Beaubier

500719.Name: Provoked!
500719.text: Hero Response: After you defend against an attack and take at least 1 damage, ready your hero. "Someone is either breaking in or shooting a music video in my apartment." —Hulkling

500725.Name: Strength in Otherness
500725.text: Team-Up (Hulkling and Wiccan). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action (attack/thwart): Remove 1 threat from the main scheme and deal 1 damage to the villain for each different card type in your discard pile.

500723.Name: Talos
500723.text: Interrupt: When Talos would take any amount of consequential damage, deal that damage to another character you control. “I may be dishonored, but you are in no way honorable enough to fight against me."

500731.Name: Interracial Hatred
500731.text: Cards with the [[kree]] and [[skrull]] trait you control cannot ready. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Teddy Altman → discard this obligation.

500732.Name: Empress R'Klll
500732.text: Villainous. [star] Empress R'Klll's attacks gain piercing. When Revealed: Empress R'Klll attacks each player in hero form. (Hulkling's nemesis minion.) "Your empire will shatter, and the last light will dim."

500733.Name: DNA Masking
500733.text: "I spent years infiltrating the Kree! Masking my DNA, risking death at every turn! All for you… the last of the line! My grandson!" —R'Klll Minions cannot take damage. Threat cannot be removed from DNA Masking while there are no minions in play.

500734.Name: Inhibited
500734.text: Attach to your identity. You cannot change form or play cards that share a [[trait]] with your identity. Action: Spend [physical][physical] resources → discard this card. "I'm guessing this inhibitor mask they put me in is blocking my Skrull half." —Hulkling

500735.Name: Assailed by Their Own
500735.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Exhaust your identity. When Revealed (Hero): Choose a character in play (other than your identity) that shares a [[trait]] with your hero. Take X damage where X is equal to the chosen character's ATK. Otherwise, exhaust your identity.

500736.Name: Swapping Roles
500736.text: When Revealed: Exhaust each card you control that shares a [[trait]] with your identity (including your identity). [star] Boost: Exhaust each card you control that shares a [[trait]] with your identity (except for your identity).

500720.Name: The Night Nurse
500720.text: Uses (3 medical counters). Action: Exhaust The Night Nurse and remove 1 medical counter from her → heal 1 damage from a hero and discard 1 status card from it.

500717.Name: Counter-Punch
500717.text: Response (attack): After your hero defends against an enemy attack, deal damage to that enemy equal to your hero's ATK.

500722.Name: Hard to Ignore
500722.text: Hero Response: After your hero defends against an attack and takes no damage, exhaust Hard to Ignore → remove 1 threat from the main scheme.

500718.Name: Not Today!
500718.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When your hero defends against an attack, it gets +2 DEF for that attack. If you take no damage from that attack, remove 2 threat from a scheme.

500737b.Name: Laura Green

999001.text: Win the Mutagen Formula scenario with the Flight modular encounter set, using only heroes who have or can gain the [[Aerial]] trait. During this scenario, whenever an identity changes to alter-ego form, deal that identity 2 damage.

999002.Name: Two for One
999002.text: Defeat a minion and the villain at the same time with the damage dealt by the Fastball Special event.

999003.Name: Magnets and Metal
999003.text: Defeat the Magneto villain using only heroes from the following list: Iron Man, War Machine, Ironheart, and/or SP//dr. After setup, search the encounter deck for the Seized! side scheme and reveal it.

999004.Name: Teamwork Makes the Dream Work
999004.text: Defeat the Hood villain using the Acolytes, Dark Riders, Reavers, Blue Moon, Nasty Boys, Brotherhood, and Exodus modular encounter sets.

999005.Name: Form Flippers
999005.text: Win the En Sabah Nur scenario using any combination of the following heroes: Ant-Man, Wasp, Spectrum, Vision, Shadowcat, and/or Angel.

999006.Name: Flower Power
999006.text: Defeat the Ronan the Accuser villain as the Groot hero. Groot must be at full health and possess the Power Stone at the end of the scenario.

999007.Name: Breakin’ and Takin’: Ultimate Edition
999007.text: Defeat the Rhino villain while including the following modular encounter sets: Infinity Gauntlet, Flight, Super Strength, and Telepathy.

999008.Name: Absorbing the Elements
999008.text: Defeat the Absorbing Man villain while the following characters are in play (as heroes or allies): Groot, Iceman, Rockslide, and Colossus.

999009.Name: Gene Pool Party
999009.text: Defeat the Unus villain using only heroes with the ‘Pool aspect, one of whom must be Phoenix.

999010.Name: Need for Speed
999010.text: Attack the Speed Demon minion three times in one turn with the Quicksilver hero.

999011.Name: Whose Show is it Anyway?
999011.text: Defeat the Mojo villain as the Spider-Ham and/or Deadpool hero(es). During this scenario, Show environments cannot leave play (ignore their “When Revealed” effects).

999012.Name: Wrath of the Mad Titan
999012.text: Defeat the Thanos villain using only [[Avenger]] and/or [[Guardian]] heroes. The final blow can only be dealt by a hero with 1 remaining hit point. After completing setup, advance the main scheme to stage 2A.

999013.Name: Complete the Collection
999013.text: Win the Infiltrate the Museum scenario as any hero(es). During this scenario, players cannot remove cards from The Collection, and The Grand Collection main scheme no longer causes players to lose when there are 5 per player cards in The Collection.

999014.Name: Symbiote Smackdown
999014.text:
Defeat the Venom villain with the Venom Nemesis encounter set as the modular encounter set.
Only the Venom hero, [[Web-Warrior]] heroes, or heroes with “Spider” in their title can be used. After setup, each player searches their collection for a Symbiote Suit and puts it in play under their control, then searches the encounter deck for an Enraged Symbiote and reveals it.
During this scenario, each Symbiote Suit gains permanent, and each Enraged Symbiote triggers the villain’s Forced Response when attacked.

999015.Name: Fickle Crowds
999015.text: Defeat MaGog as any hero(es). During this scenario, at the end of each villain phase, move 1 per player ratings counters from The Challengers to The Champion.

999016.Name: Everyday Heroes
999016.text: Win any scenario as any hero(es) without any identities flipping to hero form (each player must stay in alter-ego form for the entire game).

999017.Name: Mystic Mayhem
999017.text: Defeat Ebony Maw using the Adam Warlock Nemesis and the Doctor Strange Nemesis encounter sets as modular encounter sets. Only [[Mystic]] heroes can be used for this scenario. At the end of each villain phase, first player reveals the top card of the encounter deck.

999018.Name: Lock and Load
999018.text: Defeat Crossbones using the Osborn Tech, Goblin Gear, and Military Grade modular encounter sets (remove Experimental Weapons). During setup, shuffle four random [[Weapon]] cards from these modular sets together to form the Experimental Weapons deck. Shuffle the remaining cards into the encounter deck as normal. For this scenario, only heroes with [[Weapon]] or [[Armor]] identity-specific upgrades may be used.

999019.Name: Lone Wolf
999019.text: Defeat Stryfe solo as any hero with no allies in your deck (replace any identity-specific allies with aspect/basic cards). During this scenario, whenever you defeat a minion, draw 1 card.

999020.Name: Field Study
999020.text: Defeat Dark Beast using the Temporal modular encounter set. Each player must use a hero whose alter-ego has the [[Genius]] trait. During this scenario, whenever a minion is revealed, resolve the “Special” ability on the Setting environment.

999021.Name: Battle of the Bots
999021.text: Defeat Ultron as any hero(es) using the Sentinels modular encounter set. During this scenario, Drone minions gain the [[Sentinel]] trait, and Sentinel minions gain the [[Drone]] trait.

999022.Name: Not Easy Being Green
999022.text: Win the Risky Business scenario using only heroes from the following list: She-Hulk, Hulk, Gamora, and/or Drax. Each hero deck must use the Protection aspect for this scenario. During this scenario, if there are ever 6 per player or more infamy counters on Criminal Enterprise, the players lose the game.

999023.Name: The Wreckoning
999023.text: Win the Wrecking Crew scenario as any hero(es). After setup, search each encounter deck for the following attachments and reveal them: Magic Crowbar, Ball and Chain, Distracting Taunts, and Bulldozer’s Helmet. During this scenario, each villain gains +1 SCH and +1 ATK for each defeated villain.

999024.Name: Absolutely Zero Tolerance
999024.text: Win the Project Wideawake scenario using the Future Past modular encounter set. Players can only use [[X-Men]] heroes for this scenario. After setup, search the encounter deck for Bastion and deal him to the first player as a facedown encounter card. At the end of each villain phase, if Bastion is in the encounter discard pile or victory display, deal him to the first player as a facedown encounter card.

999025.Name: Boss Rush
999025.text: Defeat the Hela, Taskmaster, and Mister Sinister scenarios, in that order. Players do not reset the game state between each scenario; instead, as soon as one scenario is won, remove all encounter cards from the game (except for Captive allies) and replace them with those of the next scenario, then resume play from the beginning of the player phase. During these scenarios, if any hero is defeated, the players lose the challenge.

999101.Name: Irresistible Charm
999101.text: Defeat the Enchantress scenario as any hero(es). After setup, place 5 charm counters on the [[Enchantment]] card in each player’s play area.

202901a.Name: Beast
202901a.text: Multitasker — Response: After you draw an event or resource, put that card into your reserve → draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.) “Oh, my stars and garters! What have we here?”

202901b.Name: Hank McCoy
202901b.text: R&D — You may include up to 6 upgrades from aspects other than your chosen aspect. Your minimum deck size is 45 cards. Action: Put a card from your hand into your reserve. (Limit once per round.)

202902.Name: Beast
202902.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust this card → heal 1 damage from your identity and 1 damage from Beast. “I'll set-up the device while you--”“--Run those calculations. Lets--” —Beast (Earth 616)“--Tag team a scientific solution.”

202903.Name: Addition by Subtraction
202903.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. If this attack defeats an enemy, repeat this attack. “The noblest answer unto such, is kindly silence when they brawl.” —Alfred Lord Tennyson

202904.Name: Lateral Thinking
202904.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. If you played this card from your hand, put this card into your reserve. “Perhaps a new perspective will present a possible resolution for this perplexing problem.” —Beast

202905.Name: Logical Solution
202905.text: Action: Choose an attachment with the text “Alter-Ego Action” or “Hero Action”. Discard that attachment. “Oftentimes, concocting a feasible countermeasure to the opponent's paraphernalia is a trying and complex process. However, in this instance brute force will suffice.” —Beast

202906.Name: Spring into Action
202906.text: Hero Action: Ready your hero. “We few, we happy few, we band of brothers; For he who sheds his blood with me this day shall be my brother; be he ne'er so vile, this day shall gentle his condition; And men in England now abed, will count their manhoods cheap, they were not here with us to fight on Crispin's day!” —William Shakespeare, Henry V

202907.Name: Beast's Lab
202907.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Beast's Lab → choose a player. That player searches their deck and discard pile for an upgrade and plays it (paying its resource cost). “This is absolutely fascinating on every conceivable level.” —Beast

202908.Name: Keen Mind
202908.text: Increase your reserve limit by 1. Resource: Exhaust Keen Mind → generate a [mental] resource (generate a [wild] resource instead if paying for a card in your reserve). ”As Archimedes said when he discovered the principle of displacement; Eureka!” —Beast

202909.Name: Prehensile Feet
202909.text: You can control 1 additional upgrade that has the restricted keyword. Action: Exhaust Prehensile Feet → put a card from your reserve into your hand. “My prodigious pedal extremities have things in hand... or foot, to be more accurate.” —Beast

202910.Name: Scientific Solution
202910.text: Response: After you draw an event or resource, put that card into your reserve → draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.) “To answer the age-old question of whether one would rather serve in righteous heaven or rule in pragmatic hell, I'm forced to say, Dr. McCoy, you might just be the devil.” —Beast

202911.Name: Secondary Mutations
202911.text: You get +4 hit points. Hank McCoy gets +1 REC. Beast gets +1 ATK, and +1 DEF. “According to your records you genetically tampered with our own mutation years ago...” —Beast (Earth-TRN240)

202912.Name: Mutation Degeneration
202912.text:
You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose:
Exhaust any 2 of your alter-ego, your hero-specific ally, or Beast's Lab → remove Mutation Degeneration from the game.
Exhaust your identity and take 2 damage. Discard this obligation.

202913.Name: Dark Beast
202913.text: Quickstrike. Forced Response: After Dark Beast attacks and damages a character, place 2 threat on the Dark Experimentation side scheme. If the Dark Experimentation side scheme is not in play, heal 2 damage from Dark Beast and the villain instead.

202914.Name: Dark Experimentation
202914.text: Dark Beast is using chemistry and robotics to concoct vile and dangerous experiments. Enters play with 1 test counter. Forced Response: After resolving step 1 of the villain phase, if there are no test counters here, place 1 test counter here. Otherwise, seek an attachment from the encounter deck and reveal it. Then, remove 1 test counter from here and shuffle each other card discarded this way into the encounter deck.

202915.Name: Cybernetic Enhancements
202915.text: Attach to a unique ([unique]) minion. If you cannot, search the encounter deck and discard pile for Dark Beast. Put him into play engaged with you with this card attached to him. Forced Response: After this card is attached to a minion, give attached minion a tough status card. Attached minion gets +2 hit points.

202916.Name: Horrifying Test Subject
202916.text: Attach to a non-unique minion. If you cannot, this card gains surge. Attached minion gains armored 1 and the [[cyborg]] trait. Forced Interrupt: When attached enemy would be defated, if no excess damage was dealt to it heal damage from this minion until it has 1 hit point remaining.

202917.Name: Power Dampening Serum
202917.text: Attach to your identity. Treat the text boxes of your hero and any [[superpower]] upgrades you control as if they were blank (except for [[traits]]). You cannnot play [[superpower ]]cards. Alter-Ego Action: Spend a [mental] resource and exhaust your identity → discard this card.

500963.Name: Crusader
500963.text: Response: After Crusader enters play, choose a player → deal 1 damage to the villain and each minion engaged with that player. Draw 1 card for each enemy defeated this way. “Do you still want to be a super hero?"

500964.Name: Jazinda
500964.text: Jazinda does not count against your ally limit. While Jazinda is exhausted, your hero gets +1 THW. “i do not deny it, I simply despise it"

500965.Name: Paibok
500965.text: Toughness. [star] Paibok gets +1 THW and +1 ATK for each treachery card attached to him. Response: After a treachery card is discarded, take 1 damage → attach it facedown here (to a maximum of 2). “The time has come for the Super-Skrull to strike!"

500966.Name: Skymax
500966.text: Response: When Skymax enters play, shuffle all allies from your discard pile into your deck. “I already lost one home. I will not lose Earth to your petty revolt.”

500967.Name: Super-Skrull
500967.text: [star] Super-Skrull gets +1 THW and +1 ATK for each different [[superpower]] card attached to him. Response: After a [[superpower]] card is placed into a discard pile, attach it facedown here (to a maximum of 4). “The time has come for the Super-Skrull to strike!"

500968.Name: War Skrull
500968.text: [star] Response: After "Chilly McHotpants" attacks you, draw 1 cards. If you take no damage from that attack, draw 1 card. “I'm going to freeze your pathetic little body, then I'm going smash it into little pieces which I'm going to use to keep my drinks cold."

500969.Name: Xavin
500969.text: Interrupt: When Xavin enters play, discard cards from your deck until you discard an event with a "Hero Action" ability. You may resolve that event's "Hero Action" ability. “My name is Xavin, Super-Skrull-in-training."

500970.Name: Buddy Training Program
500970.text: Victory 0. X is equal to the villain's stage number. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme may give up to X friendly characters a tough status card.

500971.Name: Cloning Program
500971.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme may deal up to 3 damage to each [[skrull]] minion engaged with them. [acceleration]

500972.Name: Fickle Alliance
500972.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme may search the encounter deck for a non-[[elite]] minion and put it into play under their control. (Shuffle.) Treat that minion as an ally with a blank text box (except for [[traits]]). Its THW is equal to its printed SCH and it takes 1 consequential damage . after it thwarts or attacks.

500973.Name: Newbie Training
500973.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme may defeat a non-[[elite]] [[skrull]] minion and draw 1 card.

500974.Name: Searching for Powers
500974.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme may search their deck and discard pile for a card with the [[superpower]] trait and play it, ignoring its resource cost. (Shuffle.)

500975.Name: Skrull Military Training
500975.text: Victory 0. Threat cannot be removed from this scheme unless it is being thwarted by a [[skrull]] ally. While this card is in the victory display, its owner's hero gets +1 THW, +1 ATK, and +1 DEF.

500976.Name: Stealing For Good
500976.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme may search their deck and discard pile for an upgrade and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.) Then, they remove threat from a scheme equal to that upgrade's printed cost.

500977.Name: Antalya
500977.text: Action: Exhaust Antalya → heal 1 damage from a friendly character. "We can't let fear make us afraid to live."

500978.Name: Cadre K
500978.text: Action: Exhaust Cadre K → remove 1 threat from a scheme. “This is Cadre K. They are an... impure segment of the Skrull population. Like the X-Men of Earth, they were born with powers and abilities beyond the Skrull species.” —K'thron

500979.Name: Point of View
500979.text: Hero Response: After a [[skrull]] minion is defeated, exhaust "Pool-O-Vision" → draw 1 card (to a maximum of 3) for each [crisis],[acceleration],[amplify], and [hazard] in play. "So you were saying, "P.O.V." stands for "point of view"? Usually. But in my case, it stands for "Pool-O-Vision". —Deadpool

500980.Name: Princess Anelle
500980.text: Alliance. X is equal to the total number of players and [[skrull]] enemies in play. Response: After the player phase ends, remove Princess Anelle from the game → skip the villain phase. “She would have been a powerful leader...might well have brought peace to our warring races." —Mar-Vell

500981.Name: Skrull Battleship
500981.text: Play only if you control a [[skrull]] ally. Hero Resource: Exhaust Skrull Battleship → generate a [wild] resource for any player. "You know what I am. You've seen what I can do. I wanna be in the Skrull business." —Deadpool

500982.Name: Skrull Kill Krew
500982.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Skrull Kill Krew → deal 1 damage to a [[skrull]] minion. If that minion is defeated this way, ready Skrull Kill Krew. “We're the Skull Kill Krew. This is how we do." —Ryder

500983.Name: 3-D Man's Goggles
500983.text: Attach to a non-[[skrull]] ally. Interrupt: When attached ally attacks a [[skrull]] enemy, that ally does not take consequential damage. Googles that let him see and fight your kind over half a century ago!" —3-D Man

500984.Name: Inhibitor Mask
500984.text: Attach to a [[skrull]] enemy. Temporary. Treat attached enemy's printed text box as if it were blank. "The Inhibitor mask, It's locked on. I, I can't change." —Empress R'Klll

500985.Name: Ultimate Nullifier
500985.text:
Attach to a [[skrull]] enemy.
Temporary.
Attached enemy cannot activate.
While Nullifier is attached to the villain, it gains 1[per_hero] hazard icon ([hazard]).

500986.Name: Reverting Device
500986.text: Play under any player's control. Each [[skrull]] minion engaged with you gets -1 SCH. "I will prove it… by reverting you to your original form." —Super-Skrull Hero Action: Discard Reverting Device → remove 1 acceleration token from the main scheme. "Googles that let him see and fight your kind over half a century ago!" —3-D Man

500987.Name: Skrull Shapeshifter
500987.text: Play under any player's control. Your identity gains the [[skrull]] trait. Interrupt: When you would be defeated, set your hit point dial to 1 instead. Then, discard this card.

500988.Name: Sy-Torak Gem
500988.text: Play under any player's control. You get +3 hit points. Your hero gets +1 ATK. Forced Interrupt: When your deck empties, spend [energy] resource. If you cannot, discard Sy-Torak Gem.

500807.Name: Skrull Scientist
500807.text: [acceleration] [star] Boost: Heal 2 damage from the villain, after this activation ends. "He truly loves us. The Empire will live." —Dro'ge

500808.Name: Skrull Spy
500808.text: When Revealed: Discard 1 random card from your hand. [star] Boost: Discard 1 random card from your hand.

500809.Name: Skrull Telepath
500809.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Skrull Telepath would attack, it schemes instead. [star] Boost: If this activation is a scheme, reveal this card.

500810.Name: Skrull Warrior
500810.text: Guard. (While this minion is engaged with you, you cannot attack the villain.) [star] Boost: If this attack is undefended, you are stunned. "You should not have forgotten I'm a Skrull." —M'lanz

500811.Name: Plotting Revenge
500811.text: The Skrulls thoroughly studied human behavior in order to achieve their goal of conquering Earth and completely dominating the universe. Hinder 2[per_hero]. [acceleration]

500812.Name: Outnumbered
500812.text: When Revealed: Engage each [[skrull]] minion in play. Then, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[skrull]] minion and reveal it. [star] Boost: This card gets +1 boost icon ([boost]) for each [[skrull]] enemy in play (to a maximum of +4) for this activation. "Warriors of the Skrull armada! This base now belongs to us!" —Emperor Dorrek VII

500813.Name: Skrull Commander
500813.text: Each other [[skrull]] minion gets +1 ATK. [star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, this card gets +2 boost icons ([boost][boost]) for this activation. "If he was a significant threat, we would know who he is" —Commander Ak'strk

500814.Name: Skrull Soldier
500814.text: When Revealed: Place 2 threat on each side scheme in play. [star] Boost: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck. "He loves you..."

500815.Name: Hijacked
500815.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. When Revealed: Search your deck, discard pile and hand for an ally and place it beneath this scheme. When Defeated: Put the ally beneath this scheme into play under its owner's control. • [star] Boost: Reveal this card.

500816.Name: Skrull Assault
500816.text: When Revealed: Each [[skrull]] minion attacks the hero it is engaged with. If no attacks were made this way, this card gains surge. [star] Boost: This card gets +1 boost icon ([boost]) for each [[skrull]] enemy in play (to a maximum of +4) for this activation.

500817.Name: Super-Skrull
500817.text: Forced Response: After resolving step two of the villain phase, shuffle each [[superpower]] attachment from play into the [[superpower]] deck and reveal the top card of the [[superpower]] deck. “This is no common miscreant you face. Mine is the combined power of the Fantastic Four!”

500818.Name: Super-Skrull
500818.text: Forced Response: After resolving step two of the villain phase, shuffle each [[superpower]] attachment from play into the [[superpower]] deck and reveal the top 2 cards of the [[superpower]] deck. “This is no common miscreant you face. Mine is the combined power of the Fantastic Four!”

500819.Name: Super-Skrull
500819.text: Forced Response: After resolving step two of the villain phase, shuffle each [[superpower]] attachment from play into the [[superpower]] deck and reveal the top 2 cards of the [[superpower]] deck. “This is no common miscreant you face. Mine is the combined power of the Fantastic Four!”

500820a.Name: Searching for the Heir
500820a.text: Contents: Super-Skrull I and Super-Skrull II (Super-Skrull II and Super-Skrull III for expert mode). Super-Skrull and Standard encounter sets. Two modular encounter sets (Army of Skrulls and Kree-Skrull War). Setup: Shuffle each [[superpower]] attachment into the [[superpower]] deck and set it next to the encounter deck.

500820b.Name: Searching for the Heir
500820b.text: Learning that Princess Anelle had a child with his old foe, the original Captain Marvel and that the Skrull Empire was seeking out this heir, named Dorrek VIII, the Super-Skrull made it his mission to be the first to find the boy, hidden on planet Earth. When Revealed: Reveal the top card of the [[superpower]] deck.

500821a.Name: Heir to the Throne
500821a.text: The Super-Skrull broadcasted to all Skrull worlds that he had located Dorrek VIII, who turned out to be Hulkling, a member of the recently formed Young Avengers team. When Revealed: If Lord Kl'rt is in play, deal each player a facedown encounter card. Otherwise, search the encounter deck and discard pile for Lord Kl'rt and attach it to Super-Skrull. Shuffle the encounter deck.

500821b.Name: Heir to the Throne
500821b.text: Kl'rt, the Super-Skrull, revealed Hulkling the truth about his past. He insisted that he must return to his people so that they could reunite the Skrull Empire. When Revealed: Reveal the top card of the [[superpower]] deck. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

500822.Name: Flexibility
500822.text: Attach to Super-Skrull. Super-Skrull gains stalwart and his attacks gain ranged. "You are nothing compared to me. I have more power than all four of you combined." —Super-Skrull

500823.Name: Invisibility
500823.text: Attach to Super-Skrull. As an additional cost to attack Super-Skrull, you must spend 1 resource of any type. "Invisibility is one of the powers I wield as the Super-Skrull. A secondary effect of that power allows me to see what is hidden from sight..." —Super-Skrull

500824.Name: Pyrokinesis
500824.text: Attach to Super-Skrull. Forced Response: After a friendly character thwarts the main scheme, deal 1 damage to it. [star] Super-Skrull's attacks gain piercing. "Fools, you should have run while you had a moment's chance!" —Super-Skrull

500825.Name: Rock Mimicry
500825.text: Attach to Super-Skrull. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Super-Skrull attacks, give him 1 additional boost card for this activation. [star] Super-Skrull's attacks gain overkill. "Before I am done, human, you will beg me for the swift, sure release of death!" —Super-Skrull

500826.Name: Invisible Forcefield
500826.text: Attach to the enemy with the highest printed hit points and without another Invisible Forcefield attached. If you cannot, this card gains surge. Forced Interrupt: When any amount of damage would be dealt to attached character, place it here instead. Then, if there is at least 5 damage here, discard this card.

500827.Name: Lord Kl'rt
500827.text: Attach to Super-Skrull. [amplify] Hero Action: Reveal the top card of the [[superpower]] deck → discard this card. [star] Boost: Reveal this card. "I was bred and raised to be a warrior. The most powerful warrior of the whole race." —Super-Skrull

500828.Name: Mt'nox
500828.text: [star] Forced Response: After Mt'nox makes an undefended attack against you, discard the top card of your deck. If that card's printed resource has: [physical] - Give the villain a tough status card. [energy] - You are stunned. [mental] - You are confused. [wild] - All of the above.

500829.Name: Praxagora
500829.text: [star] Praxagora's attacks gain overkill. "All it takes is a thought...the flick of a mental switch...and I become a countdown to Armageddon."

500830.Name: R'kin
500830.text: When Defeated: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an attachment is discarded. Reveal that card. "I hope you're ready to be a hero, R'Kin. Because we will either return as heroes or not at all." —Super-Skrull

500831.Name: Galactic Council Membership
