500831.text: The Galactic Council is an intergalactic organization which was created to deal with important matters in the universe. Represented are the races of eight galaxies and other dimensions. Forced Response: After a player attacks Super-Skrull, place 1 threat on the main scheme. [acceleration]

500832.Name: Skrull Warlords
500832.text: The Super-Skrull became one of many Warlords seeking to re-unite the divided Skrull territories. He became one of the six most powerful Warlords who united themselves against this common foe. Forced Response: After a card enters play under any player's control, give the villain a facedown boost card.

500833.Name: Hypnotic Gaze
500833.text: When Revealed: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck. For each [physical] resource discarded this way stun a character you control, for each [mental] resource discarded this way confuse a character you control. "Let me show you an ability I haven't used in some time. The matchless power of hypnotism!" —Kl'rt

500834.Name: Power Multiplying
500834.text: When Revealed: Reveal the top card of the [[superpower]] deck. If you cannot, this card gains surge. [star] Boost: This card gets +1 boost icon ([boost]) for each [[superpower]] attachment attached to Super-Skrull. "Fools, you should have run while you had a moment's chance!" —Super-Skrull

500835.Name: Villain's Versatility
500835.text: When Revealed: If Super-Skrull has the following [[superpower]] attachment attached: • Pyrokinesis - Take 3 indirect damage. • Rock Mimicry - Give Super-Skrull a tough status card. • Flexibility - Discard 1 card from your hand. • Invisibility - Place 2 threat on the main scheme.

500836.Name: Bel-Dann
500836.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for Raksor and put him into play engaged with you. "Any one of these beings may be my enemy in disguise. I must take no chances… destroy them all!"

500837.Name: Raksor
500837.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for Bel-Dann and put him into play engaged with you. "Never in all my days did I ever think I would fight alongside a… Kree!"

500838.Name: Earth Involvement
500838.text: Both the Kree and Skrulls are involving Earth in their plans in this intergalactic war. Permanent. Setup. While there is at least 1 threat here, this card gains a crisis icon ([crisis]). Forced Response: After a card that belongs to the Kree-Skrull War encounter set is revealed, place 2 threat here. [hazard]

500839.Name: Imperial Kree Army
500839.text: When Revealed: Discard the top card of the encounter deck. Deal 1 damage to each character you control for each boost icon ([boost]) discarded this way. [star] Boost: Place 2 threat on Earth Involvement. "Trust. What do humans know of trust? You can't even agree on one god." —Nogor

500840.Name: Skrull Imperial Fleet
500840.text: When Revealed: Discard the top card of the encounter deck. Place 1 threat on each scheme in play for each boost icon ([boost]) discarded this way. [star] Boost: Place 2 threat on Earth Involvement. "Trust. What do humans know of trust? You can't even agree on one god." —Nogor

500841.Name: Paibok
500841.text: Toughness. While the number of [[power skrull]] cards attached to Paibok is equal to or less than the number of mastery counters on him, [[power skrull]] cards cannot be discarded. “I can easily kill you with my bare hands! I am Paibok, the genetically enhanced Power Skrull!”

500842.Name: Paibok
500842.text: Toughness. While the number of [[power skrull]] cards attached to Paibok is equal to or less than the number of mastery counters on him, [[power skrull]] cards cannot be discarded. When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[power skrull]] card and reveal it.

500843.Name: Paibok
500843.text: Toughness. While the number of [[power skrull]] cards attached to Paibok is equal to or less than the number of mastery counters on him, [[power skrull]] cards cannot be discarded. When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[power skrull]] card and reveal it.

500844a.Name: Power Skrull Engineering
500844a.text: Paibok the Power Skrull. All the powers of some of the X-Men. None of the conscience. Contents: Paibok I and Paibok II (Paibok II and Paibok III for expert mode). Paibok and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (New Revengers). Setup: Place 1 mastery counter on Paibok.

500844b.Name: Power Skrull Engineering
500844b.text: Paibok was trained at the Skrullian military academy, and was bionically re-engineered to posses more power than the Fantastic Four. So he became the first Power Skrull. When Revealed: Discard cards from the encounter deck until a [[power skrull]] card is discarded. Reveal that card. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.

500845a.Name: Mastering Superpowers
500845a.text: Paibok wants to take revenge on the Earth's superheroes and destroy them once and for all. To achieve his goal, he needs to master all his newly acquired superpowers. When Revealed: Place 1 mastery counter on Paibok. Then, If Captain Paibok is in play, resolve its "Boost" ability. Otherwise, search the encounter deck and discard pile for Captain Paibok and attach it to Paibok. Shuffle the encounter deck.

500845b.Name: Mastering Superpowers
500845b.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When this scheme would be completed place 1 mastery counter on Paibok and remove all threat from here instead. Then, discard cards from the encounter deck until a [[power skrull]] card is discarded. Reveal that card. When the player phase ends, if all 4 [[power skrull]] cards are attached to Paibok, the players lose the game.

500846.Name: Captain Paibok
500846.text: Attach to Paibok. [hazard] Hero Action: Resolve the "Boost" ability on each attachment in play that belongs to the Paibok encounter set → discard this card. [star] Boost: Heal 2 damage from Paibok. "Bow down and beg to the Skrulls!" —Paibok

500847.Name: Distracted
500847.text: Attach to your identity. Forced Interrupt: When you thwart, reduce the amount of threat that thwart removes by 1. Hero Action: Spend [mental][mental] resources → discard this card. [star] Boost: Place 1 threat on the main scheme. "I was able to move my vital organs out of harm's way." —Paibok

500848.Name: Electricity Projection
500848.text: Attach to Paibok. Paibok gains retaliate 1. Hero Action: Spend [mental][physical] resources → discard this card. [star] Boost: Stun a character you control. "Foolish one! You were no match for my bio-genetically engineered powers!" —Paibok

500849.Name: Hypnotized
500849.text: Attach to your identity. As an additional cost to change form, you must spend 1 resource of any type. Hero Action: Spend [energy][energy] resources → discard this card. [star] Boost: Discard 1 card from your hand. "Bow down and beg to the Skrulls!" —Paibok

500850.Name: Ice Control
500850.text: Attach to Paibok. [star] Forced Response: After Paibok attacks you, exhaust a character you control. Hero Action: Spend 3 resources of any type → discard this card. [star] Boost: Exhaust a character you control. "I don't know if you're incredibly brave or just plain stupid to fight me." —Paibok

500851.Name: Metallic Skin
500851.text: Attach to Paibok and give him 1[per_hero] tough status cards. Paibok can have 1[per_hero] additional tough status card and attacks against Paibok lose piercing. Hero Action: Spend [energy][mental] resources → discard this card. [star] Boost: Give Paibok a tough status card. Interrupt: When attached ally would attack, treat Spider- Woman's printer text box as if it were blank (except for [[traits]]) until that attack resolves. "Googles that let him see and fight your kind over half a century ago!" —3-D Man

500852.Name: Shapeshifting
500852.text: Attach to Paibok. Paibok gains stalwart and the [[aerial]] trait. Hero Action: Spend [energy][physical] resources → discard this card. [star] Boost: Confuse a character you control. "We Skrulls are shape-shifters." —Paibok

500853.Name: Trapped in Ice
500853.text: Attach to your identity. Forced Interrupt: When you attack, reduce the amount of damage that attacks deals by 1. Hero Action: Spend [physical][physical] resources → discard this card. [star] Boost: Take 1 damage. "Welcome to your icy grave!" —Paibok

500854.Name: Devos the Devastator
500854.text: Forced Response: After a status card is placed on a friendly character, Devos the Devastator activates against the player who controls that character. "You are apparently the least cerebrally evolved of your comrades!"

500855.Name: General Kalamari
500855.text: When Defeated: The player who defeated General Kalamari resolves the "Boost" ability on each[[ ]]attachment in play, that belongs to the Paibok encounter set. "Our worthy goal can only be achieved if we conquer and enslave every other inhabited world!"

500856.Name: Galactic Ambassador
500856.text: ﻿Paibok The Power Skrull was assigned to the Galactic Council as full-time diplomatic envoy. When Revealed: Place 2 additional threat here for each friendly character with a status card. [acceleration]

500857.Name: Settling Scores
500857.text: "Now the human race will soon fear me! Hahahahaha!" —Paibok Hinder 2[per_hero]. Resolve the "Boost" ability on each boost card 1 additional time. When Revealed: Shuffle each [[power skrull]] card from the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.

500858.Name: Council Manipulation
500858.text: When Revealed: Paibok schemes. If you are stunned or confused, this card gains surge. "We have made a strategic alliance with the expressed purpose of obliterating our mutual enemies, the Fantastic Four." —Paibok

500859.Name: Getting Ruthless
500859.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Resolve the "Boost" ability on each attachment in play that belongs to the Paibok encounter set. When Revealed (Hero): Paibok attacks you. Give him 1 additional boost card if you are stunned or confused. "I don’t know if you’re incredibly brave or just plain stupid to fight me." —Paibok

500860.Name: Power Demonstration
500860.text: When Revealed: Resolve the "Boost" ability on each attachment in play, that belongs to the Paibok encounter set. "You are an impetuous boy, and today I am going to teach you why I am known as the Power Skrull!" —Paibok

500861.Name: O.M.N.I.T.R.O.N.I.C.U.S.
500861.text: Each [[revenger]] minion gains villainous. Hero Action: If there is no [[revenger]] enemy in play, spend [energy][energy] resources → discard this card. “I am O.M.N.I.T.R.O.N.I.C.U.S.! Organo-Mechanic Nexus-Iterated Techno-Radical Organizational Networked Intelligent Computer Unity System!!!”

500862.Name: Angar the Screamer
500862.text: [star] Angar the Screamer's attacks gain ranged. Forced Interrupt: When Angar the Screamer attacks you, also resolve his attack against each other hero. "I am David Angar -- I am sane! And more -- am the Screamer-- master of the mind-storm! I am power!"

500863.Name: Asti the All-Seeing
500863.text: Forced Interrupt: When Asti the All- Seeing takes any amount of damage, place 1 absorption counter on it. When Defeated: Assign 2 indirect damage among players for each absorption counter on Asti the All- Seeing. "We mustn't be afraid to dream a little bigger."

500864.Name: Skar
500864.text: [star] Skar's attacks gain overkill. When Revealed: Exhaust a character you control. "I got him from an alternate universe where Mars is the dominant planet in this solar system." —The Maker

500865.Name: The Maker
500865.text: The Maker cannot take damage while another [[revenger]] enemy is in play. When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for The Revenge Time side scheme and reveal it. "We mustn't be afraid to dream a little bigger."

500866.Name: Vermin
500866.text: [star] Vermin's attacks deal indirect damage. [star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, it deals indirect damage. "﻿SSSCURRY, MY FRIENDSSS! SSSCURRY AND SSSWARM! BITE AND SSSCRATCH! VICTORY CAN STILL BE OURSSS!"

500867.Name: White Tiger
500867.text: Quickstrike. (After this minion engages your hero, it attacks you.) When Defeated: Give the villain 1 facedown boost card. "Your team is split, weakened, demoralized. Fodder for out New Revengers."

500868.Name: The Revenge Time
500868.text: The New Revengers were a group of villains assembled by the Maker to strike directly at the New Avengers in his takeover attempt. The villain gains the [[revenger]] trait. When Revealed: Place 1 additional threat here for each [[revenger]] enemy in play. [acceleration]

500869.Name: Forming the Revengers
500869.text: When Revealed: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a card with the [[revenger]] trait is discarded. Reveal that card. "New Revengers to translocation bay. The time has come..." —The Maker

500870a.Name: Kly'bn
500870a.text: When Revealed: Place 1 faith counter on Kly'bn. Forced Response: After resolving step one of the villain phase, discard the top card of the encounter deck for each faith counter on Kly'bn. Deal the players each non-treachery card discarded this way as a facedown encounter card in player order.

500870b.Name: Sl'gur't
500870b.text: When Revealed: Place 1 faith counter on Sl'gur't. Forced Response: After resolving step one of the villain phase, discard the top card of the encounter deck for each faith counter on Sl'gur't. Deal the players each treachery card discarded this way as a facedown encounter card in player order.

500871a.Name: Kly'bn
500871a.text: When Revealed: Place 1 faith counter on Kly'bn. Forced Response: After resolving step one of the villain phase, discard the top card of the encounter deck for each faith counter on Kly'bn. Deal the players each non-treachery card discarded this way as a facedown encounter card in player order.

500871b.Name: Sl'gur't
500871b.text: When Revealed: Place 1 faith counter on Sl'gur't. Forced Response: After resolving step one of the villain phase, discard the top card of the encounter deck for each faith counter on Sl'gur't. Deal the players each treachery card discarded this way as a facedown encounter card in player order.

500872a.Name: Kly'bn
500872a.text: When Revealed: Place 1 faith counter on Kly'bn and give him a tough status card. Forced Response: After resolving step one of the villain phase, discard the top card of the encounter deck for each faith counter on Kly'bn. Deal the players each non-treachery card discarded this way as a facedown encounter card in player order.

500872b.Name: Sl'gur't
500872b.text: When Revealed: Place 1 faith counter on Sl'gur't and give her a tough status card. Forced Response: After resolving step one of the villain phase, discard the top card of the encounter deck for each faith counter on Sl'gur't. Deal the players each treachery card discarded this way as a facedown encounter card in player order.

500873a.Name: Protect the Pantheon
500873a.text: Contents: Kly'bn I and Kly'bn II (Kly'bn II and Kly'bn III instead for expert mode). Skrull Pantheon, Dard'van Sect and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (Skrull Society). Setup: Set the Skrull Pantheon environment aside, out of play.

500873b.Name: Protect the Pantheon
500873b.text: Forced Interrupt: When the last threat is removed from this scheme, put the set-aside Skrull Pantheon environment into play, [[destroyed]] side faceup. Advance to stage 2B. When Completed: Put the set-aside Skrull Pantheon environment into play, [[stronghold]] side faceup. Advance to stage 2A.

500874a.Name: Slaying the False Gods
500874a.text: Kly'bn, the Eternal Skrull, and Sl'gur't of the Infinite Names are presented as the emperor and the empress of the Skrull Pantheon. When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for Strengthen the Faith side scheme, reveal it and place 2[per_hero] additional threat on it.

500874b.Name: Slaying the False Gods
500874b.text: Kly'bn and Sl'gur't indirectly supported the creation and expansion of the Skrull Empire. They conquered and enslaved the pantheons of the conquered races, numbering nearly 1000 pantheons. Now the duo is after the gods of Earth. When Revealed: Flip the villain. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

500875a.Name: Skrull Pantheon
500875a.text: Hero Action: Spend 2 resources of any type → remove 1 faith counter from the villain. Skrull Pantheon was successfully destroyed and the Skrull Diety became really angry.

500875b.Name: Skrull Pantheon
500875b.text: Hero Action: Spend 2 resources of the same type → remove 1 faith counter from the villain. Kly'bn and Sl'gur't joined together and ascended to godhood becoming the leaders of the Skrull Pantheon.

500876.Name: Blessed by Kly'bn
500876.text: Attach to the minion with the lowest SCH. If you cannot, this card gains surge. X is equal to the number of faith counters on the villain. [star] Boost: If this activation is a scheme, this card gets +2 boost icons ([boost][boost]) for this activation.

500877.Name: Blessed by Sl'gur't
500877.text: Attach to the minion with the lowest ATK. If you cannot, this card gains surge. X is equal to the number of faith counters on the villain. [star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, this card gets +2 boost icons ([boost][boost]) for this activation.

500878.Name: Nogor
500878.text: [star] Nogor gets +1 SCH, +1 ATK and +1 hit point for each faith counter on the villain. When Revealed: Flip the villain. [star] Boost: Flip the villain. "I am the living harness of the power of the gods."

500879.Name: Shapeless Wastes
500879.text: The Skrullian equivalent of Hell is known as the Shapeless Wastes. Hinder 2[per_hero]. Forced Response: After an ally or a minion is defeated, if that character has the [[skrull]] trait, flip the villain. Otherwise, place 1 faith counter on the villain.

500880.Name: Strengthen the Faith
500880.text: Most Skrulls worship Kly'bn, the Eternal Skrull, and Sl'gur't of the Infinite Names. They are the only true gods of the Skrull Empire. Forced Response: After a [[skrull]] minion enters play, place 1 faith counter on the villain. [star] Boost: Place 1 faith counter on the villain.

500881.Name: Prayer to Kly'bn
500881.text: When Revealed: If Kly'bn is in play, he activates against you. Otherwise, flip the villain. [star] Boost: If Kly'bn is not in play, flip the villain. "For I am Kly'bn. I am the Eternal Skrull. And I love you." —Kly'bn

500882.Name: Prayer to Sl'gur't
500882.text: When Revealed: If Sl'gur't is in play, she activates against you. Otherwise, flip the villain. [star] Boost: If Sl'gur't is not in play, flip the villain. "What do they call you? I pray you, tell us…" —Sl'gur't

500883.Name: Talisman of the Skrulls
500883.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for Nogor and reveal him. If Nogor did not enter play this way, this card gains surge. "The Talisman is the representation of the gods, and his presence is required to ensure the gods' blessing on our endeavors" —Jazinda

500884.Name: Dard'van Fanatic
500884.text: When Revealed: Choose to either deal 1 damage to each character you control or place 1 threat on each scheme in play. "I belong to the Dard'van sect. It's considered extreme by some." —Grrix

500885.Name: Dard'van Priest
500885.text: When Revealed: Dard'van Priest schemes. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Dard'van Priest would attack, instead choose a card in play with a "When Revealed" ability and resolve that ability. "He loves you."

500886.Name: Dard'van Sect
500886.text: A zealous sect of the Skrull Empire which follows prophecies foretelling that Earth will become the new home for the Skrull race. When Revealed: Give the villain 1 facedown boost card. [hazard]

500887.Name: Collective Prayers
500887.text: When Revealed: Discard the top card of the encounter deck for each character in play. Reveal each card discarded this way that belongs to the Dard'van Sect encounter set. "…the first one loves us all alike." —Grrix

500888.Name: Sectarian Practices
500888.text: When Revealed: Choose a card in play with a "When Revealed" ability and resolve that ability. If you cannot, this card gains surge. "Trust. What do humans know of trust? You can't even agree on one god." —Nogor

500889a.Name: Spider-Woman(Veranke)
500889a.text: Spider-Woman cannot take damage. [star] Forced Response: After Spider-Woman attacks you, place 1 suspicion counter on "Who do you trust?". You are a Skrull! — Hero Action: Exhaust a hero and spend 1[per_hero] resources of any type → flip Spider-Woman. (The players can pay this ability's costs as a group.) “We now know the words as written are truth!”

500889b.Name: Queen Veranke
500889b.text: Forced Response: After the villain phase ends, if any player is in alter-ego form, flip Queen Veranke. When Defeated: Remove all suspicion counters from "Who Do You Trust?". "I will be among those on Earth infiltration assignment. I will take a role in this strategy.”

500890a.Name: Spider-Woman(Veranke)
500890a.text: Spider-Woman cannot take damage. [star] Forced Response: After Spider-Woman attacks you, place 1 suspicion counter on "Who do you trust?". You are a Skrull! — Hero Action: Exhaust a hero and spend 1[per_hero] resources of any type → flip Spider-Woman. (The players can pay this ability's costs as a group.) “We now know the words as written are truth!”

500890b.Name: Queen Veranke
500890b.text: Forced Response: After the villain phase ends, if any player is in alter-ego form, flip Queen Veranke. When Defeated: Remove all suspicion counters from "Who Do You Trust?". "I will be among those on Earth infiltration assignment. I will take a role in this strategy.”

500891a.Name: Spider-Woman(Veranke)
500891a.text: Spider-Woman cannot take damage. [star] Forced Response: After Spider-Woman attacks you, place 1 suspicion counter on "Who do you trust?". You are a Skrull! — Hero Action: Exhaust a hero and spend 1[per_hero] resources of any type → flip Spider-Woman. (The players can pay this ability's costs as a group.) “We now know the words as written are truth!”

500891b.Name: Queen Veranke
500891b.text: Forced Response: After the villain phase ends, if any player is in alter-ego form, flip Queen Veranke. Otherwise, discard the top card of the encounter deck, if it is a treachery, flip Queen Veranke. "I will be among those on Earth infiltration assignment. I will take a role in this strategy.”

500892a.Name: The Infiltration Has Begun
500892a.text: Contents: Spider-Woman I and Spider-Woman II (Spider-Woman II and Spider-Woman III instead for expert mode). Secret Invasion and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (Army of Skrulls). Setup: Create the [[impostor]] deck and set it next to the encounter deck (see insert). Put the "Who Do You Trust?" environment into play.

500892b.Name: The Infiltration Has Begun
500892b.text: [star] Place 1 additional threat here for each [[skrull]] enemy in play and each [[impostor]] ally in play. Forced Response: After your turn ends, if there are less than 2[per_hero] suspicion counters on "Who Do You Trust?", put a [[camouflaged]] ally at random from the [[impostor]] deck into play under your control.

500893a.Name: The Skrull Invasion
500893a.text: The Skrulls, a ruthless group of alien shapeshifters, have secretly replaced many heroes on Earth with impostors and now they are about to strike. When Revealed: If Mistrust and Paranoia is in play, remove 2[per_hero] suspicion counters from "Who Do You Trust?". Otherwise, find Mistrust and Paranoia and reveal it.

500893b.Name: The Skrull Invasion
500893b.text: X is equal to twice the number of [[skrull]] enemies in play. Forced Response: After your turn ends, if there are less than 2[per_hero] suspicion counters on "Who Do You Trust?", put a [[revealed]] minion at random from the [[impostor]] deck into play engaged with you. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

500894.Name: "Who Do You Trust?"
500894.text: Forced Interrupt: When any amount of threat is placed on the main scheme, remove an equal amount of suspicion counters from here. Forced Interrupt: When any amount of threat is removed from the main scheme, place an equal amount of suspicion counters here.

500895.Name: Impostor
500895.text: Treat attached ally as a [[skrull]] minion with a blank text box. Attached minion's SCH is equal to its printed THW and it does not take consequential damage. When Revealed: Attach to the non- [[skrull]] ally with the most remaining hit points without Impostor attached. Attached ally engages its controller. Otherwise, the villain schemes.

500896.Name: Super-Skrull Enhancement
500896.text: Attach to the [[skrull]] minion with the most remaining hit points without another Super-Skrull Enhancement attached. If you cannot, choose a [[camouflaged]] ally, flip that ally and attach this card to it. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Attached minion gets +2 hit points. . [star] Boost: Reveal this card, after . this activation ends.

500897.Name: Super-Skrull Enhancement
500897.text: Attach to the [[skrull]] minion with the most remaining hit points without another Super-Skrull Enhancement attached. If you cannot, choose a [[camouflaged]] ally, flip that ally and attach this card to it. Otherwise, this card gains surge. [star] Boost: Reveal this card, after this activation ends.

500898.Name: Super-Skrull Enhancement
500898.text: Attach to the [[skrull]] minion with the most remaining hit points without another Super-Skrull Enhancement attached. If you cannot, choose a [[camouflaged]] ally, flip that ally and attach this card to it. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Attached minion gains retaliate 1. . [star] Boost: Reveal this card, after . this activation ends.

500899.Name: Chaos on the Battlefield
500899.text: "All I know is, if there's only one way to figure out who's a Skrull… Then I'm more than happy to do it!" —Wolverine Incite 2. When Revealed: Place X additional threat here, where X is equal to the total SCH of all [[impostor]] characters in play. [acceleration]

500900.Name: Fulfill the Prophecy
500900.text: The holy text of the Book of Worlds was the main reason the Skrulls turned the invasion of Earth into a holy war. They believed it rightfully theirs. Hinder 1[per_hero]. Each [[skrull]] minion gains guard and patrol. [hazard]

500901.Name: Mistrust and Paranoia
500901.text: Players cannot attack minions engaged with other players or defend against them. Players cannot pay any card's or ability's costs as a group. When Revealed: Place 1 additional threat here for each friendly character in play. [acceleration]

500902.Name: Arrival of Impostors
500902.text: When Revealed: Each player puts a [[camouflaged]] ally at random from the [[impostor]] deck into play under their control. [star] Boost: Put a [[camouflaged]] ally at random from the [[impostor]] deck into play under your control. "It's all meant to be. Fight or do not." —Queen Veranke

500903.Name: Camouflage
500903.text: When Revealed (Queen Veranke): Flip Queen Veranke. Remove 3 suspicion counter from "Who Do You Trust?". When Revealed (Spider-Woman): Spider-Woman schemes. [star] Boost: Flip Queen Veranke, after this activation ends.

500904.Name: Glory to the Skrull Empire
500904.text: When Revealed: Give the villain and each [[skrull]] minion engaged with you a tough status card. If the villain already has a tough status card, this card gains surge. [star] Boost: Give the villain a tough status card.

500905.Name: Infiltration Ritual
500905.text: When Revealed: Put a [[camouflaged]] ally at random from the [[impostor]] deck into play under any player's control. If you cannot, this card gains surge. [star] Boost: Remove 3 suspicion counters from "Who Do You Trust?". "You will never shift back to this form." —Queen Veranke

500906.Name: Invasion Fleet
500906.text: When Revealed: Each player puts a [[revealed]] minion at random from the [[impostor]] deck into play engaged with them. [star] Boost: Put a [[revealed]] minion at random from the [[impostor]] deck into play engaged with you.

500907.Name: Revelation
500907.text: When Revealed: Flip the [[camouflaged]] ally with the most remaining hit points. If you cannot, put a [[revealed]] minion at random from the [[impostor]] deck into play engaged with you. [star] Boost: Flip 1 [[camouflaged]] ally you control, after this activation ends.

500908a.Name: Captain America(Pitt'o Nili)
500908a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Captain America would leave play, flip him instead. "Your death will bring this world's heroes to their knees. Your death will bring the writings to life.” —Queen Veranke

500908b.Name: Pitt'o Nili
500908b.text: Guard. (While this minion is engaged with you, you cannot attack the villain.) When Revealed: Heal all damage from Pitt'o Nili and put him into play engaged with you.

500909a.Name: Captain Marvel(Khn'nr)
500909a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Captain Marvel would leave play, flip him instead. "I Speak Skrull perfectly well."

500909b.Name: Khn'nr
500909b.text: When Revealed: Heal all damage from Khn'nr and put him into play engaged with you. When Defeated: Remove all suspicion counters from "Who Do You Trust?".

500910a.Name: Captain Marvel(M'lanz)
500910a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Captain Marvel would leave play, flip her instead. "It was written a world of blue would be the home for all that believed." —Queen Veranke

500910b.Name: M'lanz
500910b.text: When Revealed: Heal all damage from M'lanz and put her into play engaged with you. [star] Forced Interrupt: When M'lanz attacks you, also resolve her attack against each other hero.

500911a.Name: Carnage(Zr'x)
500911a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Carnage would leave play, flip him instead. "It was written and it has come true." —Queen Veranke

500911b.Name: Zr'x
500911b.text: Toughness. (This character enters play with a tough status card.) When Revealed: Heal all damage from Zr'x and put him into play engaged with you.

500912a.Name: Daredevil(Trl'k)
500912a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Daredevil would leave play, flip him instead. "As the prophets wrote down to our ancestors." —Queen Veranke

500912b.Name: Trl'k
500912b.text: While the engaged player is engaged with another [[skrull]] minion Trl'k cannot take damage. When Revealed: Heal all damage from Trl'k and put him into play engaged with you.

500913a.Name: Deathlok(Fry'lu)
500913a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Deathlok would leave play, flip him instead. "This will not be easy. Most of us will die before this is over." —Queen Veranke

500913b.Name: Fry'lu
500913b.text: When Revealed: Heal all damage from Fry'lu and put her into play engaged with you. When Defeated: Deal the player who defeated Fry'lu a facedown encounter card.

500914a.Name: Dum Dum Dugan(Sn'Tlo)
500914a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Dum Dum Dugan would leave play, flip him instead. "You don't reveal your true self in the open."

500914b.Name: Sn'Tlo
500914b.text: Reduce the amount of damage Sn'Tlo takes from each attack by 1. When Revealed: Heal all damage from Sn'Tlo and put him into play engaged with you.

500915a.Name: Elektra(Siri)
500915a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Elektra would leave play, flip her instead. "My identity was not detected."

500915b.Name: Siri
500915b.text: Patrol. (While this minion is engaged with you, you cannot thwart the main scheme.) When Revealed: Heal all damage from Siri and put her into play engaged with you.

500916a.Name: Giant-Man(D'lutz)
500916a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Giant-Man would leave play, flip him instead. "It was written in our Book of Worlds." —Queen Veranke

500916b.Name: D'lutz
500916b.text: Retaliate 1. When Revealed: Heal all damage from D'lutz and put him into play engaged with you.

500917a.Name: Invisible Woman(De'Lila)
500917a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Invisible Woman would leave play, flip her instead. "It's true! I'm not Susan Richards; I am a Skrull!"

500917b.Name: De'Lila
500917b.text: As an additional cost to attack De'Lila, you must spend 1 resource of any type. When Revealed: Heal all damage from De'Lila and put her into play engaged with you.

500918a.Name: Iron Fist(Grrix)
500918a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Iron Fist would leave play, flip him instead. "He loves me… He loves me… He loves me…" —Queen Veranke

500918b.Name: Grrix
500918b.text: When Revealed: Heal all damage from Grrix and put him into play engaged with you. When Defeated: The villain attacks the player who defeated Grrix (even if that player is in alter-ego form).

500919a.Name: Iron Man(Ssrov)
500919a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Iron Man would leave play, flip him instead. "In spite of all that you've done to our empire, he loves you." —Queen Veranke

500919b.Name: Ssrov
500919b.text: [star] While the villain has the [[revealed]] trait, Ssrov gets +1 SCH and +1 ATK. When Revealed: Heal all damage from Ssrov and put him into play engaged with you.

500920a.Name: Moon Knight(Hs'fld)
500920a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Moon Knight would leave play, flip him instead. "A billion Skrulls died to prove the words true." —Queen Veranke

500920b.Name: Hs'fld
500920b.text: When Revealed: Heal all damage from Hs'fld and put him into play engaged with you. When Defeated: The player who defeated Hs'fld puts a [[camouflaged]] ally at random from the [[impostor]] deck into play under their control.

500921a.Name: Nick Fury(H'kurrek)
500921a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Nick Fury would leave play, flip him instead. "It was written a wave would come." —Queen Veranke

500921b.Name: H'kurrek
500921b.text: [star] H'kurrek's attacks gain overkill, piercing, and ranged. When Revealed: Heal all damage from H'kurrek and put him into play engaged with you.

500922a.Name: Phoenix(Korya)
500922a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Phoenix would leave play, flip her instead. "You will kill her. After we'll switch you out." —Queen Veranke

500922b.Name: Korya
500922b.text: When Revealed: Heal all damage from Korya and put her into play engaged with you. [star] Forced Response: After Korya attacks you, discard the top card of each player's deck.

500923a.Name: Spider-Man(Ch'Gra)
500923a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Spider-Man would leave play, flip him instead. "Well, I do hate myself, but I don't know if I feel like smacking myself around."

500923b.Name: Ch'Gra
500923b.text: When Revealed: Heal all damage from Hagar and put him into play engaged with you. When Defeated: Flip Queen Veranke.

500924a.Name: Thor(Hagar)
500924a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Thor would leave play, flip him instead. "He even loves you." —Criti Noll

500924b.Name: Hagar
500924b.text: [star] Hagar's attacks deal indirect damage. When Revealed: Heal all damage from Hagar and put him into play engaged with you.

500925a.Name: Venom(Dharr)
500925a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Venom would leave play, flip him instead. "We now know the words as written are truth!" —Queen Veranke

500925b.Name: Dharr
500925b.text: Villainous. (When this minion activates, give it a boost card.) When Revealed: Heal all damage from Dharr and put him into play engaged with you.

500926a.Name: Wolverine(V'lrym)
500926a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Wolverine would leave play, flip him instead. "This is as it is written. And no Skrull or man can change that." —Commander Chrell

500926b.Name: V'lrym
500926b.text: Quickstrike. When Revealed: Heal all damage from V'lrym and put him into play engaged with you.

500927a.Name: Yellowjacket(Criti Noll)
500927a.text: Forced Interrupt: When Yellowjacket would leave play, flip him instead. "It won't be long until we have a Skrull in every state!"

500927b.Name: Criti Noll
500927b.text: Incite 3. (When this card is revealed, place 3 threat on the main scheme.) When Revealed: Heal all damage from Criti Noll and put her into play engaged with you.

500931.Name: Crusader
500931.text: Victory 1. When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to each character you control. Give the villain 1 facedown boost card for each character defeated this way. [star] Boost: Put Crusader into play engaged with you. "I've been entrusted with the most important duty in the Skrull Empire."

500932.Name: Enemy Adaptation
500932.text: Attach to a [[skrull]] minion. If you cannot, attach to the villain. You cannot defend against attached enemy's attacks. Hero Action: Give the villain 1 facedown boost card → discard Enemy Adaptation.

500933.Name: Freedom Ring
500933.text:
Attach to Crusader. If Crusader is not in play, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a minion is discarded. Put that minion into play engaged with you and attach this card to it. If you cannot, give the villain 1 facedown boost card.
Attached minion gains villainous.

500934.Name: Spy Training
500934.text: Z'Reg, a Skrull operative who had been scarred by fellow trainee K'rtem, was sent to spy on the Avengers after his training was complete. When Revealed: Defeat an ally you control and give the villain 1 facedown boost card. [hazard]

500935.Name: Rivals to the End
500935.text: When Revealed: Choose a minion. That minion attacks your hero twice in a row. If no attack was made this way, give the villain 1 facedown boost card for each character you control. "Your strategy is pathetic, human! You rush into battle and then you cradle your weak! Ha! Let me show you how Skrulls heed the call!" —K'rtem

500936.Name: Jazinda
500936.text: Victory 1. The villain gets +1 SCH. [star] Boost: Put Jazinda into play engaged with you. "Pretending to be human is amusing. Especially when I do it so much better than you."

500937.Name: Skrull Energy Gun
500937.text: Attach to a [[skrull]] minion. If you cannot, attach to the villain. While attached to a [[skrull]] enemy, attached enemy's attacks gain overkill, piercing, and ranged. Hero Action: Spend a [physical] resource → attach this card to another enemy.

500938.Name: Sy-Torak Gem
500938.text: Attach to Jazinda. If you cannot, attach to the villain. Attached character gets +3 hit points. Hero Action: Give the villain 1 facedown boost card and spend a [energy] resource → discard Sy-Torak Gem.

500939.Name: Stealing for the Empire
500939.text: A former agent of the Skrull Empire was sent to recover a sacred artifact of the Skrull stolen by the Kree. When Revealed: Discard cards from the encounter deck until you discard an attachment. Reveal that attachment. Then, place threat on the main scheme equal to the number of boost icons ([boost]) on that attachment. [acceleration]

500940.Name: Skrull of Royal Blood
500940.text: Surge. When Revealed: Shuffle all cards with the highest number of boost icons ([boost]) in the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.

500941.Name: Skymax
500941.text: Victory 1. When Revealed: Shuffle all minions from the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. [star] Boost: Put Skymax into play engaged with you. "Oh, he fought bravely, but never really stood a chance… against the Skrullian Skymaster."

500942.Name: Changing Appearance
500942.text: Attach to a [[skrull]] minion. If you cannot, attach to the villain. Attached enemy cannot be attacked. Forced Interrupt: When attached enemy would attack, it schemes instead. Then, discard this card. Hero Action: Spend 2 resources . of a diferent type → discard . Skrull Adaptation.

500943.Name: Surprising Alliance
500943.text: "I am my world's last survivor." —Skymax Forced Response: When a player discards an ally from their hand, they put that ally into play engaged with them instead. Treat that ally as a minion with a blank text box. Its SCH is equal to its printed THW and it does not take consequential damage. [crisis]

500944.Name: Shape Alteration
500944.text: When Revealed: Remove each stunned and confused status card from each [[skrull]] enemy and give each [[skrull]] enemy a tough status card. If there are no [[skrull]] enemies in play, this card gains surge. [star] Boost: Give 1 [[skrull]] enemy a tough status card.

500945.Name: War Skrull
500945.text: Victory 1. [star] Forced Response: After War Skrull attacks you, discard the top 2 cards of your deck. [star] Boost: Put War Skrull into play engaged with you. "Did you really think, in that puny little head of yours, that you could go toe-to-toe with the might of the Skrull Empire?"

500946.Name: Impostor
500946.text: Treat attached ally as a [[skrull]] minion with a blank text box. Attached minion's SCH is equal to its printed THW and it does not take consequential damage. When Revealed: Attach to the non- [[skrull]] ally with the most remaining hit points without Impostor attached. Attached ally engages its controller. Otherwise, the villain schemes.

500947.Name: Skrull Commander
500947.text: Each other [[skrull]] minion gets +1 ATK. [star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, this card gets +2 boost icons ([boost][boost]) for this attack. "If he was a significant threat, we would know who he is" —Commander Ak'strk

500948.Name: Skrull Geneticist
500948.text: [hazard] [star] Boost: Deal yourself a facedown encounter card. "These results are fascinating"

500949.Name: Cloning Program
500949.text: The Skrull scientists had cloned samples of Deadpool's blood and use it to upgrade a squadron of Super-Skrulls. They also place Deadpool in charge of training these new Super-Skrulls. Each [[skrull]] minion activates 1 additional time during the step two of the villain phase. Threat cannot be removed from this scheme while there is no [[skrull]] minion in play. [crisis]

500950.Name: Xavin
500950.text: Victory 1. When Revealed: Discard cards from the encounter deck until a treachery is discarded. Reveal that treachery. [star] Boost: Put Xavin into play engaged with you. "My name is Xavin, Super-Skrull-in-training. I was forced to abandon my outpost world to protect my mate from murderous thugs like you."

500951.Name: Invisible Forcefield
500951.text: Attach to the enemy with the highest printed hit points and without another Invisible Forcefield attached. If you cannot, this card gains surge. Forced Interrupt: When any amount of damage would be dealt to attached character, place it here instead. Then, if there is at least 5 damage here, discard this card.

500952.Name: Super-Skrull Training Program
500952.text: "Always remember, when you face a superior opponent, learn their weaknesses. Exploit them. That is the Skrull way." —Commander Chrell When Revealed: Give each [[skrull]] enemy a tough status card. [amplify]

500953.Name: Going Nova
500953.text: When Revealed: Assign 2[per_hero] indirect damage among players. "Damnation. I keep forgetting how fragile you people are." —Xavin

500928.Name: Shaper of Worlds
500928.text: Forced Response: After a player attacks Shaper of Worlds, shuffle this card into that player's deck. Forced Interrupt: When Shaper of Worlds enters your hand, discard the top 4 cards of the encounter deck. Put Shaper of Worlds into play engaged with you.

500929.Name: Cosmic Cube Creation
500929.text: Hinder 4[per_hero]. Victory 2. When Revealed: Put the set-aside Shaper of Worlds into play engaged with you. When Defeated: Each player chooses a copy of the set-aside Cosmic Cube Fragment resource and shuffles it into their deck. [acceleration]

500954.Name: Impostor
500954.text: Treat attached ally as a [[skrull]] minion with a blank text box. Attached minion's SCH is equal to its printed THW and it does not take consequential damage. When Revealed: Attach to the non- [[skrull]] ally with the most remaining hit points without Impostor attached. Attached ally engages its controller. Otherwise, the villain schemes.

500955.Name: Cursed by the Past
500955.text: When Revealed: If your nemesis minion is in play, it activates against you. Otherwise, find your nemesis minion and reveal it. If your nemesis side scheme is in play, place threat on it equal to its starting threat value. Otherwise, find your nemesis side scheme and reveal it. Shuffle your remaining set-aside nemesis set into the encounter deck.

500956.Name: Experiment Subject
500956.text: When Revealed: Discard the highest- cost upgrade you control. If no card was discarded this way, the villain schemes. "I am curious to see just what the upper limits of his extension are…" —Skrull Scientist

500957.Name: Forge Ahead
500957.text: When Revealed: Each minion engaged with you schemes. If no scheme was made this way, the villain schemes. "We are not speaking of conquest. Think of it more as a… strategic protective occupation." —Nogor

500958.Name: Mobilization
500958.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Engage each minion in play. The villain schemes. When Revealed (Hero): The villain and each minion engaged with you attacks you. "We are by any and all definitions, the superior race!" —Dorrek VII

500959.Name: Stick to the Plan
500959.text: When Revealed: The villain attacks the hero with the most remaining hit points. If no attack was made this way, the villain schemes. "Bow down and beg to the Skrulls!" —Paibok

500960.Name: Replaced Archenemy
500960.text: Attached minion gains the [[skrull]] trait. When Revealed: If your nemesis minion is in play, attach this card to it. Then, it activates against you. Otherwise, find your nemesis minion, attach this card to it and reveal it.

500961.Name: Focused Attention
500961.text: Surge. When Revealed: Give the villain 1 facedown boost card. "Earth shall pay for what it has done to my people!" —Super-Skrull

500962.Name: Tricky Assault
500962.text: When Revealed: Flip to hero form. The villain attacks you. If this attack is undefended, the villain schemes. "We are prepared to accept your surrender." —Unknown Skrull

999102.Name: Strength in Diversity
999102.text: Defeat any scenario as any hero(es). For this scenario, each player must adhere to the following deckbuilding restriction: no two allies in your deck can have any of the same printed traits, including identity-specific allies.

203001b.Name: Alex Summers
203001b.text: Rest & Recharge — Action: Remove 1 plasma counter from here → heal 2 damage from Alex Summers. Search your deck and discard pile for a Cosmic Energy resource and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.)

203001a.Name: Havok
203001a.text: Plasma Generation — Response: After you pay for a card using only [energy] resources, place 1 plasma counter on Havok (to a maximum of 3). “You keep this up and soon...you'll cry Havok!”

203002.Name: Polaris
203002.text: Hero Response: After Polaris enters play, place 1 plasma counter on Havok (to a maximum of 3). If this places the third plasma counter on Havok, each player may choose a card in their discard pile and add it to their hand.

203003.Name: Energy Absorption
203003.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage from an attack, prevent up to 4 of that damage. Then, if you took no damage from that attack, you may place a plasma counter on Havok (to a maximum of 3). “C'mon, give me all you've got!” —Havok

203004.Name: Plasma Blast
203004.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy, plus 2 additional damage for each plasma counter on Havok. This attack gains overkill. “I've been afraid of letting loose ever since I first manifested my powers. But here goes!” —Havok

203005.Name: Plasma Burst
203005.text: Hero Action: Resolve the "Special" ability on Plasma Discharge. “With everything that's been happening, I actually find this pretty cathartic.” —Havok

203006.Name: Wreak Havoc
203006.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from a scheme, plus 1 additional threat for each plasma counter on Havok. You may remove a plasma counter from Havok to repeat this thwart on another scheme once.

203007.Name: Cosmic Energy
203007.text: Interrupt: When you spend this card, choose to either generate an additional [energy] resource or place 1 plasma counter on Havok (to a maximum of 3).

203008.Name: Containment Suit
203008.text: Hero Interrupt: When you would resolve the "Special" ability on Plasma Discharge, exhaust Containment Suit and choose a player → deal 3 damage to the villain and each minion engaged with that player instead.

203009.Name: Controlled Blast
203009.text: Hero Interrupt: When you would resolve the "Special" ability on Plasma Discharge, remove 1 threat from each scheme instead. “You'd be surprised how many problems you can solve with a controlled plasma blast.” —Havok

203010.Name: Plasma Discharge
203010.text: Permanent. Setup. Forced Response: After you place a third plasma counter on Havok, remove all plasma counters on him. Resolve this card's "Special" ability. Special: Deal 1 damage to each enemy. “You keep this up and soon...you'll cry Havok!” —Havok

203011.Name: Brothers 'Til the End
203011.text: Team-Up (Cyclops and Havok). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. Deal 1 damage to each other enemy. This attack gains ranged. “Just like old times, eh Alex?” —Cyclops

203012.Name: Energy Surge
203012.text:
Choose one, then discard this obligation:
. Exhaust Containment Suit. If you cannot, exhaust your identity.
. Deal 1 damage to each character other than your identity and Cyclops/Scott Summers. This card gains surge.

203013.Name: Reign of Fire
203013.text: After a bloody civil war, Vulcan has crowned himself emperor of the Shi'ar, and his forces now scour the galaxy for Havok and his allies. Forced Interrupt: When the villain phase ends, deal 1 indirect damage to each player. [star] Boost: Deal 1 indirect damage to each player. [hazard]

203014.Name: Vulcan
203014.text: Retaliate 1. Reduce all damage dealt to Vulcan by 1. [[superpower]] cards cost 1 additional resource to play. (Havok's nemesis minion.)

203015.Name: Deathbird
203015.text: Teamwork ([[imperial guard]]). [star] Forced Response: After Deathbird activates against you, place 1 troop counter on Shi'ar Legion. If you cannot, find Shi'ar Legion and put them into play engaged with the player with the fewest remaining hit points.

203016.Name: Shi'ar Legion
203016.text: Enters play with 3 troop counters. [star] Shi'ar Legion gets +X SCH and +X ATK, where X equals the number of troop counters here. Forced Interrupt: When Shi'ar Legion would take damage, remove 1 troop counter from here instead.

203201b.Name: Hercules Panhellenios
203201b.text: Wealth of Experience — Action: Search your deck for a card with the uses keyword and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.) "Ne'er hath the Prince of Power bothered with coin of the realm! It seemed such a trifle!”

203201a.Name: Hercules
203201a.text: Godlike Stamina — Action: Deal 2 damage to Hercules or give him a stunned status card → draw up to your printed hand size. (Limit once per round.) “Less talking and more fighting. For Olympus!”

203202.Name: Feat of Strength
203202.text: Requirement ([physical]). (While paying for this card, spend the listed resources.) Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Reduce the cost of the next card you play this round by 1. “There's something I have to do. A labor to complete.”

203203.Name: Have at Thee!
203203.text: Hero Action: Until the end of the round, Hercules gains retaliate 1 and each time an enemy attacks, you may declare Hercules the defender without exhausting him (using your DEF). “Thou wouldst dare strike the Lion of Olympus?!”

203204.Name: Mighty Blow
203204.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this card using only [physical] resources, stun or confuse that enemy. “What do you want from me? I punch stuff. It falls down! That's the only 'strategy' I've ever needed!”

203205.Name: Divine Intervention
203205.text: Uses (1 divinity counter). Hero Interrupt: When you reveal an encounter card, remove 1 divinity counter from here → cancel all of that card's effects and discard it. "Gods of Olympus, hear my prayer!" —Hercules

203206.Name: Olympus
203206.text: Hercules Panhellenios gets +2 REC. Cards that you control with the uses keyword enter play with 1 additional counter on them. “Olympus, land of beauty and hope unlimited, of art, music and poetry unsurpassed!” —Hercules

203207.Name: Godlike Endurance
203207.text: Uses (3 endurance counters). Interrupt: When you use a basic power, exhaust Godlike Endurance and remove 1 endurance counter from it → ready your identity. “The Lion of Olympus never tires!” —Hercules

203208.Name: Godlike Strength
203208.text: Uses (3 strength counters). Resource: Exhaust Godlike Strength and remove 1 strength counter from it → generate [physical][physical] resources. “None can match the strength of Hercules!” —Hercules

203209.Name: Godlike Fury
203209.text: Hercules gains retaliate 1. Hero Action (attack): Discard 1 card from your hand and exhaust Godlike Fury → deal 2 damage to an enemy. “Ha! You have earned the full wrath of a god!” —Hercules

203210.Name: Hercules' Helm
203210.text: Hercules gets +1 THW. Hero Action: Exhaust Hercules' Helm → draw 1 card, then choose one card in your hand and place it on top of your deck. “'I see you. Not with sorcery, with thermal imaging.”

203211.Name: Hercules' Mace
203211.text: Restricted. Hercules gets +1 ATK. Hero Response: After you give an enemy a status card, deal 2 damage to that enemy. “I bring you the gift...of battle!"

203212.Name: Immortal
203212.text: Response: After you take damage, heal 1 damage from your identity. (Limit once per phase.) Interrupt: When you would take damage that would defeat you, discard Immortal instead. “...is there some part of 'immortal' you don't get?"

203213.Name: Shield of Perseus
203213.text: Uses (1 gaze counter). Restricted. Hercules gets +1 DEF. Hero Action: Remove 1 gaze counter from here → stun each enemy in play. Give the villain a tough status card.

203214.Name: Excessive Revelry
203214.text: You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: Exhaust Hercules Panhellenios → remove Excessive Revelry from the game. Discard 1 card at random from your hand. Discard this obligation. [star] Boost: You are confused.

203215.Name: Clash of the Titans
203215.text: Seeking vengeance and glory, Ares brings war against Hercules and all those who stand with him. Have at thee! When Revealed: Give each enemy a facedown boost card. [amplify]

203216.Name: Ares
203216.text: Steady. Toughness. Forced Response: After a character attacks Ares, Ares attacks that character. "Men call me Ares... and tremble when they do. I am the God of War!"

203217.Name: Attrition
203217.text: When Revealed: Remove 1 counter from each player card with the uses keyword. Deal 1 damage to each friendly character. [star] Boost: Remove 1 counter from a card you control with the uses keyword.

203218.Name: Let There Be War
203218.text: When Revealed: Each minion attacks the player it is engaged with. Each player not engaged with a minion searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a minion and puts it into play engaged with them. (Shuffle.) [star] Boost: This attack gains overkill.

203101b.Name: Puddlegulp
203101b.text: Worthy — Action: Find Frogjolnir and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.)

203101a.Name: Throg
203101a.text: [star] Froglike Stamina — Response: After Throg uses a basic power, return Frogjolnir to your hand → ready Throg. (Limit once per phase.) “There is justice to be done, so let us hop to it!”

203102.Name: Airborne Amphibian
203102.text: Hero Action: Ready Throg and Frogjolnir. You may choose a minion engaged with another player and engage it to draw 1 card. "Back, vile fiend! Throg the Thunder Frog defends these lands!" —Throg

203103.Name: Great Courage
203103.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from a scheme. Engage any number of minions in play. For each minion engaged with you (to a maximum of 3), remove 2 threat from a scheme. "Though my size is small, my courage is not!" —Throg

203104.Name: Hammer Throw
203104.text: Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Frogjolnir and return it to your hand → deal 6 damage to an enemy. This attack gains overkill. "I have no more words for thee, villain. So now we let Frogjolnir do the talking." —Throg

203105.Name: Lightning Leap
203105.text: Hero Interrupt: When you make a basic attack against a minion engaged with a player, resolve that attack against the villain and each minion engaged with that player instead, ignoring the guard keyword. "Have at thee! And at thee! And thee!" —Throg

203106.Name: Thunderous Charge
203106.text: Hero Interrupt: When you make a basic thwart against a scheme, resolve that thwart against each scheme in play instead, ignoring the crisis icon (in the order of your choice, including any bonuses to your THW for that thwart). "Fear not my friends, I will save you!" —Throg

203107.Name: Foreverglade
203107.text: Alter-Ego Response: After you make a basic recovery, exhaust Foreverglade → ready Puddlegulp and draw 1 card. A kingdom in the marshland of Midgard where the razor-sharp songs of the cicadas melt against the bellowing of the toads and sing of glory.

203108.Name: Frog of Thunder
203108.text: Hero Resource: Exhaust Frog of Thunder → generate a [energy] resource. If you paid for a Throg card this way, deal 1 damage to an enemy. “I am the Frog of Thunder. The very skies must tremble when croaks the Mighty Throg!” —Throg

203109.Name: Frogjolnir
203109.text: Restricted. Throg gains the [[aerial]] trait. Hero Interrupt: When Throg uses a basic power, exhaust Frogjolnir → Throg gets +1 to that power for this use. “EMBIGGEN!” —Ms. Marvel

203110.Name: Throg's Armor
203110.text: You get +2 hit points. Hero Response: After you engage a minion, give Throg a tough status card. If you cannot, draw 1 card. (Limit once per phase.) “Have at thee, scoundrel!” —Throg

203111.Name: Trouble in Central Park
203111.text: Uses (3 foe counters). Victory 0. Forced Action: Seek a minion from the encounter deck and put it into play engaged with you → remove 1 foe counter from here. That enemy attacks you. (Limit once per round.)

203112.Name: Adorable Distraction
203112.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. Alligator Loki cannot be attacked. (Throg's nemesis side scheme.) [crisis]

203113.Name: Alligator Loki
203113.text: Forced Response: After Alligator Loki enters play, find Chomped and attach it to your identity. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Alligator Loki schemes and places threat, place that much threat on each side scheme. [star] Alligator Loki's attacks gain piercing.

203114.Name: Causing a Commotion
203114.text: When Revealed: Each player discards the top 3 cards of their deck and places 1 threat here for each different card type they discarded this way. [hazard]

203115.Name: "Lost" Property
203115.text: When Revealed: Each player tucks an identity-specific upgrade they control under this card. It cannot be found while under here. When Defeated: Add each card under here to its owner's hand.

203116.Name: Chomped
203116.text: Attach to your identity. Forced Interrupt: When the round ends, take 1 damage. Forced Interrupt: When you would use a basic power, discard Chomped and take 1 damage instead. [star] Boost: Reveal this card.

203301b.Name: Eddie Brock
203301b.text: So Happy Together — Setup: Put Symbiotic Bond into play, [[bonded ]]side faceup. Draw 1 card. While Symbiotic Bond is [[bonded]], Eddie Brock gets +3 REC and +1 hand size.

203301a.Name: Venom
203301a.text: We Are Venom — Resource: Place 1 facedown boost card here → generate [wild][wild] resources. (Limit once per round.) Forced Interrupt: When an enemy attacks you, move each facedown boost card from here to that enemy. (Limit once per round.) "We...are...VENOM..."

203302.Name: Spider-Man
203302.text: While Symbiotic Bond is attached to Spider-Man, reduce all consequential damage he takes by 1. Interrupt: When Spider-Man leaves play, draw 2 cards.

203303.Name: Webs of Venom
203303.text: Action (attack): Ready Venom or the ally with Symbiotic Bond attached → deal 5 damage to an enemy. If you have a facedown boost card, stun that enemy. “You're big... but we've fought bigger.”

203304.Name: Unbreakable Bond
203304.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When Venom defends, he gets +2 DEF for each boost card resolved during this attack (to a maximum of +6 DEF). Ignore each “Boost” ability for those boost cards. “Eddie... We are bonded forever. No one will break that bond.”

203305.Name: Horrify
203305.text: Hero Action (thwart): Place 2 confused status cards among enemies in play. Remove X threat from a scheme, where X is the number of confused enemies in play. “Stand in our way and Venom will feast on your entrails!”

203306.Name: “I Will Eat Your Brains!”
203306.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy (6 damage instead if you have a facedown boost card). If this attack defeats that enemy, heal 3 damage from Venom. “How shall we kill him? Slowly? No! Painfully! No! Slowly AND Painfully!”

203307.Name: Eddie's Apartment
203307.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Eddie's Apartment → shuffle 1 Venom card from your discard pile into your deck. If Symbiotic Bond is [[bonded]], draw 1 card. Otherwise, heal 2 damage from Eddie Brock. “Slowly Learning. Slowly. While Eddie is asleep...”

203308.Name: Lethal Protector
203308.text: Venom gets +1 DEF. Interrupt: When a boost card is turned face up while an enemy is attacking Venom, exhaust Lethal Protector → deal 1 damage to that enemy for each icon on that card.

203309.Name: Tooth and Nail
203309.text:
Venom gains steady.
While you have a facedown boost card, Venom gets +1 ATK and his basic attacks gains piercing and overkill.

203310.Name: Klyntar Tendrils
203310.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Klyntar Tendrils → if Symbiotic Bond is: • [[bonded]], remove 2 threat from a scheme. • Attached to an ally, ready that ally.

203311a.Name: Symbiotic Bond
203311a.text: Permanent. Venom gets +1 THW, +1 ATK and +1 DEF. Forced Interrupt: When the villain initiates an attack against Venom, that attack gains overkill. Action: Spend 2 resources of the same type → flip this card.

203311b.Name: Symbiotic Bond
203311b.text: Permanent. Attach to an ally. Attached ally gets +2 hit points, +1 THW, and +1 ATK. Forced Response: When attached ally leaves play, flip this card.

203312.Name: Sonic Vulnerability
203312.text: Flip Symbiotic Bond to its [[bonded ]]side. Treat the printed text box of Symbiotic Bond as if it were blank. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Eddie Brock and take 1 damage → discard this obligation.

203313.Name: Fire Vulnerability
203313.text:
If Symbiotic Bond is [[bonded]], take 2 indirect damage. Discard this obligation.
If Symbiotic Bond is attached to an ally, deal 3 damage to that ally. Discard this obligation.

203314.Name: Maximum Carnage
203314.text: Carnage and his lover Shriek are committing a murder spree across Manhattan. Venom and Spider-Man reluctantly agree to work together to stop his rampage. Hinder 2[per_hero]. Assault. When Defeated: Deal 1 damage to each hero. [crisis]

203315.Name: Carnage
203315.text: Villainous. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Carnage would scheme against you, he attacks an ally you control instead, if able. (Venom's nemesis minion.) “I'M GOING TO PAINT THE TOWN RED!!!!”

203316.Name: Shriek
203316.text: Villainous. Patrol. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Shriek attacks, if Carnage is in play, give her 1 additional boost card for this activation. “My sonic scream didn't hurt you, did it? I get angry when someone's hurting my man...”

203317.Name: Sonic Boom
203317.text: When Revealed: Either spend [energy][mental][physical] resources or exhaust each character you control. [star] Boost: If this activation deals damage to you, exhaust your hero.

203318.Name: Paint the Town Red
203318.text: Attach to Carnage. If you cannot, attach to a minion. Forced Interrupt: After attached minion attacks you, deal 1 damage to each character you control. [star] Boost: Deal 1 damage to each character you control.

999103.Name: The Futurist
999103.text: Defeat the Iron Man leader as any hero(es). During this scenario, whenever a Tech attachment is revealed, deal 2 indirect damage to each player, and whenever the Stark Tower side scheme is defeated, deal it to the first player as a facedown encounter card.

203501b.Name: Kaine
203501b.text: Setup: Put your 2 Organic Webbing upgrades into play. No Responsibility — Interrupt: When the villain initiates a scheme against you, draw 1 card.

203501a.Name: Scarlet Spider
203501a.text: All The Power — Action: Deal 2 damage to Scarlet Spider → ready each Organic Webbing upgrade. (Limit once per round.) “They're calling me Scarlet Spider now. Another man's name... a better man. But I'm trying.”

203502.Name: Organic Webbing
203502.text: Permanent. Hero Resource: Exhaust Organic Webbing → generate a [physical] resource for an event. Alter-Ego Resource: Exhaust Organic Webbing and take 1 damage → generate a [wild] resource.

203503.Name: Venom
203503.text: When Defeated: Discard cards from the top of your deck until you discard an event and add it to you hand. [acceleration] “ ... I've been looking forward to this.”

203504.Name: Scarlet Web Kick
203504.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 8 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this card using only [physical] resources, this attack deals 1 additional damage and gains overkill.

203505.Name: Tangled Web
203505.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from among schemes in play. If you paid for this card using only resources generated by Organic Webbing, ready your hero. “ I... am... not... SPIDER-MAN!”

203506.Name: Mark of Kaine
203506.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this card using only [physical] resources, stun and confuse that enemy.

203507.Name: Front Flip
203507.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When an enemy initiates an attack against you, give Scarlet Spider a tough status card. If you paid for this card using a [physical] resource, draw 1 card. “I deserve this. But not from these bastards.”

203508.Name: Stealth Suit
203508.text: Events tucked here may be played as if they were in your hand. Response: After you change form, exhaust Stealth Suit → choose an event in your discard pile and tuck it here (to a maximum of 3).

203509.Name: Spider-Healing Factor
203509.text: Action: Exhaust Spider-Healing Factor → heal 2 damage from your identity. “This may take more than five minutes.” — Scarlet Spider

203510.Name: Stingers
203510.text: As an additional cost to play Stingers, take 2 damage. Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Stingers → deal 1 damage to an enemy. Deal 1 damage to an enemy.

203511.Name: Houston, Texas
203511.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Houston, Texas → shuffle 1 Scarlet Spider card from your discard pile into your deck. Heal 1 damage from Kaine. “If I've learned one thing, it's that you could not pay me to swing around in costume with this kind of humidity.” — Peter Parker

203512.Name: The Carrion Virus
203512.text: You cannot ready Organic Webbing upgrades. When Revealed: Exhaust each of your Organic Webbing upgrades. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Kaine → remove this obligation from the game.

203513.Name: The Jackal's Obsession
203513.text: “Through my perfected cloning techniques, I, THE JACKAL, will bring Gwen Stacy back to life.” -Miles Warren, the Jackal When Revealed: Place 1[per_hero] threat here. [crisis]

203514.Name: Jackal
203514.text: Quickstrike. When Defeated: Confuse your identity. Search the encounter deck and set-aside area for the Clone Saga environment and put it into play. (Scarlet Spider's nemesis minion.)

203515.Name: Clone Saga
203515.text:
Surge. Jackal gains surge.
The unique rule does not apply to characters in play.
Each [[clone ]]minion gains each [[trait ]]of the identity engaged with them.

203516.Name: Clone
203516.text: Forced Interrupt: When a character other than your identity attacks Clone, discard the top card of your deck. If that card's printed cost is odd, resolve that attack against your identity instead.

203601b.Name: Luke Cage
203601b.text: Impenetrable Skin — Damage cannot be healed from Luke Cage other than using his REC. Setup: Give Luke Cage a tough status card. “You look like you could use some help. I'm for hire.”

203601a.Name: Luke Cage
203601a.text: Impenetrable Skin — Damage cannot be healed from Luke Cage. Interrupt: When you would take any amount of damage, reduce that amount by 1. “Sweet Christmas!”

203602.Name: Jessica Jones
203602.text: [star] Interrupt: When Jessica Jones thwarts, discard he top card of the encounter deck. For each boost icon discarded this way, Jessica Jones gets +1 THW for this use. If no boost icons were discarded, Jessica Jones takes no consequential damage for this thwart. different types → deal 2 damage to an enemy and return Red Dagger to your hand.

203603.Name: Beatdown
203603.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 5 damage to an enemy. This attack gains overkill. This attack deals 1 additional damage for each [physical] resource you used to pay or overpay for this card. “When I knock you down, you're gonna stay down!”

203604.Name: Community Outreach
203604.text: Action: Remove 1 threat from a scheme. Draw 1 card (2 cards instead if you are in alter-ego form). Your hero gets +1 THW until the end of the round. “I'm just a New Yorker like you. And if someone's in trouble, I do what New Yorkers do: I help.” —Luke Cage

203605.Name: In Harm's Way
203605.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When an identity would take any amount of damage, prevent 2 of that damage and draw 1 card. If no damage was taken this way, remove 1 threat from a scheme. “Get behind me!” —Luke Cage

203606.Name: Unbreakable
203606.text: Hero Action: Give Luke Cage a tough status card. If you paid for this card using a [physical] resource, you may shuffle this card into your deck. “Did you do your "I-don't-break" speech? I love that one.” —Jessica Jones

203607.Name: Luke's Apartment
203607.text: Luke Cage gets +1 REC (+2 REC instead if Jessica Jones or Luke's Family is in play). Alter-Ego Response: After you use your REC, discard 1 card → give Luke Cage a tough status card.

203608.Name: Luke's Family
203608.text: You get +1 hand size. “Dani and Jess? They're my whole world.” —Luke Cage

203609.Name: Bulletproof
203609.text: You get +3 hit points. Attacks against Luke Cage lose piercing. Response: After you gain a tough status card, ready Luke Cage. “I got skin like steel and muscles to match.” —Luke Cage

203610.Name: Luke's Bracers
203610.text: Luke Cage requires 2 stunned status cards to be stunned. While in hero form, Luke Cage gains retaliate 1. “I used to wear a big metal tiara. Why? Because look at me. I could. And if not me, then who?” —Luke Cage

203611.Name: Super Strength
203611.text: Your hero gets +1 ATK. Resource: Exhaust Super Strength → generate a [physical] resource. “They don't call Ol' Luke Cage "Power Man" for nothin'!” —Luke Cage

203612.Name: Relationship Breakdown
203612.text: You may flip to alter-ego form. While this card is in play, flip your hero-specific ally and supports facedown. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Luke Cage → remove Relationship Breakdown from the game and flip face-up each card that was flipped facedown by this obligation.

203613.Name: A New Kingpin
203613.text: Diamondback is flooding the street with a new drug that gives superpowers, aiming to become the new Kingpin of Crime by hooking up other criminals. When Revealed: Give the villain 1 facedown boost card and a tough status card. [acceleration]

203614.Name: Diamondback
203614.text: Toughness. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Diamondback would activate, seek an attachment from the encounter deck and reveal it. (Luke Cage's nemesis minion.)

203615.Name: Jacked-Up
203615.text:
Attach to Diamondback, otherwise attach to the minion with the most remaining hit points and give them a tough status card. If you cannot attach this card, this card gains surge.
Attached character gets +2 hit points.

203616.Name: Diamond
203616.text: Attach to the minion with the most remaining hit points without another copy of Diamond attached and give them a tough status card. If you cannot attach this card, this card gains surge. Diamond produces a second-long surge of energy in its consumer, followed by an unstoppable rush that lasts for hours.

203401b.Name: Peter Parker
203401b.text: Reduce your ally limit by 2. Setup: Set aside each Spiderling ally. Technologist — Resource: Generate a [mental] resource for a [[tech ]]card. (Limit once per round.) “I am very busy!”

203401a.Name: Spider-Man
203401a.text: Reduce your ally limit by 2. The Die Is Cast — Response: After an ally you control leaves play, draw 1 card. (Limit once per phase.) “With my unparalleled genius and my boundless ambition, I'll be a better Spider-Man than you ever were!”

203402.Name: Spider-Arms
203402.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Spider-Arms → discard the top 4 cards from your deck. Add 1 card with a printed [mental] resource discarded this way to your hand.

203403.Name: Spider-Patrol
203403.text: Action: Put 2 set-aside Spiderling allies into play under your control. “This is Spider-Patrol 3, at the corner or 23rd and Broadway. We're on the way.”

203404.Name: Superior Kick
203404.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 6 damage to an enemy. You may discard an ally you control to stun that enemy. “I've been tracking this monster across twelve dimensions. His power levels are off the charts. We have to run.”

203405.Name: Genius in Command
203405.text: Hero Action (attack): Put 1 set-aside Spiderling ally into play under your control. For each ally you control, choose an enemy and deal 2 damage to it. “Hear me, you cretins! I AM THE SUPERIOR SPIDER-MAN!”

203406.Name: Dissertation
203406.text: Alter-Ego Action: Search your deck for a card with a printed [mental] resource or the [[superior ]]trait and add it to your hand. “Parker Industries! A revolution in start-ups! An overthrow of the technology sector!”

203407.Name: Web-Swinger
203407.text: Response: After an ally you control leaves play, choose: • Deal 1 damage to an enemy. • Exhaust Web-Swinger → ready Spider-Man.

203408.Name: Superior Spider-Suit
203408.text: Spider-Man gets +1 ATK and +1 DEF. Hero Response: After Spider-Man attacks an enemy, discard an ally you control → deal damage to that enemy equal to that ally's printed cost.

203409.Name: Spider-Bot
203409.text: Interrupt: When the surge keyword on an encounter card would be resolved, discard Spider-Bot instead → draw 2 cards. The Superior Spider-Bot can be found in the South-Eastern part of Downtown Brooklyn.

203410.Name: Web-Shooter
203410.text: Enters play with 4 web counters. Hero Resource: Exhaust Web-Shooter and remove 1 web counter from it → generate a [wild] resource. Alter-Ego Action: Spend [mental][mental] → place 2 web counters here.

203411.Name: Spider-Island Lair
203411.text: Action: Exhaust Spider-Island Lair, shuffle 1 [[superior ]]card from your discard pile into your deck, and spend [mental][mental] resources→ remove 2 threat from each scheme, ignoring any crisis icons ([crisis]) in play.

203418.Name: Spiderling
203418.text: Forced Interrupt: When this card leaves play, set it aside. Fragile. (Attacks against this character gain overkill.) Legion. (2 allies with the legion keyword count as 1 ally toward your ally limit.)

203413.Name: Peter Parker's Conciousness
203413.text: Forced Response: After an ally you control leaves play, discard the top 8 cards of your deck. Alter-Ego Action: Spend [mental][mental] resources and read this card's flavor text → remove this card from the game. “The die is cast!”

203414.Name: Limitless Power
203414.text: Supernova has been imprisoned by the Superior Spider-Man for months. Now she's back with a vengeance and incredible power. Supernova gets +1 ATK and +1 THW. Supernova cannot be defeated. [acceleration]

203415.Name: Supernova
203415.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Supernova activates against you, deal 1 damage to each character you control and place 1 threat on each scheme. (Superior Spider-Man's nemesis minion.) “Spider-Man will pay for what he did to me!”

203417.Name: Explosion of Power
203417.text: When Revealed: Take 4 indirect damage. Discard cards from the top of your deck until you discard an [energy] resource. Add that card to your hand. [star] Boost: Take 1 indirect damage.

203416.Name: Dynamo Assault
203416.text: Surge. When Revealed: Discard 2 cards from the top of the encounter deck and each player deck.

203701a.Name: Sabretooth
203701a.text: Hunter's Instinct — Action: Look at the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Put them back in any order. (Limit once per round). "I'm the best there is at what I do...just like Logan. Difference is, I do it with a smile."

203701b.Name: Victor Creed
203701b.text: Apex Predator — Setup: Find the Sabretooth's Claws upgrade and add it to your hand. Action: Search your discard pile for a Sabretooth card and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.)

203702.Name: Mystique
203702.text: Interrupt: When Mystique leaves play, discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck. Deal damage to an enemy equal to the number of icons ([star] and [boost]) discarded this way. "Hello, dear. Did someone call for a rescue?"

203703.Name: Rip and Rend
203703.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy and discard the top card of the encounter deck. For each icon ([star] and [boost]) discarded this way, deal 1 additional damage to that enemy. This attack gains piercing. “Ready to die?”

203704.Name: Feral Tactics
203704.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 4 threat from a scheme and discard the top card of the encounter deck. For each icon ([star] and [boost]) discarded this way, remove 1 additional threat from that scheme. “No cage, no plan, no chance. Not against me.”

203705.Name: Savage Reflexes
203705.text: Interrupt: When a boost card is turned faceup, cancel that card's icons and "Boost" ability. Choose to either deal X damage to an enemy or remove X threat from a scheme. X is the number of icons ([star] and [boost]) in the canceled card's boost area.

203706.Name: Ferocious Lunge
203706.text: Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Sabretooth's Claws → deal 8 damage to an enemy. This attack gains overkill. "Never met anyone who pushed me like the little guy. I want him dead, and I never want this fun to end. Wolverine. Can't live with him, can't live without him."

203707.Name: Relentless
203707.text: Action: Choose a player. Give that player 1 facedown encounter card → ready your identity and draw 1 card (2 cards instead if another player was chosen). "So you're still alive. Good. I wanna kill you slow and painful."

203708.Name: Feral Vitality
203708.text: Action: Exhaust Feral Vitality and discard the top card of the encounter deck → heal damage from Sabretooth equal to the number of icons ([star] and [boost]) discarded this way.

203709.Name: Bloodthirsty
203709.text: You get +2 hit points. Sabretooth gains retaliate 1 and his basic attacks gain piercing. "You bleed, I feast."

203710.Name: Unstoppable
203710.text: Interrupt: When you would be defeated, instead discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Set your hit point dial equal to the number of icons ([star] and [boost]) discarded this way. Remove this card from the game.

203711.Name: Razor Focus
203711.text: Sabretooth gains steady. Resource: Exhaust Razor Focus → generate a [wild] resource for an event. "Try to touch my head...I'll touch your guts!"

203712.Name: Sabretooth's Claws
203712.text: Hero Action: Discard the top card of the encounter deck → take damage equal to the number of icons on that card. Reduce the cost of the next event you play this round by the damage taken. (Limit once per round.)

203720.Name: Savage Masquerade
203720.text: Team-Up (Sabretooth and Mystique). Hero Action: Shuffle this card into the encounter deck. When Revealed: Choose to either deal 4 damage to an enemy or remove 4 threat from a scheme.

203713.Name: Primal Impulses
203713.text:
You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose:
• Exhaust Victor Creed → remove Primal Impulses from the game.
