• Deal damage to another player equal to your ATK. If you cannot, place 3 threat on the main scheme instead. Discard this obligation.

203714.Name: "You've Taken Your Shot."
203714.text: Victory 0. Assault. (Basic thwarts against this scheme use ATK instead of THW.) When Defeated: Attach the set-aside Now It's My Turn! upgrade to your identity. [hazard]

203715.Name: Now It's My Turn!
203715.text: Linked (You've Taken Your Shot). Attach to your identity. You get -2 REC. Forced Response: After your turn ends, take 1 damage. Hero Action: Spend [physical][energy] resources → discard this card.

203716.Name: Wolverine
203716.text: Quickstrike. Forced Interrupt: When the villain phase begins, heal 2 damage from Wolverine. (Sabertooth's nemesis minion.)

203717.Name: Adamantium Blades
203717.text: Attach to the minion with the highest printed ATK. Otherwise, attach to the villain. [star] Attached enemy's attacks gain overkill and piercing. Hero Action: Spend [physical][energy] resources → discard this card.

203718.Name: Blood Feud
203718.text: When Revealed: Shuffle this card into your deck. This card gains surge. Forced Response: After this card enters your hand, take 3 indirect damage. If you are in alter-ego form, you may discard a random card from your hand to prevent this damage.

203719.Name: Krakoan Justice
203719.text: Attach to your identity. Attached identity cannot ready. When Revealed: You are stunned. If you are already stunned, this card gains surge. Hero Action: Spend [physical][mental] resources → discard this card. "You are exiled." —Professor X

203801b.Name: Adam Brashear
203801b.text: Setup: Put the Matter Manipulation upgrade into play. Prepared — Action: Choose a Blue Marvel card in your discard pile and place it on the top of your deck. (Limit once per round.)

203801a.Name: Blue Marvel
203801a.text: Living Antimatter Reactor — Resource: Generate a [energy] resource. (Limit once per phase). “I'd do whatever is right, wherever and whenever it needs to be done - and I wouldn't care what anyone thinks. Not anymore.”

203802.Name: Matter Manipulation
203802.text: Permanent. Setup. Hero Interrupt: When you overpay for a card, Blue Marvel gets +1 THW, +1 ATK, and +1 DEF until the end of the round. (Limit twice per round.)

203803.Name: Spectrum
203803.text: [star] Spectrum gets +1 hit point for each energy counter on her. Interrupt: When Spectrum enters play, place 1 energy counter on her (to a maximum of 3) for each resource you overpaid for Spectrum's cost. “The name is Monica, or Spectrum if you're nasty.”

203804.Name: Anti-Matter Forcefield
203804.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take damage from an enemy attack, prevent all of that damage. If you overpaid for this card, deal that much damage to your attacker. “Don't try it!”

203805.Name: Cosmic Awareness
203805.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. If you overpaid for this card, remove 2 additional threat and this thwart ignores the crisis icon ([crisis]). “My greatest power cannot be measured in feats of strength or cosmic awareness, but in possibilities.”

203806.Name: Supersonic Flight
203806.text: Hero Action: Ready your hero. If you overpaid for this card, draw 1 card. Hero Response: After you change form, make a basic attack or thwart without exhausting your hero. If you overpaid for this card, draw 1 card.

203807.Name: Kadesh Base
203807.text: Action: Exhaust Kadesh Base → draw 1 card (2 cards instead if you are in alter-ego), then choose 1 card in your hand and shuffle it into your deck. The undersea home of Dr. Adam Brashear, located at the bottom of the Marianas Trench.

203808.Name: Uatu the Watcher
203808.text: Action: Exhaust Uatu the Watcher → search the top 3 cards of your deck for a card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. "Uatu, if you pull your "I cannot interfere" face any harder, you're going to prolapse.” —Blue Marvel

203809.Name: Anti-Matter Generation
203809.text: Resource: Spend a [energy] resource → generate [energy][energy] resources. (Limit once per phase). “Shield your eyes, I'm going to unleash my full power!” —Blue Marvel

203810.Name: Blue Marvel's Suit
203810.text: You get +2 hit points. Hero Response: After you overpay for a card, deal 1 damage to an enemy for each resource you overpaid for that card's cost. “Actually, it's one of my late wife's designs." —Blue Marvel

203811.Name: Crisis Monitor
203811.text: Interrupt: When you reveal an encounter card or your obligation is revealed, ready your hero (you may change to hero form first). If you cannot, remove 2 threat from a scheme. (Limit once per phase). “Computer, monitor emergency traffic."

203812.Name: Superhuman Speed
203812.text: Blue Marvel's attacks ignore the guard keyword. Hero Response: After you overpay for a card, remove 1 threat from a scheme for each resource you overpaid for that card's cost.

203813.Name: Level Seven Threat
203813.text:
You may flip to hero form. Choose:
Exhaust Blue Marvel → discard this obligation.
Deal yourself a facedown encounter card. This card gains surge. Discard this obligation.

203814.Name: Unshackle Creation
203814.text: Anti-Man's cosmic awareness has shattered his perception of reality. He plans to unite mankind through acts of destruction and terror. Hinder 2[per_hero]. [hazard]

203815.Name: Anti-Man
203815.text: Toughness. Forced Interrupt: When you generate a [energy] resource, take 1 damage. (Blue Marvel's nemesis minion.)

203816.Name: Anti-Matter Explosion
203816.text: When Revealed: Choose to either spend [energy][energy] resources or assign 2[per_hero] damage among heroes and allies. [star] Boost: Deal 1 damage to each character you control.

203817.Name: Quantum Immortality
203817.text: When Revealed: Heal all damage from Anti-Man and give him a tough status card. If you cannot, search the encounter deck and discard pile for Anti-Man and reveal him. Anti-Man activates against you.

203901a.Name: Howard the Duck
203901a.text: Private Eye — Interrupt: When threat would be placed on a scheme, prevent 1 of that threat. (Limit once per round.) Response: After a side scheme enters play, ready Howard the Duck. (Limit once per round.)

203901b.Name: Howard Duckson
203901b.text: Deducktive Reasoning — Action: Look at the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Put 1 on the bottom of the deck and the others back in any order. (Limit once per round.) "When life gives you lemons, make a sarcastic quip and throw them back!"

203902.Name: Man-Thing
203902.text:
Toughness.
Reduce the cost to play Man-Thing by 1 for each Howard the Duck side scheme in the victory display.

203903.Name: Mallard Magic
203903.text: Hero Action: Choose: • Stun an enemy and deal 5 damage to it. • Confuse an enemy and remove 4 threat from a scheme. “Oh boy, I hope I don't accidently summon Cthulhu again.”

203904.Name: Quack Attack
203904.text: Hero Interrupt (attack/defense): When you would take any amount of damage, prevent 2 of that damage. Deal 1 damage to an enemy for each side scheme in the victory display.

203905.Name: Fowl Play
203905.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. If you defeat a side scheme in this way, you may ready your hero or remove 1 threat from a scheme for each side scheme in the victory display.

203906.Name: Quack and Burn
203906.text: Hero Action (attack/thwart): Find Man-Thing and add him to your hand. Deal damage to an enemy equal to Man-Thing's ATK and remove threat from a scheme equal to Howard the Duck's THW.

203907.Name: Trapped
203907.text: Victory 0. While Trapped is in the victory display, Howard the Duck gets +1 ATK. When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for an ally and add it to their hand. The player who defeated this scheme, may put that ally into play.

203908.Name: In a World
203908.text: Victory 0. While In a World is in the victory display, Howard the Duck gets +1 DEF. When Defeated: Give each player a tough status card. The player who defeated this scheme, may heal 2 damage from their identity.

203909.Name: He Never Made
203909.text: Victory 0. While He Never Made is in the victory display, Howard the Duck gets +1 THW. When Defeated: Each player may shuffle up to 3 cards from their discard pile into their deck. The player who defeated this scheme, may add 1 of those cards, to their hand instead.

203910.Name: Beverly Switzler
203910.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Beverly Switzler → return the bottommost Howard the Duck card from your discard pile to your hand. Heal 1 damage from your identity.

203911.Name: Ducktective Agency
203911.text: Resource: Exhaust Ducktective Agency → generate a [mental] resource for an event. Hero Response: After you remove the last threat from a scheme, ready Ducktective Agency.

203912.Name: Duckpool Suit
203912.text: You get +3 hit points. Howard the Duck gets +1 ATK. Hero Response: After you defeat a side scheme, exhaust Duckpool Suit → deal 1 damage to an enemy.

203913.Name: Iron Suit
203913.text: Action: Exhaust Iron Suit → move 1 threat from a scheme to here. Hero Action: Exhaust Iron Suit and remove X threat from here → deal X damage to a minion or remove X threat from a scheme.

203914.Name: Nexus of all Realities
203914.text: Setup. Permanent. Interrupt: When a character enters play, choose a play area that character is played to. Interrupt: When an ally you control leaves play, search your deck for an event card, and add it to your hand.

203915.Name: Waddle it Be?
203915.text:
You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: • Exhaust Howard Duckson → remove Waddle it Be? from the game.
• Remove and shuffle all Howard the Duck side schemes from the victory display into your deck. If no schemes were removed this way, this card gains surge. Discard this obligation.

203916.Name: Duck and Cover!
203916.text: Quack-tastrophe! Howard the Duck is in over his head once again. It's up to the heroes to save him from a group of interdimensional bounty hunters. When Revealed: Each player must discard cards with a printed [mental] from their hand. Place 1 additional threat here for each card discarded this way. [hazard]

203917.Name: Collector
203917.text: Villainous. (When this minion activates, give it a boost card.) When Revealed: Discard an ally or support you control. If you cannot, put the topmost scheme from the encounter deck into play. (Howard the Duck's nemesis minion.)

203918.Name: Duck, Duck, Doom!
203918.text: Doctor Bong has set up a trap to capture Howard the Duck. When Revealed: Place an ally you control beneath this card. If you cannot, confuse your identity. When Defeated: Return the ally beneath here to its owner's hand.

203919.Name: A Fowl Plot
203919.text: The Collector plans to add Howard the Duck to his collection of rare and unique items. When Revealed: Discard an upgrade you control. If no cards were discarded this way, place 1 threat on the main scheme and take 1 damage. (Howard the Duck's nemesis side scheme.) [acceleration]

203920.Name: Duck Hunt
203920.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): The villain schemes. If there are side schemes in play, divide and place threat from this activation among them instead. When Revealed (Hero): Give the villain a tough status card. If you cannot, heal 3 damage from it instead.

999104.Name: He Can Do This All Day
999104.text: Defeat the Captain America leader as any hero(es). During this scenario, after Cap’s Shield is attached to a hero, that hero’s player must choose either heal 6 damage from Captain America or Captain America attacks their hero.

44225.Name: Night Thrasher
44225.text: Night Thrasher enters play exhausted. Retaliate 2. Response: After you flip a card you control, ready Night Thrasher.

44226.Name: Rage
44226.text:
Rage enters play exhausted.
[star] Rage gets +X ATK, where X is equal to the villain’s stage number.

44227.Name: Collective Breather
44227.text: Max 1 per round. Hero Action: Heal 2 damage from each damaged enemy → ready a friendly character for each enemy healed this way.

44228.Name: MRVL Network
44228.text: Uses (3 replay counters). Response: After an enemy takes damage during the villain phase, remove 1 replay counter from here → ready a character you control.

44229.Name: Determined Conditioning
44229.text:
Play under any player’s control.Max 1 per player.
You get +3 hit points, and your hero gets -1 DEF and gains retaliate 1.

44230.Name: Timed Detonation
44230.text: Attach to an enemy. Max 1 per enemy. Forced Interrupt (Hero) (attack): When the villain phase ends, flip to alter-ego form and remove Timed Detonation from the game → deal 6 damage to attached enemy. This attack gains ranged and overkill.

44231.Name: Speedball
44231.text: Speedball enters play exhausted. Response: After you ready Speedball, place 1 ball counter on him (to a maximum of 2). Reduce the amount of damage Speedball takes from enemy attacks by 1 for each ball counter on him.

999105.Name: Infamous Antiheroes
999105.text:
Defeat the Hood scenario as any hero(es). All 7 modular encounter sets used for this scenario must be Thunderbolt modular sets (see below for a list of legal encounter sets). During this scenario, all Thunderbolt minions lose the Victory keyword.
Thunderbolt modular sets: Gravitational Pull, Hard Sound, Pale Little Spider, Power of the Atom, Supersonic, The Leaper, Extreme Risk, Growing Strong, Techno, and Whiteout

202801b.Name: Alligator Loki
202801b.text: Setup: Find Throg and add him to your hand. Nap Time — Forced Response: After you switch to this form, detach Alligator Loki. You may make a basic recovery without exhausting.

202801a.Name: Alligator Loki
202801a.text: Attached enemy gets -1 SCH and -1 ATK. Lock Jaws — Interrupt: When Alligator Loki makes a basic attack or defense against an enemy, attach Alligator Loki to that enemy. Forced Response: After attached enemy activates, detach Alligator Loki.

202802.Name: Throg
202802.text: Patrol. Interrupt: When Alligator Loki attacks Throg, that attack gains overkill. When Defeated: Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Shuffle Throg into the Alligator Loki player's deck. “I am neither god, man, nor frog.”

202803.Name: Chomp!
202803.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy (6 damage instead if Alligator Loki is attached to that enemy). If this attack defeats an enemy, ready Alligator Loki. Otherwise, you may attach Alligator Loki to that enemy.

202804.Name: See You Later!
202804.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Change to alter-ego form. You may shuffle Throg from your discard pile into your deck.

202805.Name: Alligator Antics
202805.text: Action: Ready your identity. Search any deck and discard pile for the Throg minion and put him into play. Search the set-aside area, encounter deck and discard pile area for an attachment that can be attached to a minion and attach it to Throg. • Find a minion and put it into play engaged with you → draw 2 cards.

202806.Name: Loki
202806.text: Alligator Loki gains the [[mystic ]]trait. While in hero form, Alligator Loki gets +1 THW. Alter-Ego Resource: Exhaust Loki → generate a [wild] resource.

202807.Name: Butterfly Swamp
202807.text: While in alter-ego form, Alligator Loki gets +1 REC. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Butterfly Swamp → shuffle 1 [[preparation ]]card from your discard pile into your deck. Draw 1 card.

202808.Name: Gator Aid
202808.text: Interrupt: When attached character uses a basic power, exhaust Gator Aid → that character gets +1 to that power for this use. After this use, you may attach this to another friendly character.

202809.Name: Unbreakable Grip
202809.text: While in hero form, Alligator Loki gets +1 ATK. Hero Interrupt: When you would detach Alligator Loki from an enemy in play, exhaust Unbreakable Grip instead.

202810.Name: Lurking
202810.text: Max 1 per player. Hero Response: After a minion enters play, discard Lurking → Alligator Loki makes a basic attack against that minion without exhausting. Alligator Loki gets +1 ATK for this attack.

202812.Name: Time Out
202812.text: Search the set-aside area for Frogjolnir and shuffle it into the encounter deck. You get -2 ATK while in hero form. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust your alter-ego → remove Time Out from the game.

202813.Name: Throg and Loki
202813.text: "SMAK! SHLORP! RAWR! KLONK! SPLOOSH!" Alligator Loki can attack only Throg. When Revealed: If Throg is not in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for him and reveal him. [hazard]

202814.Name: Throg
202814.text: Forced Interrupt: When this minion would enter play, discard any other Throg from play. Place a random card from your hand facedown here. When Defeated: Return each facedown card here to its owner's hand. (Alligator Loki's nemesis minion.)

202815.Name: Lightning Bolt
202815.text: When Revealed: Discard 2 cards from the encounter deck. Take 1 indirect damage for each boost icon discarded this way. ___________________________________ [star] Boost: Discard 3 cards from the encounter deck.

202816.Name: Frogjolnir
202816.text: If Throg is not in play, find him and reveal him. Attach this card to Throg. Then, Throg activates against you. Throg gains the [[aerial ]]trait. [star] Forced Response: AfterThrog attacks you, take 1 indirect damage.

204101b.Name: Blackagar Boltagon
204101b.text: Setup: Place 2 electron counters on Blackagar Boltagon. Drawing In Strength — Action: Draw a card. Place electron counters on Blackagar Boltagon equal to the number of [mental] resources on that card. (Limit once per round.)

204101a.Name: Black Bolt
204101a.text: Particle Channeling — Action: Discard a card from your hand → place electron counters on Black Bolt equal to the number of printed [mental] resources on that card. (Limit once per round.)

204102.Name: Lockjaw
204102.text: Interrupt: When Lockjaw is defeated, remove 2 electron counters from Black Bolt → return Lockjaw to your hand. “He is my oldest friend in the world -- closer to me than my family, truer to me than my brother.” -- Black Bolt

204103.Name: Strength of a King
204103.text: Max 1 per round. Hero Action: Remove 1 electron counter from Black Bolt → until the end of the round, Black Bolt gets +2 ATK.

204104.Name: Energy Beam
204104.text: Hero Action (attack): Remove 2 electron counters from Black Bolt → deal 6 damage to an enemy. This attack gains overkill and piercing.

204105.Name: Aerial Dodge
204105.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage, prevent 2 of that damage (4 of that damage instead if you have the [[AERIAL]] trait). If you took no damage, place 1 electron counter on Black Bolt.

204106.Name: Silent Schemes
204106.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove X electron counters from Black Bolt → remove 3 threat from X schemes. “You are about to see a most wonderful, carefully-orchestrated plan come to its fruition.” - Karnak

204108.Name: Royal Antenna
204108.text: Alter-Ego Action: Take up to 3 damage and exhaust Royal Antenna → place 1 electron counter on Blackagar Boltagon for each damage you took.

204109.Name: Anti-Graviton Field
204109.text: Black Bolt gains the [[AERIAL]] trait. Hero Action: Remove 1 electron counter from Black Bolt and exhaust Anti-Graviton Field → ready Black Bolt.

204110.Name: Inhuman Throne
204110.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Inhuman Throne → shuffle a Black Bolt card from your discard pile into your deck.

204111.Name: Commanding Voice
204111.text: Hero Action (attack): Choose a player and remove 4 electron counters from Black Bolt → deal 10 damage to the villain and each enemy engaged with that player. “War.”

204112.Name: Muzzled
204112.text: Give to the Blackagar Boltagon player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: . Exhaust Blackagar Boltagon → remove Muzzled from the game. . Remove all electron counters from Black Bolt or Blackagar Boltagon. If no counters were removed, this card gains surge. Discard this obligation.

204113.Name: Maximus the Mad
204113.text: [star] Forced Response: After Maximus the Mad attacks, remove 1 electron counter from Black Bolt. “I am my brother's keeper -- because that's what they made me to be.”

204114.Name: Alpha Primitives Revolt
204114.text: “Oh my brothers. It is our time to rejoice. We have been meek and downtrodden for too long.” — Maximus the Mad [hazard]

204115.Name: Telepathic Manipulation
204115.text: When Revealed: Remove 3 electron counters from Black Bolt and take 1 indirect damage for each electron counter removed. If no electron counters were removed, this card gains surge.

204116.Name: Madman's Invention
204116.text: Attach to the villain. [star] Forced Interrupt: When the villain attacks you, give them 1 additional boost card for this activation. Discard the boost card with the least boost icons ([boost]) before resolving the attack. Hero Action: Spend [mental] [mental] resources → discard this card.

204001b.Name: Karnak Mander-Azur
204001b.text: Meditation — Response: After Karnak recovers, search your deck and discard pile for an [[ATTACK]], [[THWART]], or [[DEFENSE]] event. Add that card to your hand. If you searched your deck, shuffle it. (Limit once per phase.)

204001a.Name: Karnak
204001a.text: Flaw in All Things — Response: After Karnak attacks or thwarts and defeats an enemy or side scheme without dealing excess damage or removing excess threat, deal 1 damage to an enemy and ready Karnak. (Limit twice per round.)

204002.Name: Gorgon Petragon
204002.text: Response: After Gorgon Petragon attacks, deal 1 damage to each enemy. “I have devoted my entire life to honing the warrior's craft. I have sacrificed everything fighting for my people's future!”

204003.Name: Excess and Restraint
204003.text: Hero Interrupt: When Karnak attacks, increase or decrease (you choose) the damage that attack deals by 1. Hero Interrupt: When Karnak thwarts, increase or decrease (you choose) the threat that thwart removes by 1.

204004.Name: Disarm
204004.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme and discard an [[ARMOR]], [[TECH]], or [[WEAPON]] attachment from an enemy. If no attachment was discarded this way, confuse the villain instead. “In time, all we rely on will shatter and fall.”

204005.Name: Peerless Defense
204005.text: Hero Interrupt (thwart): When you would take any amount of damage, discard Peerless Defense → prevent up to 3 of that damage. Remove threat from a scheme equal to the amount of damage prevented this way.

204006.Name: Probing for Weakness
204006.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 1 damage to an enemy. This attack gains piercing. If this attack discarded a tough status card, deal another 3 damage to that enemy. “Where is the flaw?”

204007.Name: Martial Training
204007.text: If Karnak has attacked or thwarted this turn, double the number of resources this card generates.

204008.Name: Tower of Wisdom
204008.text: Karnak Mander-Azur gets +2 REC. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Tower of Wisdom → remove 1 threat from a scheme.

204009.Name: The Shatterer
204009.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal between 1 and 6 damage to an enemy. If you defeat a minion engaged with a player, stun the villain and each minion engaged with that player. “It is my discipline to be able to sense the weakest spot in any object -- And my power to shatter it.”

204010.Name: Forever Unchanging
204010.text: Give to the Karnak Mander-Azur player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: . Exhaust Karnak Mander-Azur → remove Forever Unchanging from the game. . Until the end of the next hero phase, you cannot ready or change forms. Discard this obligation.

204011.Name: Kree Invasion
204011.text: “We, of the Kree race, have power so much greater than yours that it must seem like virtual magic to you.” Threat cannot be removed from here if the Supreme Intelligence is in play. [crisis]

204012.Name: Supreme Intelligence
204012.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Supreme Intelligence would attack, he schemes instead. (Karnak's nemesis minion.) [star] Boost: Add 2 threat to the main scheme.

204013.Name: Kree Soldier
204013.text: When Revealed: When Kree Soldier engages with you, either spend a [mental] resource or add 2 threat to the main scheme. [star] Boost: Put Kree Soldier into play engaged with you.

204014.Name: Collective Intelligence
204014.text: Attach to the villain. Forced Interrupt: After resolving the effects of a treachery card, shuffle it back into the encounter deck instead of discarding it. Hero Action: Spend [mental] [mental] resources → discard this card.

204201b.Name: Betsy Braddock
204201b.text: You may play cards attached to your identity as if they were in your hand. Max 1 attached card. Telekinesis — Action: Search your deck for a [[PSIONIC]] card and attach it faceup to your identity. (Limit once per round.)

204201a.Name: Captain Britain
204201a.text: You may play cards attached to your identity as if they were in your hand. Counter-attack — Response (attack): After you defend against an enemy attack and take no damage, deal damage to that enemy equal to your ATK.

204202.Name: Captain Avalon
204202.text: Toughness. [star] Captain Avalon's basic attack gains piercing. (Discard any tough status cards from the target before dealing damage.)

204203.Name: Telekinetic Sword
204203.text: Restricted. Captain Britain gets +1 ATK. Hero Interrupt: When you make an attack, exhaust Telekinetic Sword → that attack gains piercing.

204204.Name: Telekinetic Shield
204204.text: Restricted. Captain Britain gets +1 DEF. Hero Response: After you defend against an attack, exhaust Telekinetic Shield → ready Captain Britain.

204205.Name: Amulet of Right
204205.text: You get +2 hit points. Resource: Exhaust Amulet of Right → generate a [wild] resource.

204206.Name: Braddock Lighthouse
204206.text: Betsy Braddock gets +2 REC. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Braddock Lighthouse → shuffle up to 2 events from the discard pile into your deck.

204207.Name: Shield Bash
204207.text: Hero Action (attack): Confuse an enemy. If you paid for this card using a [physical] resource, deal 4 damage to that enemy.

204208.Name: Against the Tides
204208.text: Hero Response: After you defeat an enemy, ready Captain Britain.

204209.Name: Psionic Defense
204209.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you defend against an attack, you get +3 DEF for that attack. If you take no damage from that attack, heal 1 damage for each point of excess damage blocked.

204210.Name: Psionic Blast
204210.text: Hero Action (attack): Choose one: . Deal 1 damage to each enemy. . Deal 5 damage to an enemy.

204211.Name: Provoke
204211.text: Hero Action (thwart): Choose an enemy. That enemy attacks you. Remove threat from a scheme equal to your DEF.

204212.Name: Sibling Rivalry
204212.text: Give to the Betsy Braddock player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: * Exhaust Betsy Braddock → remove Sibling Rivalry from the game. * Discard each event from your hand. If no cards are discarded this way, this card gains surge. Discard this obligation.

204213.Name: King Jamie Braddock
204213.text: Villainous. [star] Forced Interrupt: When King Jamie Braddock schemes, if the Fractured Realities side scheme is in play place the threat on it instead. When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for the Fractured Realities side scheme and put it into play.

204214.Name: Fractured Realities
204214.text: The villain cannot take damage. Forced Interrupt: When the villain would attack, put 1 threat on the main scheme instead. [crisis]

204215.Name: Quantum Teleportation
204215.text: Attach to King Jamie Braddock. Otherwise, attach to the villain. Uses (3 teleport counters). Forced Interrupt: When attached enemy would take any amount of damage, remove 1 teleport counter from this card → prevent all of that damage.

204216.Name: Backlash
204216.text: When Revealed: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. For each event discarded this way, take 1 indirect damage. [star] Boost: For each event in your hand, this card gains 1 boost icon (to a maximum of 4).

204301b.Name: Norrin Radd
204301b.text: Toomie! — Action: Exhaust Norrin Radd → search your deck and discard pile for The Silver Surfboard upgrade and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

204301a.Name: Silver Surfer
204301a.text: Compunction — Forced Response: After Silver Surfer makes a basic attack, change your form.

204302.Name: Dawn Greenwood
204302.text: Interrupt: When Dawn Greenwood is defeated, deal 2 damage to your identity → return Dawn Greenwood to your hand.

204303.Name: The Silver Surfboard
204303.text: Hero Action: Exhaust The Silver Surfboard → ready Silver Surfer. Interrupt: When you discard The Silver Surfboard, deal 1 damage to Silver Surfer → draw a card.

204304.Name: Energy Manipulation
204304.text: Action: Spend X [energy] resources → put X energy counters here. Hero Action: Discard Energy Manipulation → draw 1 card (to a maximum of 5) for each energy counter here.

204305.Name: Rage of Retribution
204305.text: Silver Surfer gains retaliate 1. Interrupt: When Silver Surfer would change form, discard Rage of Retribution → ready Silver Surfer instead.

204306.Name: Cosmic Speed
204306.text: Hero Action (thwart): Choose one: . Remove 4 threat from a scheme. . Discard The Silver Surfboard → remove up to 3 threat from each scheme in play.

204307.Name: Cosmic Strength
204307.text: Hero Interrupt: When you make a basic attack, choose one: . You get +7 ATK for that attack. . Discard The Silver Surfboard → You get +9 ATK for that attack and it gains overkill.

204308.Name: Cosmic Energy
204308.text: Hero Action (attack): Remove X threat divided among schemes as you choose and deal X damage to an enemy, where X is the number of [energy] resources you paid for Cosmic Energy's cost.

204309.Name: Silver Up
204309.text: When you play this card, you may discard The Silver Surfboard, then choose two instead. Alter-Ego Action: Flip to Silver Surfer, then choose one: draw 2 cards, deal 4 damage to an enemy, or ready Silver Surfer.

204310.Name: The Power Cosmic
204310.text: Response: After you spend this card to play a [[COSMIC]] event, deal 2 damage to an enemy.

204311.Name: Silver Down
204311.text: Give to the Norrin Radd player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: . Exhaust Norrin Radd → remove Silver Down from the game. . Summon Dawn Greenwood and remove her from the game → remove Silver Down from the game.

204312.Name: Galactus
204312.text: Villainous. When Revealed: Reveal The World Eater and put it into play engaged with you. When Defeated: Remove Galactus from the game. (Silver Surfer's nemesis minion.)

204313.Name: The World Eater
204313.text: Galactus cannot take damage and his attacks gain overkill. When Defeated: Remove The World Eater from the game.

204314.Name: The Life Stealer
204314.text: All friendly characters get -1 ATK. When Revealed: Place 1 additional threat here for each friendly character in play.

204315.Name: Cosmic Power
204315.text: Attach to Galactus. If you cannot, attach to the villain. [star] Attached enemy's attacks gain overkill. Hero Action: Take 3 damage → remove Cosmic Power from the game.

204401b.Name: Gwendolyn Poole
204401b.text: "I Won't Be an Extra" — Action: Find a Gwenpool card and add it to your hand. (Limit once per phase.)

204401a.Name: Gwenpool
204401a.text: Medium Awareness — Interrupt: When you resolve an ability on a Gwenpool card, replace "_______" with a phrase from a speech bubble. (Use bubbles on a card you are playing, a card you spend, or a card in play.) (Limit each bubble once per phase.) (Speech Bubble: "Draw 1 card.")

204402.Name: "Here I Come!"
204402.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 5 damage to an enemy. This attack gains overkill. If this attack defeats an enemy, _______. (Speech Bubble: "Deal 2 damage to the villain.")

204403.Name: "It Can't End Like This!"
204403.text: Hero Action (attack/thwart): Deal 1 damage to the villain and remove 1 threat from the main scheme. If the villain schemed last round, _______. (Speech Bubble: "Confuse the villain.")

204404.Name: Fun Background Noise
204404.text: Hero Interrupt: When a treachery card is revealed from the encounter deck, cancel its "When Revealed" effects and discard it. Then, _______. (Speech Bubble: "Give Gwenpool a tough status card.")

204405.Name: "Sorry, Gotta Run!"
204405.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from a scheme. This thwart ignores the patrol keyword and crisis icons ([crisis]). If this thwart defeats a scheme, _______. (Speech Bubble: "Remove 2 threat from the main scheme.")

204406.Name: Endless Storylines
204406.text: Hero Response: After you spend this card, _______ and _______. (Speech Bubbles: "Remove 1 threat from a scheme.", "Heal 1 damage from Gwenpool.", "Deal 1 damage to an enemy.")

204407.Name: Endless Storylines
204407.text: Hero Response: After you spend this card, _______ and _______. (Speech Bubbles: "Remove 1 threat from a scheme.", "Heal 1 damage from Gwenpool.", "Deal 1 damage to an enemy.")

204408.Name: Endless Storylines
204408.text: Hero Response: After you spend this card, _______ and _______. (Speech Bubbles: "Remove 1 threat from a scheme.", "Heal 1 damage from Gwenpool.", "Deal 1 damage to an enemy.")

204409.Name: Gwen's Room
204409.text: You get +1 REC. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Gwen's Room → heal 1 damage from Gwendolyn Poole. Then, find Unbelievable Gwenpool and add it to your hand. (Speech Bubble: "Heal 1 damage from Gwenpool.")

204410.Name: Comicbook Panels
204410.text: Hero Resource: Exhaust Comicbook Panels → generate a [wild] resource and _______. Hero Action: Exhaust Comicbook Panels and Unbelievable Gwenpool → _______ and _______. (Speech Bubble: "Look at the top card of any deck.")

204411.Name: Unbelievable Gwenpool
204411.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Unbelievable Gwenpool → search your deck for a Gwenpool card and attach it faceup here (to a maximum of 1). (Shuffle.) You may use the speech bubbles of the attached card. Hero Action: Draw 2 cards and _______. Discard Unbelievable Gwenpool. (Speech Bubble: "Ready Gwenpool.")

204412.Name: The End
204412.text: Give to the Gwendolyn Poole player. You cannot use speech bubbles from Gwenpool cards. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Gwendolyn Poole and discard Unbelievable Gwenpool → remove THE END from the game.

204413.Name: Rules of the Universe
204413.text: Permanent. While there is no threat here, this scheme loses the [hazard] icon. Forced Interrupt: When you resolve an ability on a Gwenpool card, replace "_______" with the phrase from the speech bubble on Evil Gwenpool. [hazard]

204414.Name: Evil Gwenpool
204414.text: Steady. Villainous. When Defeated: Shuffle Evil Gwenpool into the encounter deck. [star] Boost: Put Evil Gwenpool into play engaged with you. (Speech Bubble: "Gwenpool takes 1 damage.") (Gwenpool's nemesis minion.)

204415.Name: Break Reality
204415.text: Incite 1. When Revealed: Search the encounter deck for Evil Gwenpool and reveal her. (Shuffle.) If Unbelievable Gwenpool is in play, she gains quickstrike. If Evil Gwenpool was already in play, add 2[per_hero] threat to Rules of the Universe.

204416.Name: "Future Me Scares Me"
204416.text: Incite 0 (incite 1 instead, if this is a multiplayer game). Incite 1 (incite 2 instead, if this is an expert mode game). When Revealed: If Evil Gwenpool is in play, add 2 threat to Rules of the Universe and shuffle this card into the encounter deck.

204501b.Name: Kevin Plunder
204501b.text: Tamed Beast — Response: After you change to this form, remove up to 3 savage counters from Zabu. Heal 1 damage from Kevin Plunder for each savage counter removed this way.

204501a.Name: Ka-Zar
204501a.text: The Call Of The Wild — Action: Spend 1 resource of any type → ready Ka-Zar or Zabu. (Limit once per round.)

204502.Name: Zabu
204502.text: Permanent. Setup. Action: Exhaust Zabu → place 3 savage counters here. Hero Interrupt: When you use one of your basic powers, exhaust Zabu and remove 1 savage counter from it → get +2 to that power for this use.

204503.Name: Shanna the She-Devil
204503.text: Response: After Shanna the She-Devil enters play, ready a [[Savage Land]] card in play.

204504.Name: Stalk
204504.text: Action: Look at the top card of the encounter deck (top 2 cards instead if you exhaust Zabu and remove 1 savage counter from it). Discard any number of those, then place the rest on the top and/or bottom of the encounter deck in any order.

204505.Name: Ambush
204505.text: Hero Interrupt (attack/defense): When you would take any amount of damage, prevent 3 of that damage. Deal 1 damage to an enemy. You may exhaust Zabu and remove 1 savage counter from it to deal 1 damage to an enemy and draw 1 card.

204506.Name: Swing Into Action

 Attached character gains the [[avenger]] trait.

205601b.Name: James Howlett
205601b.text: Setup: Search your deck, hand and discard pile for Wolverine's Claws and put it into play under your control. Healing Factor — Action: Remove 1 wound counter from the Old and Tired upgrade. (Limit once per round.)

205601a.Name: Old Man Logan
205601a.text: Berserker — Action: Place 1 wound counter on the Old and Tired upgrade. Old Man Logan gets +1 THW, +1 ATK and +1 DEF until the end of the round. (Limit once per round.)

205602.Name: Old and Tired
205602.text:
Permanent. Setup.
You get -1 hit point for each wound counter here.
While there are 6 or more wound counters here, you get +1 hand size.

205603.Name: Wolverine's Claws
205603.text: Interrupt: When you attack, exhaust Wolverine's Claws → increase the damage that attack deals by 1 for each wound counter on Old and Tired (max 3 increase in damage). This attack gains piercing. Place 1 wound counter on Old and Tired.

205604.Name: Blind Rage
205604.text: Hero Resource: Exhaust Blind Rage → Place 1 wound counter on Old and Tired. Generate a [wild] resource.

205605.Name: Adamantium Skeleton
205605.text: Old Man Logan gets +1 DEF. Interrupt: When a wound counter would be placed on Old and Tired, exhaust Adamantium Skeleton instead.

205606.Name: Enhanced Healing Factor
205606.text: Interrupt: When you would be defeated, remove each wound counter from Old and Tired instead. Then, discard Enhanced Healing Factor.

205607.Name: Old Man Hawkeye
205607.text: Old Man Hawkeye enters play with 2 arrow counters on him. Response: After a minion engages you, remove 1 arrow counter from Old Man Hawkeye → deal 4 damage to that minion.

205608.Name: Savage Stab
205608.text: Hero Action (attack): Place 1 wound counter on Old and Tired. Deal 3 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this card using a [physical] resource, ready Wolverine's Claws.

205609.Name: Unfazed
205609.text: Interrupt: When you would take any amount of damage from an attack, prevent 1 of that damage for each wound counter on Old and Tired. Place 1 wound counter on Old and Tired.

205610.Name: Vicious Animal
205610.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy for each wound counter on Old and Tired (max 8 damage). You may divide the damage dealt by this attack among enemies as you choose. If you paid for this card using a [physical] resource, you may place a wound counter on Old and Tired.

205611.Name: Skilled Tracker
205611.text: Action (thwart): Remove 1 threat from a scheme for each wound counter on Old and Tired (max 4 threat). If you paid for this card using a [mental] resource, you may remove a wound counter from Old and Tired.

205612.Name: Blood on One's Hands
205612.text: Give to the James Howlett player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: • Discard Wolverine's Claws → remove Blood on one's Hands from the game. • Place 3 wound counters on Old and Tired. Discard this card.

205613.Name: Old Man Hulk
205613.text: [star] Old Man Hulk gets +1 ATK for each damage token here. Forced Response: After a [[GAMMA]] minion is defeated, deal 1 damage to Old Man Hulk. (Old Man Logan's nemesis minion.)

205614.Name: Debt Collection
205614.text: The Hulk Gang is going around collecting debt. If you can't pay up, prepare to take a beating. [crisis] When Revealed: The James Howlett player must choose to either take 2 damage or place 1 additional threat here.

205615.Name: Bobbie-Jo Banner
205615.text: When Revealed: If Charlie Banner is not in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for him. Reveal him and put him into play engaged with you.

205616.Name: Charlie Banner
205616.text: When Revealed: If Otis Banner is not in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for him. Reveal him and put him into play engaged with you.

205617.Name: Otis Banner
205617.text: When Revealed: If Bobbie-Jo Banner is not in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for her. Reveal her and put her into play engaged with you.

502101.Name: The Gardener
502101.text: Forced Response: After the Gardener attacks you, reveal the top card of the GROOT deck.

502102.Name: The Gardener
502102.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for the Reclaim the Green side scheme and reveal it. If it is already in play, resolve its "When Defeated" effect. [star] Forced Response: After the Gardener attacks you, reveal the top card of the GROOT deck.

502103.Name: The Gardener
502103.text: [[WOOD]] minions gain toughness. [star] Forced Response: After the Gardener activates against you, reveal the top card of the GROOT deck.

502104a.Name: Groot Invasion
502104a.text: Contents: The Gardener (I) and The Gardener (II). (The Gardener (II) and The Gardener (III) instead for expert mode.) The Gardener, Ship Command II and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (recommended: Growing Pain). Setup: Set aside each copy of Flora Sapling and shuffle them together into a GROOT deck.

502104b.Name: Groot Invasion
502104b.text: When Revealed: Each player reveals the top card of the GROOT deck.

502105b.Name: Branching Path
502105b.text: When Revealed: Each player votes to either defend Knowhere, or confront the Gardener. The first player's vote breaks tie-breakers. Then, if there were more votes to defend Knowhere, advance to Leaf No Survivors 3A. Otherwise, advance to Confront the Root 3A.

502106a.Name: Confront the Root
502106a.text: When Revealed: Each player draws 1 card. (The first player draws 1 additional card.)

502106b.Name: Confront the Root
502106b.text: Each character in play gets +1 ATK. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

502107a.Name: Leaf No Survivors
502107a.text: When Revealed: Each player reveals the top card of the GROOT deck. Each player who cannot deals themselves a facedown encounter card.

502107b.Name: Leaf No Survivors
502107b.text: X is equal to the number of enemies in play (including the Gardener). If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

502108.Name: Flora Beast
502108.text: Quickstrike. [star] Boost: After this activation, place Flora Beast at the bottom of the GROOT deck.

502109.Name: Flora Colossus
502109.text: When Defeated: The engaged player reveals the top card of the GROOT deck. [star] Boost: After this activation, place Flora Colossus at the bottom of the GROOT deck.

502110.Name: Flora Consumer
502110.text: When Revealed: Defeat the WOOD minion in play with the lowest ATK → the engaged player reveals the top card of the GROOT deck. [star] Boost: After this activation, place Flora Consumer at the bottom of the GROOT deck.

502111.Name: Flora Titan
502111.text: Incite 3. Guard. When Revealed: If Flora Titan was revealed from the encounter deck, place Flora Titan at the bottom of the GROOT deck. [star] Boost: After this activation, place Flora Titan at the bottom of the GROOT deck.

502112.Name: Reclaim the Green
502112.text: When Defeated: Each player reveals the top card of the GROOT deck.

502113.Name: Wode Blockade
502113.text: Assault. (Basic thwarts against this scheme use ATK instead of THW.) Hinder 2[per_hero]. When Defeated: Defeat a non-ELITE WOOD minion in play.

502114.Name: Groot Swarm
502114.text: When Revealed: Each WOOD minion engaged with your hero attacks you. If no attack was made this way, reveal the top card of the GROOT deck. [star] Boost: This card gains [boost][boost] if you are engaged with a WOOD minion.

502115.Name: Rampant Growth
502115.text: When Revealed: Reveal the top 2 cards of the GROOT deck. If less than 2 cards were revealed this way, this card gains surge.

502116.Name: Regrowth
502116.text: Surge. When Revealed: Place the topmost WOOD minion in the encounter discard pile at the bottom of the WOOD deck. [star] Boost: Resolve this card's "When Revealed" effect. (Does not surge.)

502117.Name: Flora Sapling
502117.text: When Defeated: Place Flora Sapling at the bottom of the GROOT deck.

502118.Name: Warbringer
502118.text: Steady. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Warbringer activates against you, if you control a card with a printed [wild] resource, he gets +1 SCH and +1 ATK for this activation.

502119.Name: Warbringer
502119.text: Steady. Toughness. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Warbringer activates against you, if you control a card with a printed [wild] resource, he gets +1 SCH and +1 ATK for this activation.

502120.Name: Warbringer
502120.text: Steady. Toughness. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Warbringer activates against you, if you control a card with a printed [wild] resource, he gets +2 SCH and +2 ATK for this activation.

502121a.Name: Chitauran Command
502121a.text: Contents: Warbringer (I) and Warbringer (II). (Warbringer (II) and Warbringer (III) instead for expert mode.) Warbringer, Ship Command II and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (recommended: Mercenary Fleet). Setup: Set aside the Heavy Cannon and Hyper Thrusters upgrades.

502121b.Name: Chitauran Command
502121b.text: When Revealed: Reveal the Blockade side scheme and exhaust the Milano. In expert mode, deal each player a facedown encounter card and deal 1 damage to the Milano.

502122b.Name: Stall for Time
502122b.text: [star] Forced Response: After resolving step one of the villain phase, place 1 time counter here. If there at least 2 time counters here, advance to stage 3A.

502123a.Name: Raring to Go
502123a.text: When Revealed: If the previous stage was progressed by time counters, each player votes either Thrusters or Weapons. The first player's vote breaks tie-breakers. If thrusters won, put the set aside Hyper Thrusters into play under the first player's control. Otherwise, put the set aside Heavy Cannon into play under the first player's control.

502123b.Name: Raring to Go
502123b.text: If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

502124.Name: Blockade
502124.text: Assault. [star] Boost: In expert mode, this card gets +2 boost icons ([boost][boost]) for this activation.

502125.Name: Ship Turrets
502125.text: Assault. Hinder 2[per_hero]. Forced Response: After a player ends their turn, that player takes 2 indirect damage. [star] Boost: If damage from this attack defeats an ally, the first player takes 2 indirect damage.

502126.Name: Warlord Endurance
502126.text: Warbringer gains stalwart. [star] Boost: This enemy gains stalwart for this activation.

502127.Name: Urgent Repairs
502127.text: Hinder 2[per_hero]. Victory 1. When Defeated: Heal 2 damage from the Milano.

502128.Name: Weapon of War
502128.text: Attach to Warbringer. [star] Warbringer's attacks gain overkill and piercing. Hero Action: Spend [energy][mental][physical] resources → discard this card. [star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, it gains overkill and piercing.

502129.Name: Warpath
502129.text: Attach to Warbringer. Uses (1 fury counter, plus 1[per_hero] additional fury counters.) [star] Forced Response: After Warbringer activates, remove 1 fury counter from here. (Remove 1 additional fury counter if this activation was an attack that dealt no damage.)

502130.Name: Homing Missile
502130.text: Attach to the Milano. Forced Interrupt: At the end of the villain phase, place 1 damage here. If there is 2 or more damage here, move all damage here to attached character or its controller's identity card and discard this card. Response: After attached character defends against an attack, attach this card to the attacker.

502131.Name: Chitauri Speeder
502131.text: Quickstrike. Chitauri Speeder engages the first player. [star] Forced Response: After Chitauri Speeder attacks and damages you, spend 1 resource of any type or deal 1 damage to the Milano.

502132.Name: Rip Open
502132.text: When Revealed: Place 4 threat on the main scheme. You may exhaust characters you control to prevent threat equal to the total ATK of those characters. Deal 1 damage to each exhausted character you control.

502133.Name: Spoils of War
502133.text: When Revealed: Choose to deal 2 indirect damage to the first player or give the villain 1 facedown boost card. [star] Boost: If damage from this attack defeats an ally, the first player takes 2 indirect damage.

502134.Name: Warbringer's Wrath
502134.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): The first player deals themself a facedown encounter card. When Revealed (Hero): Warbringer attacks you.

502135.Name: Heavy Cannon
502135.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Heavy Cannon → deal 1 damage to each enemy. If you control the Milano, deal 1 additional damage to the villain.

502136.Name: Hyper Thrusters
502136.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Hyper Thrusters → remove 1 threat from each scheme. If you control the Milano, remove 1 additional threat from the main scheme.

502137a.Name: Raker
502137a.text: Retaliate 1. Forced Interrupt: When Raker would be defeated, reset his hit points to 8. Then, remove 6 threat from the main scheme (ignoring any ([crisis]) icons).

502137b.Name: Raker
502137b.text: Retaliate 1. Steady. Forced Interrupt: When Raker would be defeated, reset his hit points to 12. Then, remove 6 threat from the main scheme (ignoring any ([crisis]) icons).

502138a.Name: "Here's the Milano!"
502138a.text: Contents: Raker (A). (Raker (B) instead for expert mode.) Escape the Church, Ship Command II and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (recommended: Fetters of Faith). Setup: Each player sets aside each ally, ARMOR, ITEM, LOCATION, PERSONA, TECH, VEHICLE and WEAPON in their deck into a CAPTURED deck. Reveal Church Homeworld.

502138b.Name: "Here's the Milano!"
502138b.text: Assault. Forced Interrupt: When the last threat is removed from this scheme, each player searches their CAPTURED deck for 1 card and adds it to their hand. Then, advance to stage 2A. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

502139a.Name: Spring our Allies
502139a.text: When Revealed: Each player places the top 6 cards of their CAPTURED deck under here.

502139b.Name: Spring our Allies
502139b.text: Forced Interrupt: When the last threat is removed from this scheme, the players as a group return 2[per_hero] facedown cards here into their owner's hands. The players advance to stage 3A if there are no cards here. If they do not advance, place 4[per_hero] threat here. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

502140a.Name: The Grand Escape
502140a.text: When Revealed: Deal each player a facedown encounter card.

502140b.Name: The Grand Escape
502140b.text: If there is no threat here, the players win the game. If this stage is completed or the Milano is defeated, the players lose the game.

502141.Name: Church Homeworld
502141.text: Permanent. Setup. Forced Interrupt: When a card makes a player place any number of cards from their CAPTURED deck under a card, for each card a player couldn't place this way, they place 1 card from the top of their deck instead.

502142.Name: Guard of Truth
502142.text: Guard. Patrol. When Revealed: Place the top card of a CAPTURED deck facedown here. When Defeated: Return each facedown card here to it's owner's hand.

502143.Name: Church Patrol
502143.text: Assault. Hinder 3[per_hero]. When Revealed: Each player puts the top card of their CAPTURED deck facedown here. When Defeated: Return each card here to it's owner's hand.

502144.Name: Interrogation Room
502144.text: Assault. Hinder 3[per_hero]. When Revealed: Each player searches their CAPTURED deck for an ally or a PERSONA card and places it facedown here. When Defeated: Return each card here to it's owner's hand.

502145.Name: Raid the Armory
502145.text: Assault. Hinder 3[per_hero]. When Revealed: Each player searches their CAPTURED deck for an upgrade and places it facedown here. When Defeated: Return each card here to it's owner's hand.

502146.Name: Evade Notice
502146.text: Incite 1. When Revealed: Either spend 2 resources of any type or be confused. [star] Boost: You are confused.

502147.Name: Hunt the Heretics
502147.text: When Revealed: For each character you control, discard the top 8 cards of your deck or exhaust that character.

502148.Name: Zealous Strike
502148.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. This card gains surge. When Revealed (Hero): Raker attacks you with +1 ATK. If no damage was dealt this way, add the top card of a CAPTURED deck to it's owner's hand.

502149.Name: High Evolutionary
502149.text:
Cards with 1 or fewer printed icons ([star] and [boost]) in the card's boost area gain [boost] for each progress counter on the main scheme.
Minions get +1 hit point for each icons ([star] and [boost]) in their boost area.

502150.Name: High Evolutionary
502150.text:
Cards with 1 or fewer printed icons ([star] and [boost]) in the card's boost area gain [boost] for each progress counter on the main scheme.
Minions get +1 hit point for each icons ([star] and [boost]) in their boost area.

502151.Name: High Evolutionary
502151.text:
Cards with 1 or fewer printed icons ([star] and [boost]) in the card's boost area gain [boost] for each progress counter on the main scheme.
Minions get +1 hit point for each icons ([star] and [boost]) in their boost area.

502152a.Name: Obtain Perfection
502152a.text: Contents: High Evolutionary (I) and High Evolutionary (II). (High Evolutionary (II) and High Evolutionary (III) instead for expert mode.) High Evolutionary and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (recommended: Order in Entropy). Setup: Place 1 progress counter here.

502152b.Name: Obtain Perfection
502152b.text: X is 6 plus the number of progress counters here. Forced Interrupt: When this scheme would be completed, place 1 progress here. Then, remove all threat from this scheme. The players lose the game when there are 3 progress counters here.

502153.Name: Backlash
502153.text: Attach to High Evolutionary. Forced Interrupt: When High Evolutionary would be stunned or confused, discard Backlash → the active player gains that status card instead. [star] Boost: Give this enemy a tough status card.

502154.Name: Evolution Suit
502154.text: Attach to the minion with the fewest icons in its boost area. If you cannot, this card gains surge. Attached minion is [[EVOLUTIONARY]] trait, gets [boost][boost][boost] and gains retaliate 1. When Revealed: Give attached minion a tough status card. [star] Boost: Attach this card to a minion.

502155.Name: Evolved Weapon
502155.text: Attach to the minion with the fewest icons in its boost area. If you cannot, this card gains surge. Attached minion is [[EVOLUTIONARY]] trait and gets [boost]. When Revealed: Attached minion activates against you. [star] Boost: Attach this card to a minion.

502156.Name: Induced Evolution
502156.text: Attach to the minion with the fewest icons in its boost area. If you cannot, this card gains surge. Attached minion gains [[EVOLUTIONARY]] trait and gets [boost]. When Revealed: Attached minion activates against you. [star] Boost: Attach this card to a minion.

502157.Name: Evolutionary
502157.text: Guard. Villainous. When Revealed: This minion gets [boost][boost][boost]. [star] Boost: Put Evolutionary into play engaged with you. It cannot activate this step.

502158.Name: Evolutionarian
502158.text: Guard. Villainous. When Revealed: Deal the topmost TECH attachment in the encounter discard pile to yourself as a facedown encounter card. [star] Boost: Resolve this card's "When Revealed" ability.

502159.Name: Legions of Evolutionaries
502159.text: Assault. Hinder 2[per_hero]. When Defeated: Shuffle each EVOLUTIONARY minion in the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.

502160.Name: The Magus
502160.text: Steady. [star] The Magus's attacks deal indirect damage. Forced Response: After the encounter deck resets, give The Magus a facedown boost card.

502161.Name: The Magus
502161.text: Steady. Toughness. [star] The Magus's attacks deal indirect damage. Forced Response: After the encounter deck resets, give The Magus a facedown boost card.

502162.Name: The Magus
502162.text: Steady. Toughness. [star] The Magus's attacks deal indirect damage. Forced Response: After the encounter deck resets, give The Magus a facedown boost card and deal the first player 1 facedown encounter card.

502163a.Name: Temple of The Magus
502163a.text: Contents: The Magus (I) and The Magus (II). (The Magus (II) and The Magus (III) instead for expert mode.) The Magus, Ship Command II and Standard encounter sets. Four modular encounter sets (recommended: Cosmic Sorcery, Fetters of Faith, New Men and Powers Cosmic). Setup: Find Cathedral and reveal it. Discard the top 2[per_hero] cards of the encounter deck.

502163b.Name: Temple of The Magus
502163b.text: Forced Response: After resolving step one of the villain phase, each player discards 2 cards from the encounter deck. Each player places 1 threat here if the cards they discarded were from different encounter sets. Forced Response: After The Magus is defeated, advance to stage 2B. Threat on this stage carries over. When this scheme is completed, players lose game.

502164a.Name: Usurp Death
502164a.text: When Revealed: Each player discards 4 cards from the encounter deck. Each player deals themself a facedown encounter card if the cards they discarded were from different encounter sets.

502164b.Name: Usurp Death
502164b.text: Forced Response: After resolving step one of the villain phase, each player discards 2 cards from the encounter deck. Each player places 1 threat here if the cards they discarded were from different encounter sets. When this scheme is completed, players lose game.

502165.Name: Cosmic Ward
502165.text: Attach to The Magus. The Magus gains retaliate 1. Forced Interrupt: When a player plays an event, cancel its effects → discard Cosmic Ward. [star] Boost: Attach Cosmic Ward to The Magus.

502166.Name: Quantum Magic
502166.text: Attach to The Magus. The Magus gets +1 SCH and +1 ATK. [star] Forced Response: After The Magus activates, deal the topmost The Magus card in the encounter discard pile to yourself as a facedown encounter card → discard Quantum Magic.

502167.Name: Cathedral
502167.text: Assault. [star] Boost: In expert mode, this card gets +2 boost icons ([boost][boost]) for this activation.

502168.Name: Mystic Senses
502168.text: Encounter cards that do not belong to The Magus encounter set gain incite 1. [star] Boost: You are confused. If you are already confused, discard 1 card from your hand.

502169.Name: Cosmic Awareness
502169.text: Surge. When Revealed: Discard 4 cards from the encounter deck. If you are in alter-ego form and if each card discarded this way were from different sets, The Magus schemes.

502170.Name: Karmic Blast
502170.text: Surge. When Revealed: Discard 4 cards from the encounter deck. If you are in hero form and if each card discarded this way were from different sets, The Magus attacks you.

502171.Name: Milano
502171.text: Setup. The first player controls Milano. It does not count against your ally limit. Milano cannot be affected by player cards. It can only attack VEHICLE enemies. If Milano leaves play, the players lose the game.

502172.Name: Hazardous Terrain
502172.text: Assault. (Basic thwarts against this scheme use ATK instead of THW.) Hinder 2[per_hero].

502173.Name: Rogue Ship
502173.text: Rogue Ship engages the first player. Forced Interrupt: When Rogue Ship would take 3 or less non-piercing damage, it takes 0 damage instead. [star] Boost: Choose: Either exhaust the Milano, or this card gains [boost][boost].

502174.Name: All Hands on Deck
502174.text: Give to the first player. When Revealed: Spend 2 resources of any type. For each [mental] resource spent this way, heal 1 damage from the Milano.

502175.Name: Evasive Maneuver
502175.text: Give to the first player. When Revealed (Alter-Ego): The villain schemes. If no threat was placed this way, give the Milano a tough status card. When Revealed (Hero): The villain attacks you. If no damage was dealt this way, give the Milano a tough status card.

502176.Name: Outrun Danger
502176.text: Give to the first player. When Revealed: Take 3 indirect damage. If the Milano took no damage this way, give the Milano a tough status card.

502177.Name: Growing Pain
502177.text: Assault. (Basic thwarts against this scheme use ATK instead of THW.) Hinder 2[per_hero]. When Defeated: Discard 5 cards from the encounter deck.

502178.Name: Flora Giant
502178.text: Toughness. When Defeated: Discard 3 cards from the encounter deck. [star] Boost: Resolve this card's "When Defeated" ability.

502179.Name: Entangling Vines
502179.text: When Revealed: Discard 4 cards from the encounter deck. You are stunned. If you are already stunned, this card gains surge. [star] Boost: You are stunned. If you are already stunned, discard 4 cards from the encounter deck.

502180.Name: Ship Siege
502180.text: Assault. (Basic thwarts against this scheme use ATK instead of THW.) Hinder 2[per_hero]. When Defeated: Deal 4 damage to a VEHICLE minion.

502181.Name: Assault Ship
502181.text: [star] Assault Ship's attacks deal indirect damage. Forced Interrupt: When Assault Ship would take 3 or less non-piercing damage, it takes 0 damage instead. [star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, it deals indirect damage.

502182.Name: Chitauri Leviathan
502182.text: Forced Interrupt: When Chitauri Leviathan would take 3 or less non-piercing damage, it takes 0 damage instead.

502183.Name: Warp Ship
502183.text: When Revealed: Warp Ship activates against you. Forced Interrupt: When Warp Ship would take 3 or less non-piercing damage, it takes 0 damage instead. [star] Boost: Put Warp Ship into play engaged with you.

502184.Name: The Matriarch
502184.text:
The Matriarch cannot take damage while Universal Church of Truth is in play.
The Universal Church of Truth gains an [amplify] icon.

502185.Name: Universal Church of Truth
502185.text: Forced Response: After a player resets their deck, exhaust that player's identity card and stun it. [star] Boost: Reveal this card.

502186.Name: Acolyte of Truth
502186.text: Guard. When Revealed: If Universal Church of Truth is in play, this card gains surge. Otherwise, find Universal Church of Truth and reveal it. [star] Boost: Put Acolyte of Truth into play engaged with you.

502187.Name: Cardinal of Truth
502187.text: Cardinal of Truth cannot take damage while the Universal Church of Truth is in play. [star] Forced Response: After Cardinal of Truth activates, place 2 threat on Universal Church of Truth.

502188.Name: Spread the Word
502188.text: Surge. When Revealed: Each player engaged with a minion discards the top 5 cards of their deck.

502189.Name: Luminous
502189.text: Forced Response: After Luminous activates against you, discard 1 card from the encounter deck. If 3 or more icons ([star] and [boost]) in the card's boost area were discarded this way, deal yourself 1 encounter card.

502190.Name: Order in Entropy
502190.text: Permanent. Setup. Forced Response: After cards are discarded from the encounter deck or the surge keyword is resolved, place 1 threat here. Then, if there is 10 or more threat here, find Luminous and put her into play engaged with the first player. Then, remove all but 5 threat.

502191.Name: Bend Chaos
502191.text: When Revealed: Find Luminous and reveal her. (If she is already in play, she engages you.) Luminous activates against you. If no enemy activated this way, this card gains surge. [star] Boost: Discard 5 cards from the encounter deck.

502192.Name: Hex Bolt
502192.text: When Revealed: Discard 3 cards from the encounter deck. For each card discarded this way with icons ([star] and [boost]) in the card's boost area equal to: • 0, discard 1 card from your hand. • 1, place 1 threat on the main scheme. • 2, take 1 indirect damage. • 3+, this card gains surge.

502193.Name: Master of the Dark Arts
502193.text: When Revealed: Discard cards from the encounter deck until you discard a SPELL → deal it to yourself as a facedown encounter card. [star] Boost: Resolve this card's "When Revealed" ability.

502194.Name: Magic Attack
502194.text: When Revealed: The players as a group either spends [physical][physical][physical] resources or each hero and ally takes 2 damage. [star] Boost: Your hero and each ally you control takes 1 damage.

502195.Name: Shield Spell
502195.text: When Revealed: The players as a group either spends [energy][energy][energy] resources or each player is stunned and takes 1 damage. [star] Boost: You are stunned.

502196.Name: Summoning Spell
502196.text: When Revealed: Discard cards from the encounter deck until you discard a minion → reveal that minion. [star] Boost: Give this enemy 2 more boost cards.

502197.Name: Zone of Silence
502197.text: When Revealed: The players as a group either spends [mental][mental][mental] resources or each player is confused and discards 1 card from their hand. [star] Boost: You are confused.

502198.Name: Lord Gator
